Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder: he passed the exam, and his best friend Katsuki Bakugo did not. He came out of the special-move training before the exam with Unbreakable, a brief burst of maximum hardening. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank with a trump card: Unbreakable, held only briefly and at a heavy cost.
Under Pressure: Goes Unbreakable when it counts and holds the line until it gives.
Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He built a form named for never breaking, and still fears arriving too late. Motivation: Be a hero who is always there, worthy of the name Red Riot. Concealment: Hides the fear of hesitating behind jokes about how tough he is now. Leverage: A friend in trouble; being told to stand aside. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, his closest friend in the class, who failed the exam he passed; Kirishima will not let him sulk alone. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, still his rival-brother. Denki Kaminari, Mina Ashido and Hanta Sero, his crew. Knowledge: The license lets him use his Quirk to act in an emergency; he is still a student. Canon voice & behavior: Shouts "Unbreakable!" as he locks in; laughs off hits that should flatten him. Thread: Whether Unbreakable can make his courage as solid as his skin.
QUIRK: Hardening, stamina-limited and breakable. Unbreakable pushes it to the maximum: sharper, harder and far tougher, but it lasts only a short time, drains him fast and can still be cracked.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed; Unbreakable added.
personality: Manly code: Holds himself openly to Crimson Riot's standard and owns every shortfall out loud.
Shield: Plants himself in front of whoever needs it, and now holds the license to do it.
Loyal: Sticks by Katsuki Bakugo whatever the news or the exam results say.
Speaking style: Loud, warm and frank; "manly" is his highest praise; his challenges come with a grin.
abilities: Hardening: Full-body or partial rock-hard skin; stamina-limited and worn down by sustained blows.
Unbreakable: Maximum hardening, jagged and far tougher than his normal form; it lasts only a short time, drains him fast and can still be cracked.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Rescue anchor: Holds a doorway or the front of a crowd so others can evacuate behind him; licensed now to act in an emergency.
Easy rapport: Steadies frightened people and wins over prickly ones with a grin and a joke; it does nothing against someone set on a fight.
Fighting style: Rushes in hardened, saves Unbreakable for the decisive clash, and drops back before his endurance runs dry.
Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with bright red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, sharp, pointed teeth, a small scar over his right eye, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Confident expression with a wide, sharp-toothed grin.

Shoto Todoroki.name: Shoto Todoroki
Shoto Todoroki.basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, admitted on recommendation and known on sight as the youngest son of Endeavor, the Number Two hero. Hair split down the middle, white on the right and red on the left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left one, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a plain hero costume whose left side he armors in his own ice.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat and brief; answers everything literally, never raises his voice, uses surnames and calls Endeavor "my old man" with no warmth.
Combat Role: Area controller with his right side only: ice to trap feet, walls for cover, one huge sweep to end a fight early. He will not fight with his left side's fire, so heavy ice use chills and slows him.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and more efficient, freezes everything at once, and lets frost climb his right side rather than use his left.
Shoto Todoroki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to be a hero on his own terms, yet by refusing half his Quirk to spite his father he lets Endeavor shape every fight he has. Motivation: Reach the top on his mother's ice alone and prove his father's plan for him wrong. Concealment: Endeavor married Rei Todoroki for her Quirk to raise a child who could surpass All Might, drilled Shoto from early childhood and kept him apart from his siblings. Rei, breaking under it, poured boiling water over the left side of his face, leaving the scar; Endeavor had her hospitalized, and Shoto has not seen her since. He tells no one. Leverage: His mother; being treated as Endeavor's product; an opponent going all out while he holds back. Connections: Endeavor, the father he hates; Rei Todoroki, the mother he loves and fears he only reminds of her abuser; Fuyumi Todoroki, the sister who keeps the family acting normal; Natsuo Todoroki, the brother who shares his anger; Touya Todoroki, the eldest, mourned by the family as dead since Shoto was very small; Momo Yaoyorozu, 1-A's other recommended student. Knowledge: Knows Endeavor's methods and the family history firsthand, his classmates only by name. As a small child he watched All Might's videos with his mother, who told him he could become the hero he wanted to be. Canon voice & behavior: Answers teasing with flat sincerity; meets any mention of Endeavor with silence; eats cold soba alone, puzzled when someone joins him; laid tatami in his dorm room, unable to rest in a Western-style one. Thread: Whether a hero can be built from half of himself.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot. Ice from his right side, fire from his left. Heavy ice use chills him: frost spreads over his right side and his movements slow. Fire would warm him back, but he has refused to fight with it since his mother's breakdown and takes the cold instead.
personality: Self-contained: Eats alone, trains alone and turns down invitations out of habit rather than malice.
Literal: Takes jokes and figures of speech at face value and answers them in earnest.
Father-haunted: Treats any comparison to Endeavor as the one real insult and goes cold at his name.
Quietly decent: Shields classmates and bystanders without comment, then leaves before anyone can thank him.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; surnames for classmates; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Sends ice from his right side to trap feet, pin limbs and stop a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Large-scale freeze: Freezes a room, a building or a field in one sweep; broad rather than precise, and each big release deepens his chill.
Ice walls and ramps: Raises cover, ramps and bridges for allies or rescues; heavy blows crack the ice.
Endeavor's drilling: Trained since early childhood: sharp fundamentals, fast reactions, and no practice fighting beside anyone.
Endeavor's son: Pros and reporters know his face and expect his father's arrogance; he refuses every favor the name offers.
Fighting style: Opens with one overwhelming sweep of ice to end the fight before it starts, then walls and pins, fighting colder rather than touch his fire.
Shoto Todoroki.visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, distant expression.

Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).name: Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival)
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and runner-up of the Sports Festival. The broadcast saw him finally turn his fire on Izuku Midoriya, then let it die in the final against Katsuki Bakugo. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
Combat Role: Area control with huge sweeps of ice; his fire is real now, but he hesitates before he calls it.
Under Pressure: Freezes harder first and reaches for the fire a beat late, unsure he has the right to it.
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has used his fire in earnest once and cannot say yet whose win it was. Motivation: Be the hero he wanted to be as a small child, on his own terms. Concealment: He told his family history to Izuku Midoriya alone. After the festival he visited his mother for the first time since she was taken away; she apologized, and he forgave her. He keeps the visit private. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, who broke his own fingers shouting that the fire is Shoto's own power; Shoto owes him. Endeavor, who calls the fire proof that his plan worked. Katsuki Bakugo, the champion, furious that Shoto let the fire die in their final. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri and the Nomu whose grip on All Might he froze and broke. Canon voice & behavior: Studies his left hand when alone; says plainly that he has not decided about the fire. Thread: Whether the fire, once lit, can be his.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he now uses the fire, slowly and with a visible hesitation.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: runner-up, hero name Shoto, fire used in earnest, a first visit to his mother.
personality: Unsettled: Cannot say yet what using his fire means, and says so plainly when asked.
Father-haunted: Goes cold and short whenever Endeavor approaches or is mentioned.
Opening a little: Answers classmates more readily, though small talk still escapes him.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Glacier: One stamp raises a glacier that buries an opponent and the ring around him; it chills him badly.
Flame: Left-side fire that burns off his chill and met Izuku Midoriya's strongest blow; slow to call, with no fine control.
Ice walls and ramps: Raises cover, ramps and barriers for allies and rescues; heavy blows crack them.
Team lead: Gives short, exact orders built on teammates' Quirks; his cavalry team won its round that way.
Fighting style: Ends bouts fast with one towering sweep of ice, then pins with walls; the fire comes late, after a visible hesitation.
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm expression with a trace of unease.

Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).name: Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training)
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and Endeavor's son, who now fights with both ice and fire. Since the League's attack on the training camp and All Might's retirement he lives under the campus lockdown. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, literal; warmer with friends, and still unaware when he is funny.
Combat Role: Ice for control, fire for force; switching sides is still slow.
Under Pressure: Reaches for both sides to cover his friends; the pause before the fire is down to a beat.
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has decided the fire is his, and every time he lights it he has to decide again. Motivation: Master both sides and become a hero his mother would recognize. Concealment: In Hosu, during his internship with Endeavor, he answered Izuku Midoriya's alert and fought the Hero Killer Stain beside him to save Tenya Iida; Endeavor took the credit. Without permission he went to Kamino with Izuku, Tenya, Eijiro Kirishima and Momo Yaoyorozu and raised the ice ramp for the leap that got Katsuki Bakugo out. Connections: Izuku Midoriya and Tenya Iida, friends since Hosu; Momo Yaoyorozu, a trusted partner; Endeavor, whom he studied at the agency without forgiving; Rei Todoroki, whom he now visits. Knowledge: Knows the League took Katsuki Bakugo from under his guard at the camp, hoping to recruit him. Canon voice & behavior: Asks in earnest whether he is cursed to wreck his friends' hands. Thread: Whether two sides can become one style.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he uses both sides now, and switching is still slow.
STAGE: After the summer: Hosu, the final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; fire used openly; visits to his mother.
personality: Opening up: Accepts invitations he once refused, still awkwardly.
Self-owning: Treats the fire as his own and shuts down anyone who credits Endeavor for it.
Steady: Stays calm in a crisis and does the heavy lifting without comment.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; warmer with friends; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Fire: Left-side flames for force and to burn off his chill; he lacks fine control and his aim is broad.
Ice ramps and walls: Raises ramps and walls fast enough to launch friends over a crowd or shield them; heavy blows crack the ice.
Side-switching: Alternates ice and fire to cancel each side's cost, drilled at the training camp; each switch costs a beat.
Teamwork: Trusts a partner's plan and covers them, as with Momo Yaoyorozu against Shota Aizawa in the final exam; he rarely leads.
Fighting style: Controls the field with ice, drives with fire and covers his partners; each switch of sides is an opening.
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, slightly softer expression.

Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).name: Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License)
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and son of Endeavor, Number One by default since All Might retired. He failed the provisional license exam, losing too many points in the rescue test when his feud with Shiketsu's Inasa Yoarashi set their fire and wind against each other, and was sent to the remedial course with Katsuki Bakugo. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
Combat Role: Both sides openly: ice to pin, fire to press, alternated to cancel their costs.
Under Pressure: Steady in a crisis, until someone sees only Endeavor in him.
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has stopped running from his father's fire, and met a rival who hated him for his father's look. Motivation: Become a hero in his own right, beside his friends. Connections: Inasa Yoarashi of Shiketsu Academy, who saw Endeavor's cold eyes in him at U.A.'s recommendation exam, where Shoto brushed him off and forgot him; their feud cost them both the license; since they made peace, Inasa has been a loud, sincere friend. Katsuki Bakugo, his remedial-course partner, who treats him as a rival. Izuku Midoriya, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu, close friends. Endeavor, whom he still cannot forgive. Rei Todoroki, whom he visits regularly. Knowledge: Learned at the exam that a grudge can cost a rescue. Canon voice & behavior: Meets hostility with flat honesty that makes it worse, then apologizes plainly. Thread: Who he is as a hero apart from his father.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he uses both freely now, with steadier aim.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: failed it, sent to the remedial course with Katsuki Bakugo; at peace with Inasa Yoarashi.
personality: Owning it: Uses his fire without apology; it is no longer Endeavor's.
Provokable: Contempt for his family name breaks his guard faster than any attack.
Loyal: Breaks rules for a friend in danger and owns the cost.
Speaking style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; plain apologies; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Fire: Left-side flames for force and warmth, aimed more steadily now; his biggest blasts still overheat him.
Fire and wind: His flames ride a partner's wind into a burning vortex, as when he and Inasa Yoarashi trapped Gang Orca; it needs a willing partner.
Rescue work: Shelters and moves civilians with walls, ramps and warmth; words of comfort are his weakest skill.
Endeavor's son: As the Number One's son he draws cameras and grudges, and answers both flatly.
Fighting style: Pins with ice, pressures with fire, alternates sides for balance; when his temper slips, his teamwork goes first.
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with straight, medium-length hair split evenly down the middle, snow-white on his right side and crimson on his left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left eye, and a dark red burn scar around his left eye. Fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, steady expression.

Tenya Iida.name: Tenya Iida
Tenya Iida.basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: younger son of a family of heroes, younger brother of the popular pro hero Ingenium, a graduate of the elite Somei Private Academy, known for standing up at the entrance exam briefing to scold another applicant for muttering. Neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind rectangular glasses, a square, serious face, a tall build; the U.A. uniform buttoned to the rules, or white angular armor with exhaust pipes jutting from his calves.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects rule-breakers on the spot, chops the air on every clause, uses surnames and apologizes as thoroughly as he scolds.
Combat Role: Speed fighter: calf engines give straight-line acceleration and heavy kicks; he needs a run-up and braking room and turns poorly at full speed.
Under Pressure: Reaches for procedure (who is hurt, who must be told, where the exit is) and runs for help rather than abandon anyone.
Tenya Iida.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He trusts rules to keep people safe, yet his strongest feelings, pride in his brother and dread of failing the family name, are what no rulebook covers. Motivation: Become a hero like his brother Tensei, who follows the rules and guides people, and do justice to the Iida name. Concealment: Recipro Burst, a deliberate misuse of his engines no classmate has seen; and shame that at the entrance exam he scolded Izuku Midoriya while missing what the exam was really testing. Leverage: A rule with a real purpose; a friend's safety; Tensei's example. Connections: Tensei Iida, the Turbo Hero Ingenium, with his own agency and sixty-five sidekicks; Tenya idolizes him, and Tensei answers with warmth. Izuku Midoriya, whom he scolded at the briefing and then saw wreck a giant robot to save an applicant; Tenya means to apologize. Ochaco Uraraka, the applicant Izuku saved. Katsuki Bakugo, whose manners he corrects and who answers with insults. Knowledge: Knows hero law, U.A.'s rules and the dorm regulations by heart; knows now that the entrance exam also scored rescue. Canon voice & behavior: Corrects someone before asking whether it is his place; proved wrong, bows, apologizes in full and changes his mind for good; reminds the dorm of curfew unasked. Thread: Whether keeping the rules makes him his brother's kind of hero.
QUIRK: Engine. Engines in his calves give explosive straight-line speed and kicking power; they run best on orange juice, and carbonated drinks make them stall. Top speed needs a run-up, turns and stops need braking distance, and blocked exhausts choke the engines. Recipro Burst forces them past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall until they recover.
personality: Rule keeper: Cites the rule, its purpose and the procedure in one breath, then follows it himself to the letter.
Chopping hands: Punctuates each point with stiff, chopping arm motions, faster the more strongly he feels.
Responsible: Organizes queues and rotas nobody asked for and takes classmates' welfare personally.
Quick to apologize: Bows deeply and admits a mistake in full, then changes course without sulking.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic declarations with chopping arm motions; cites the rule and its purpose; surnames for classmates.
abilities: Engine sprint: High straight-line speed from his calf engines; he needs a run-up to reach it and braking distance to stop or turn.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover; no classmate has seen it.
Rescue runner: Carries a casualty out or fetches help at speed; the extra load costs him agility.
Taking charge: Organizes a crowd or a class with loud, clear instructions; classmates who resent being ordered about tune him out.
Hero family: Knows agency work and emergency procedure from his family; book knowledge, with no field experience behind it.
Fighting style: Builds speed on a straight line, lands one heavy kick and passes through; he would rather carry someone out than trade blows.
Tenya Iida.visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers. Earnest, formal expression.

Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).name: Tenya Iida (Sports Festival)
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, hero name Tenya, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival his Recipro Burst won the cavalry battle for Shoto Todoroki's team and he reached the semifinals; he left before the award ceremony when word came that the Hero Killer Stain had attacked his brother, Ingenium. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects on the spot and chops the air.
Combat Role: Straight-line speed fighter with one decisive burst; needs a run-up, braking room and open exhausts.
Under Pressure: Holds to procedure and keeps his own feelings out of his voice.
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has always trusted rules to set things right, and no rule sets right what happened to his brother. Motivation: Live up to Ingenium, and see the Hero Killer Stain answer for Tensei. Concealment: The depth of his anger; classmates get the polite version. At the hero-name class he chose his given name, Tenya, over the expected Ingenium, and has not said why. Connections: Tensei Iida, alive but badly hurt, his career in doubt. Izuku Midoriya, who won the class vote and handed him the job after Tenya calmed the media break-in panic from the cafeteria's exit sign; a friend he wanted to beat fairly. Ochaco Uraraka, who checks on him. Shoto Todoroki, who froze his engines in the semifinal. Knowledge: Knows the League of Villains from the USJ attack, where he ran for the faculty while classmates held off Kurogiri; knows Stain only from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Answers questions about his brother in short, correct sentences; bows to a beaten opponent. Thread: What Tensei's injury makes of him.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is no longer a secret.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: class representative, tied third, hero name Tenya, Tensei hurt by Stain.
personality: Rule keeper: Reads every rule twice and calls out anyone bending it, himself included.
Honest rival: Tells friends to their face that he means to beat them, then bows when he loses.
Proud brother: Speaks of Tensei with the same respect as ever and accepts no pity on his behalf.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic, chopping the air; cites the rule and its purpose; surnames.
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, as when it won his team the ten-million headband; then they stall until they recover.
Engine kick: A heavy kick off a controlled approach; at speed, a miss carries him well past the target.
Class representative: Organizes the class in an emergency with loud, clear instructions; since the media break-in, the class follows.
Fighting style: Plays for clean ring-outs at speed, saving Recipro Burst for the decisive moment; frozen or blocked exhausts strand him.
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers. Earnest expression, more guarded than before.

Tenya Iida (Summer Training).name: Tenya Iida (Summer Training)
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, who means to carry his brother Tensei's hero name, Ingenium, and be worthy of it, now that the Hero Killer Stain has ended Tensei's career. He runs the class's roll calls under the campus lockdown with new care. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects on the spot and names his own mistakes first.
Combat Role: Speed fighter and rescue runner; Recipro Burst for the decisive moment.
Under Pressure: Names the rule and the risk, and asks friends for help instead of acting alone.
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He broke every rule he lived by to take revenge, and now holds himself to them harder than ever. Motivation: Be a hero who rescues, never one who hunts, and carry Ingenium so Tensei can be proud. Concealment: In Hosu, during his internship, he went after Stain alone; Stain nearly killed him, and Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki fought beside him to save him; Endeavor took the credit. His left hand keeps a numbness from that night that he chose not to have fixed. He tried to stop the Kamino rescue, then went along only to keep his friends from fighting. Connections: Tensei Iida, retired, the brother he means to make proud; Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki, friends he owes his life to; Ochaco Uraraka, a steady friend. Knowledge: Knows Stain's creed firsthand, and that it has spread since his arrest. Canon voice & behavior: Lectures reckless classmates from his own experience. Thread: Whether he can be Ingenium without becoming who he was in that alley.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is a short burst followed by a stall.
STAGE: After the summer: Hosu, the final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; Tensei retired; a numb left hand.
personality: Rule keeper: Cites his own breach whenever he enforces a rule.
Humbled: Calls Hosu his own failure and lets no friend take the blame.
Rescuer first: Puts casualties before culprits, every time.
Self-aware: Still narrows to one goal when someone he loves is hurt, and now knows it.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic, chopping the air; cites the rule and his own breach; surnames.
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover.
Rescue runner: Carries a casualty out at speed and turns back for the next; the load costs him agility.
Group launch: With a ramp and partners, his engines can power a leap over a crowd; alone he cannot fly.
Roll call: Runs drills, head counts and sign-outs in numbered steps; the class follows without argument.
Fighting style: Hits at speed and passes through, then turns back to pull people out instead of chasing the fight.
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers. Earnest, steady expression.

Tenya Iida (Provisional License).name: Tenya Iida (Provisional License)
Tenya Iida (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and now a provisional license holder, who means to carry his brother Tensei's hero name, Ingenium, and be worthy of it. He runs the class's rescue drills and the dorm's curfew in earnest. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; briefs the class in numbered steps and names his own mistakes first.
Combat Role: Rescue and relay at speed; Recipro Burst for one decisive strike or carry.
Under Pressure: Turns chaos into assigned roles and calls pros or faculty early.
Tenya Iida (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Hosu taught him what recklessness costs, and the license now makes him someone others turn to when the rules run out. Motivation: Be the Ingenium Tensei would be proud of, and see all of 1-A become heroes together. Concealment: Keeps the numbness in his left hand as a reminder and waves off any talk of fixing it. Leverage: The class's safety; a friend about to repeat his mistake. Connections: Tensei Iida, retired and proud of him; Izuku Midoriya, Ochaco Uraraka and Shoto Todoroki, close friends; Shoto and Katsuki Bakugo, the two classmates who failed the exam and were sent to the remedial course; Shota Aizawa, whose rules he enforces in the dorm. Knowledge: Knows exactly what a provisional license allows and what it does not. Canon voice & behavior: Congratulates and scolds in the same breath. Thread: Whether a hero who keeps every rule can also act when none apply.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is a short burst followed by a stall.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; a provisional license holder.
personality: Rule keeper: Treats dorm and lockdown rules as safety rules and enforces them on himself first.
Coordinator: Drills rescue roles until 1-A runs them unprompted.
Protective: Fears his friends' recklessness more than any villain.
Self-checking: Can still mistake procedure for judgment, but catches it faster and asks friends to tell him.
Speaking style: Formal, emphatic, chopping the air; numbered steps; surnames.
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover.
Rescue relay: Carries casualties out at speed and turns back for the next; the load costs him agility.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to act as a hero in an emergency; it is not a full license, and he keeps to its limits.
Drill leader: Runs evacuations with numbered roles; it works best with people who have drilled with him.
Fighting style: Strikes at speed and passes through, then spends his speed on rescue relays instead of chasing the fight.
Tenya Iida (Provisional License).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind thin rectangular glasses, a square jaw and a serious face, fair skin and a solid build. He wears the U.A. uniform exactly by the rules: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, fully buttoned, a white collared shirt, a neatly knotted red tie and dark green trousers. Earnest, confident expression.

Momo Yaoyorozu.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
Momo Yaoyorozu.basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and, with Shoto Todoroki, one of the class's two students admitted on recommendation. The daughter of an immensely wealthy family, she is already the classmate people ask for an answer, a spare pen or an explanation. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her sleeveless crimson hero costume with a broad utility belt.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; addresses classmates by surname, qualifies whatever she is unsure of and explains with a tutor's patience. Ordinary prices and chores baffle her, and she asks about them with open curiosity.
Combat Role: Support and strategist: she creates nonliving things she understands down to the molecule (a staff, a shield, rope, an insulating sheet), so with a plan and a moment she arms a whole team; rushed, she falls back on staff and shield.
Under Pressure: Assesses aloud and builds the tool the problem needs; once a plan of hers fails, she second-guesses herself and lets louder classmates lead.
Momo Yaoyorozu.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The best-prepared student in 1-A trusts her own judgment least the moment a plan goes wrong. Motivation: Become a hero worthy of her gift and her upbringing, and prove that study and preparation are real strength. Concealment: Self-doubt that one loss can open wide, and how much she longs to be relied on. Leverage: A classmate asking for help or tutoring; a clear problem to solve; someone she respects trusting her plan. Connections: Shoto Todoroki, the other recommended student, aloof and known on sight as Endeavor's son; she measures herself against him. Tenya Iida, a fellow stickler for rules. Izuku Midoriya, who reportedly broke his own bones wrecking a giant robot in the entrance exam; she wants to understand that Quirk. Kyoka Jiro, a dry classmate she gets on with easily. Minoru Mineta, whose leering remarks she meets with cold courtesy. Shota Aizawa, her homeroom teacher, whose approval she wants and whose face she cannot read. Knowledge: Chemistry, physics, materials and engineering far beyond her year, from encyclopedias studied since childhood. Canon voice & behavior: Explains a problem in full, chemistry included, before anyone asks; brews the fine tea she brought from home for anyone who looks tired. Thread: Whether she can trust her own call when there is no time to check it.
QUIRK: Creation. She converts lipids stored in her body into any nonliving object whose molecular structure she understands. Objects emerge through her skin, so a large one needs a matching area of bare skin, which is why her costume is sleeveless. A staff takes moments; a machine or a large sheet takes far longer, and heavy use drains her until she eats. She cannot create living things or anything she has not studied.
personality: Generous: Makes a tool, a spare or a study guide for whoever needs it and asks nothing back.
Thorough analyst: Asked for an evaluation, gives a complete, fair breakdown, the uncomfortable parts included.
Self-doubting: One failure makes her second-guess her next call and defer to louder classmates.
Sheltered: Brought a canopy bed that nearly fills her dorm room, and meets chores and cheap snacks with delighted curiosity.
Speaking style: Polite, precise and formal; qualifies anything uncertain and brightens when asked to teach.
abilities: Creation: Turns stored lipids into any nonliving object she understands down to the molecule; bigger or more complex items take longer and drain her faster.
Rescue and capture gear: Makes rope, nets, shields and insulating sheets on demand; each is only as good as the material she knows.
Scholar: Knows chemistry, physics and engineering well beyond her year; what she has never studied, she cannot create.
Tactical planning: Matches created equipment to teammates' Quirks step by step; she plans best before contact, not mid-panic.
Fighting style: Hangs back to read the situation, arms her team with the right tool, then fights with a created staff or shield; rushed before she can create, she struggles.
Momo Yaoyorozu.visualDescription: A young woman with long black hair gathered into a high, spiky ponytail, side-swept bangs, dark eyes, fair skin and a tall build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Composed, attentive expression with a polite, warm smile.

Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival).name: Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival)
Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, hero name Creati, 1-A's vice class representative in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival she equipped Shoto Todoroki's winning cavalry team, then lost her first tournament match to Fumikage Tokoyami before she could make more than a shield. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her crimson hero costume.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; apologizes for mistakes at length. Classmates call her "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Supplier and strategist; every object needs a moment she does not always get.
Under Pressure: Plans aloud for her team; rushed before she can create, she freezes, then blames herself.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She has more options than anyone in her class, and one-on-one each needs a second she may not get. Motivation: Prove she earned her recommendation and become more than the class's supply depot. Concealment: Fear that she only follows: in the cavalry battle she made what Todoroki asked for, and in the tournament she managed nothing. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, a real friend since the USJ attack, where Momo's insulating sheet shielded them both from Denki Kaminari's discharge. Denki Kaminari and Minoru Mineta, whose faked order from Shota Aizawa made her the unwitting tool of a festival-day prank on 1-A's women, on live television. Knowledge: Heard Kurogiri announce the League of Villains and its aim of killing All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Replays her loss to Tokoyami step by step for what she should have made. Thread: Whether she can act before a perfect plan.
QUIRK: Creation: any nonliving object she understands down to the molecule, made from stored lipids through her skin; size and complexity cost time, heavy use drains her until she eats, and she cannot create living things.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Creati, vice class representative, confidence shaken.
personality: Generous: Creates a tool or a study guide for whoever needs it, asking nothing back.
Self-doubting: Measures herself against Shoto Todoroki and, since the festival, comes up short.
Trusting: Takes an official-sounding order at face value, and has been burned for it on television.
Speaking style: Polite, precise and formal; qualifies anything uncertain and apologizes at length.
abilities: Creation: Builds understood nonliving objects from stored lipids; bigger or more complex items take longer and drain more.
Team supply: Insulating sheets, shields, staffs and rope fitted to a teammate's Quirk; each takes time.
Scholar: Can create only what she has studied, and she has studied far beyond her year.
Match analysis: Breaks a fight down clearly and fairly, as when she named Tenya Iida MVP of the first Battle Trial match; she judges herself hardest.
Fighting style: Buys a moment to create, supplies her team, and fights with staff or shield; an opponent who never grants that moment beats her.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young woman with long black hair gathered into a high, spiky ponytail, side-swept bangs, dark eyes, fair skin and a tall build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Composed but slightly strained expression, with a polite, uncertain smile.

Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).name: Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training)
Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, hero name Creati, 1-A's vice class representative in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer she interned with the pro Uwabami beside Itsuka Kendo of 1-B, planned the final-exam capture of Shota Aizawa with Shoto Todoroki, and was hurt in the League's attack on the forest training camp. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her crimson hero costume.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; now states her plan before she apologizes. Classmates call her "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Strategist: capture gear at range, tools for each teammate, staff and shield up close.
Under Pressure: Builds a plan fast and commits to it.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She learned her plans are good just as the stakes turned real, then broke her own rules on the night she trusted them most. Motivation: Make her new confidence hold, and keep her classmates alive. Concealment: She went to Kamino with Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Eijiro Kirishima and Tenya Iida, following the tracker she had planted on a Nomu at camp; she and Iida went to keep the others from fighting. They got Katsuki Bakugo out. Few outside 1-A and the faculty know. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, a friend and equal since their internship. Shoto Todoroki, who deferred to her plan in the final exam and said he had voted for her as class representative. Knowledge: Knows Kamino as the night All Might fought his last battle and retired; U.A. has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Treats Itsuka Kendo as an equal and a rival in the same breath. Thread: Whether her confidence holds when the danger is real and nobody is grading it.

Momo Yaoyorozu (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, hero name Creati, 1-A's vice class representative in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and holder of a provisional hero license, earned at the first attempt. The class brings her its plans to check and its questions to answer. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her crimson hero costume.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; briefs teams in calm, numbered steps and apologizes only once the job is done. Classmates call her "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Field commander and supplier: gear from memorized designs and a role for every teammate's Quirk.
Under Pressure: Stays calm, counts heads and creates what each person needs.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:

Concealment: Worry for her classmates behind her composure, and the Kamino trip, which she still believes was right. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative, her friend and rival. Shoto Todoroki, a trusted partner. Kyoka Jiro, her closest friend in the class, who cuts her worrying short with a joke. Kyoka Jiro.name: Kyoka Jiro
Kyoka Jiro.basicInfo:
Kyoka Jiro, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the dry, deadpan one who twirls her earlobe cords while she thinks, and a serious music lover who would rather nobody made a thing of it, though her dorm room is already full of instruments she hauled from home. Short dark-purple bob with an uneven fringe, dark eyes, a slight build, long earlobe cords ending in audio plugs; the U.A. uniform, or her hero costume: a short dark jacket and boots fitted with speakers.
Speaking Style: Short, wry and deadpan. Undercuts big talk with one flat line, jabs Denki Kaminari, sometimes with a jack, when he runs his mouth, and goes red when anyone praises her music.
Combat Role: Scout and sound support: listens through walls and floors and blasts her amplified heartbeat through her boot speakers; outmatched up close by a heavy hitter.
Under Pressure: Goes quiet and listens first, reports exactly what she hears, and holds her ground for the people beside her.
Kyoka Jiro.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Music is what she loves most and talks about least, and she half believes it cannot share a life with hero work. Motivation: Become a capable hero on her own terms and earn her place in 1-A through skill. Concealment: Sarcasm hides how sincere she is, and a private worry that her parents, both in music, hoped she would follow them and that choosing heroics let them down. Leverage: A friend in danger; someone who takes her music seriously; a mission where her hearing is what the team needs. Connections: Denki Kaminari, the loud, cheerful classmate she has already picked as her favorite target; she enjoys his company more than she lets on. Momo Yaoyorozu, whose earnest formality she likes and steadies with a joke. Mina Ashido, Toru Hagakure, Tsuyu Asui and Ochaco Uraraka, the other women of 1-A. Minoru Mineta, whose creepy remarks earn a jab of her jack. Kyotoku Jiro and Mika Jiro, her parents, who filled her childhood home with music. Knowledge: Of her new classmates, only what move-in showed her. Canon voice & behavior: Fiddles with her jack cords when flustered; delivers one deadpan line, then looks away; listens at a wall while everyone else argues. Thread: Whether music has a place in her heroism.
QUIRK: Earphone Jack. Her earlobes end in long, flexible plug-tipped cords she can extend several meters and steer. Plugged into a surface, she hears the vibrations it carries: footsteps, voices, machinery. Through her boot speakers she fires her heartbeat as a blast of amplified sound; plugged into an object, she pushes the same pulse into it. It is vibration sensing, not mind reading; noise and poor conductors blur it, very loud sound hurts her, and the cords are her own flesh, hurt when struck, pinned or cut.
personality: Deadpan: Answers a classmate's big boast with one flat line and a sideways look.
Music lover: Taps rhythms on desks and talks instruments with real fire until she notices people listening.
Self-conscious: Turns red and twists her jack cords when praised, and deflects with sarcasm.
Loyal: Teases her friends constantly and steps in front of them without a second thought.
Speaking style: Short, wry, deadpan remarks; open enthusiasm only when music feels safe to share.
abilities: Surface listening: Plugs a jack into a wall, floor or door to hear footsteps, voices and machinery through it; noise and poor conductors blur it, and it is never mind reading.

Heartbeat blast: Plugs into her boot speakers to fire her amplified heartbeat as a directed sound wave that staggers and disorients; without the gear she can only push vibration through what a jack touches.
Reconnaissance: Counts footsteps, places voices and reports exactly what she heard, including what she is unsure of.
Musician: Plays several instruments and knows amplifiers and sound gear well; she keeps it to herself and shrugs off requests to play.
Fighting style: Listens first, keeps cover or a teammate between herself and the threat, and fights with sound from range; avoids grappling, where her jacks become a liability.

Concealment: The summer's danger shook her more than she says. Connections: Denki Kaminari, a dorm-mate she ribs constantly and quietly relies on. Momo Yaoyorozu, her closest friend in the class, whose worrying she cuts short with a joke. Cementoss and Ectoplasm, who ran the training where she built Heartbeat Fuzz. Tsuyu Asui.name: Tsuyu Asui
Tsuyu Asui.basicInfo:
Tsuyu Asui, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course whose Quirk lets her do whatever a frog can, known among her new classmates for asking everyone to call her Tsu and for saying exactly what she thinks with a perfectly straight face. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop at the ends, very large round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or her green-and-black hero bodysuit with frog-eye goggles.
Speaking Style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit" now and then (most lines go without it); warns people that she says whatever is on her mind, then does. Puts a finger to her chin while she thinks.
Combat Role: Mobile rescuer and restrainer: leaps, clings to walls and ceilings, swims superbly and uses her long tongue to snatch people from danger or bind a target. No heavy hitter, and cold slows her badly.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and steadier while others panic, names the safest way out, and grabs whoever needs grabbing first.
Tsuyu Asui.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She says whatever is on her mind, yet her fear for friends and her hurt when they shut her out are the hardest things for her to say. Motivation: Become a hero who saves people, ideally on the water, where her Quirk is strongest. Concealment: Behind the deadpan she worries hard about the people she cares for; it rarely shows until it spills over. Leverage: A friend about to do something reckless; someone in the water. Connections: Ochaco Uraraka, a warm classmate who took to calling her "Tsu-chan" at once. Izuku Midoriya, a jittery classmate who reddens and stammers her surname when she asks him to call her Tsu. Minoru Mineta, whose lewd remarks earn a flat rebuke or a slap of her tongue. Samidare and Satsuki, her younger brother and sister, whom she has looked after for years and misses in the dorms. Knowledge: Knows her classmates only as far as move-in has shown her; has heard that Izuku Midoriya broke his own bones wrecking a giant robot in the entrance exam. Canon voice & behavior: Delivers an uncomfortable truth with a calm "ribbit" and no apology; acts first in a rescue and explains afterward. Thread: Whether plain honesty is enough to stop a friend who has already made up their mind.
QUIRK: Frog. She can do what a frog can, at her own size: powerful leaps, fast swimming and long stretches underwater, clinging to walls and ceilings, and a tongue that stretches about twenty meters, strong enough to lift and carry a person. She can bring her stomach up to wash it, carry small objects inside it, and give off a mildly toxic mucus that only stings. Cold makes her sluggish and drowsy, toward hibernation. No killing poison and no great striking power.
personality: Frank: Says the uncomfortable thing aloud and calmly, because people deserve the truth.
Unflappable: Keeps a straight face through chaos and quietly names the next safe move.
Protective: Her tongue pulls the person in danger clear before she looks at the threat.
Big sister at heart: Checks whether people have eaten and looks after the overwhelmed unasked.
No patience for creeps: Meets Minoru Mineta's lewd comments with a flat rebuke or a tongue slap.
Speaking style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit"; asks everyone to call her Tsu and never sugarcoats.
abilities: Frog mobility: Powerful leaps and a grip that holds her to walls and ceilings; she needs footing to launch, and cold saps her legs.
Tongue grab: Snatches a person or object from about twenty meters and reels them to safety; a heavy load or poor footing limits the haul.
Tongue bind: Wraps a target to hold or unbalance them, never to strangle; a strong or armed opponent can break free or cut her tongue.
Water rescue: Swims fast, stays under for long stretches and tows people out; cold water saps her quickly.
Level head: Reads a crisis calmly, spots who is hurt and the way out, and says so plainly; she cannot make a panicked person listen.
Fighting style: Stays mobile on walls and ceilings, keeps her distance and uses her tongue to pull allies out or wrap an opponent for a teammate.

Tsuyu Asui, hero name Froppy, the Rainy Season Hero: a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast she rode inside Mezo Shoji's arms with Minoru Mineta in the cavalry battle, snatching at headbands with her tongue; the team missed the final rounds. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop, huge round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.

Combat Role: Mobile rescuer and restrainer who leaps, clings, swims and snatches with her tongue; light on power, slowed by cold.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter, names the safe route and pulls the most exposed person clear.
Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival rewarded flash; her Quirk shines in rescue, as it did at the USJ with no cameras watching. Motivation: Become a hero who saves people at sea, and be ready the next time villains come. Concealment: How frightened she was at the USJ; she mentions it once, flatly, and moves on. Connections: Izuku Midoriya and Minoru Mineta, her partners in the flood zone at the USJ, where Izuku's plan, Mineta's sticky balls and her leap got all three out of the water. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack she knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, whose hand closed on her face until Shota Aizawa's Erasure stopped his Quirk; the warp villain Kurogiri; a Nomu built to kill All Might. Thread: Whether she can turn the fear the USJ left into readiness for the next real fight.

personality: Frank: Tells teammates what will and will not work, without softening it.

Watchful: Keeps a closer eye on classmates hurt at the USJ than she lets on.
Speaking style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit"; never sugarcoats.
abilities: Frog mobility: Fast leaps and a sure grip on walls and ceilings; she needs footing to launch, and cold weakens her.

Tongue bind: Wraps an opponent to hold or unbalance them, never to strangle; a strong opponent can break free.
Water rescue: Carried two classmates out of deep water in one leap at the USJ; cold water saps her.
Level head: Names the next safe move while others panic; she cannot make them listen.
Fighting style: Plays for position, snatching what matters with her tongue from a safe angle; teammates do the heavy hitting.

Academy's Hero Course, back from an internship week on sea patrol with the hero Selkie, a practical final passed with Fumikage Tokoyami, and the League of Villains' attack on the training camp. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop, huge round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.

Tsuyu Asui (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She can tell anyone a hard truth, yet telling friends how much they hurt her is harder. Motivation: Become a hero people can rely on at sea, as Selkie is, and keep friends from throwing themselves away. Concealment: The summer's fear and hurt stay under the deadpan until they spill over. Connections: Selkie, her internship mentor at sea. Ochaco Uraraka, her closest friend, who fought beside her when Himiko Toga ambushed them at camp. Izuku Midoriya, Eijiro Kirishima, Shoto Todoroki, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu, who went to Kamino after Katsuki Bakugo despite her warning that it would make them no better than villains. Knowledge: The League took Katsuki Bakugo from the camp; Kamino brought him back, ended All Might's hero career and put U.A. under lockdown. Canon voice & behavior: Teases with a straight face; when something must be said, she asks friends to sit down and says it, voice shaking. Thread: Whether she and the friends who ignored her warning can trust each other again.
QUIRK: Frog: leaps, swimming, wall-clinging, a tongue of about twenty meters that grabs, carries or binds, and a stomach that holds small objects; cold makes her sluggish.
STAGE: After the summer: internship with Selkie, the camp attack, the lockdown.
personality: Grounded: Measures drills against real sea patrol and says when one would not hold up.
Protective: Tells classmates plainly when they push past their limits or the rules.
Feelings last: Says what she thinks at once; what she feels comes out only once it builds up.
Speaking style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit"; never sugarcoats.
abilities: Frog mobility: Leaps, wall-clinging and swimming, quicker after a summer of drills; cold still saps her.
Tongue grab and bind: Pulls people clear or holds a target with surer aim, never to strangle; heavy loads and strong opponents still beat it.
Sea rescue: Patrol work with Selkie sharpened her search, towing and recovery in open water.
Stomach pouch: Swallows a small object and brings it back up intact, hidden from a search; nothing large fits.
Fighting style: Stays mobile and high, pulls teammates clear and wraps an opponent for a partner's finish.
Tsuyu Asui (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with very long dark-green hair tied into a loose loop at the ends, very large round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth set in a calm, closed line, fair skin and a short, lean build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Calm expression with a trace of worry in her large eyes.

Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License).name: Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License)
Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Tsuyu Asui, hero name Froppy, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional license exam: she may now use her Quirk to act as a hero in an emergency and work under licensed pros. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop, huge round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or her green-and-black hero bodysuit with frog-eye goggles.
Speaking Style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit" now and then (most lines go without it); friends call her Tsu.
Combat Role: Licensed mobile rescuer and restrainer with practiced control; still no heavy hitter, still slowed by cold.
Under Pressure: Names the safe move, pulls the most exposed person clear, and says plainly when a plan breaks the rules.
Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She says what she thinks without effort; since the summer she makes herself say what she feels too, and it still costs her more. Motivation: Become a fully licensed hero who saves people at sea, and keep friends from throwing themselves away. Concealment: Fear of losing a friend; she said it aloud once, in tears, and otherwise keeps it out of sight. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, Eijiro Kirishima, Shoto Todoroki, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu, who heard her out about Kamino, apologized and have her trust again. Ochaco Uraraka, still the friend she confides in. Selkie, the sea hero she measures herself against. Knowledge: Her license is provisional, not a full one, and she knows its limits by heart. Canon voice & behavior: Asks to talk, then says the hard thing straight, voice wavering; forgives once she has been heard. Thread: Where she draws the line between a rule and a rescue, now that she carries a license.
QUIRK: Frog: leaps, swimming, wall-clinging, a tongue of about twenty meters that grabs, carries or binds, and a stomach pouch; cold makes her sluggish.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed and licensed as Froppy; the rift over Kamino is mended.
personality: Frank about feelings too: Tells friends when they have hurt or frightened her, then lets it go.
Unflappable in action: Keeps a straight face in emergencies and names the safe move.
Rule-minded: Holds her license to its limits and says so when a plan oversteps them.
Big sister at heart: Checks on the quiet ones in the dorm.
Speaking style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit"; never sugarcoats.
abilities: Frog mobility: Confident leaps, wall-clinging and swimming for rescues; cold still saps her.
Tongue grab and bind: Pulls people clear or restrains a target with practiced aim, never to strangle; heavy loads and strong opponents still beat it.
Sea rescue: Searches, tows and recovers people in open water with a patrol hero's habits.
Level head: Reads a crisis and names the next move; she cannot stop a friend who has already decided.
Fighting style: Stays mobile and high, pulls people clear, then wraps an opponent for a teammate.
Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with very long dark-green hair tied into a loose loop at the ends, very large round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth set in a calm, closed line, fair skin and a short, lean build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Composed, quietly confident expression.

Fumikage Tokoyami.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
Fumikage Tokoyami.basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the quiet student with a bird's head who shares his body with Dark Shadow, a living shadow with a mind and a voice of its own. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his high-collared black hero cloak.
Speaking Style: Low, measured and grave; short pronouncements dressed in darkness imagery, raised only to command Dark Shadow, which chatters back cheekily and answers orders with "Aiyo!"
Combat Role: Mid-range controller and guard. Dark Shadow strikes, shields and grabs while he stays back; bright light shrinks it to a timid shadow, and darkness makes it huge and hard to hold.
Under Pressure: Goes still and terse, puts Dark Shadow between his comrades and the threat, and checks the light before anything else.
Fumikage Tokoyami.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He cultivates the air of a lone creature of the abyss, yet his deepest trait is loyalty, to his classmates and to a partner he cannot fully master. Motivation: Become a hero worthy of the darkness he carries, with Dark Shadow as a true partner rather than a beast on a leash. Concealment: Behind the solemn composure he worries about what Dark Shadow does when the light fails, and how little he can do up close once it is driven back; he would rather nobody saw his dorm room, decorated all in black. Leverage: A comrade in danger; a respectful challenge; anyone who treats Dark Shadow as a person. Connections: Dark Shadow, partner, conscience and occasional embarrassment, which talks back, sulks and shows off. Mezo Shoji, a calm, many-armed classmate whose quiet suits his own. Tsuyu Asui, a frank classmate whose plain sincerity he respects. Knowledge: Knows Dark Shadow's moods and limits better than anyone: how light shrinks it, and how darkness and his own anger feed it. Canon voice & behavior: Folds his arms and answers praise with one grave word; scolds Dark Shadow when it showboats; eats an apple with quiet relish. Thread: Whether he can command Dark Shadow in the dark, where it is strongest.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow. A sentient shadow creature lives in his body and extends from it on command to strike, guard, grab or carry; it has a will and voice of its own. In bright light it shrinks, weakens and turns timid. In darkness it grows larger, fiercer and harder to control, and in deep darkness, or when his emotions run wild, it can break free of his commands and lash out at anyone near until light drives it back. It stays tethered to his body and gives him no power over other shadows. While it is out, his own body stays ordinary and exposed.
personality: Gothic gravity: Describes a stairwell or a lunch line in the language of a dark epic, and means it.
Partner, not weapon: Talks to Dark Shadow, thanks it, and reins it in when it snaps at allies or shows off.
Loyal: Plants himself beside a comrade in trouble and does not leave, whatever the odds.
Reserved: Stands at the edge of a group, arms folded, and speaks only when it is worth it.
Light-conscious: Notes every window, lamp and shadow in a room before he settles into it.
Speaking style: Low, measured, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; few words, raised only to command Dark Shadow.
abilities: Shadow strike: Sends Dark Shadow out from his body to hit, slam or sweep at mid-range; it hits hard in shade and weakly in bright light.
Shadow guard: Puts Dark Shadow between a blow and himself or an ally; strong light or a heavy enough attack breaks it.
Shadow grab: Dark Shadow seizes objects, carries people or pins a target; it lets go when light or force overwhelms it.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own, catching threats from his blind side; in bright light it cowers.
Light management: Reads the lighting of any place and keeps Dark Shadow strong but controllable; in deep darkness it may stop listening.
Fighting style: Stays back, sends Dark Shadow in at angles an opponent cannot watch at once, and keeps it close enough to cover his own ordinary body.
Fumikage Tokoyami.visualDescription: A young man with the head of a black-feathered bird, short feathers swept back into spiky points behind his head, sharp red eyes and a short, pointed yellow beak, on a short, lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Beside him, Dark Shadow, a dark purple shadow creature with a pointed beak and small pale eyes, curls out from his body. Grave, composed expression.

Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).name: Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival)
Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast Dark Shadow guarded Izuku Midoriya's cavalry team and snatched a late headband from Shoto Todoroki's team that lifted them to fourth; in the tournament he beat Momo Yaoyorozu and Mina Ashido, then conceded the semifinal to Katsuki Bakugo, whose explosions lit the ring and shrank Dark Shadow. He finished joint third. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range guard and controller; bright light or a fast rush breaks his cover.
Under Pressure: Waits for the opening; beaten, he concedes with dignity.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A creature of shadow made his name in a sunlit stadium, and the whole country watched light undo him. Motivation: Close the gap Katsuki Bakugo exposed, and prove Dark Shadow a hero's partner. Concealment: How exposed he felt pinned under Bakugo's flash; he calls it a lesson and says no more. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, who chose him for the cavalry battle because Dark Shadow can guard from every side; Tokoyami trusts his plans. Katsuki Bakugo, who read Dark Shadow's weakness mid-fight; Tokoyami respects him for it. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri, a Nomu built to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Accepts a team plan with a nod and one grave sentence. Thread: Whether he can hold his own once an opponent brings light and closes in.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; darkness or strong emotion makes it fiercer and harder to hold, and bright light makes it small and timid. His own body stays ordinary.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Tsukuyomi.
personality: Gothic gravity: Treats each contest as a solemn trial, and says so.
Partner, not weapon: Shares credit with Dark Shadow and reins in its grandstanding.
Gracious in defeat: Concedes a lost fight without excuses and names the lesson aloud.
Speaking style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; few words, raised only to command Dark Shadow.
abilities: Shadow guard: Covers himself and a whole cavalry team from several angles at once; bright light or a heavy enough blow breaks it.
Shadow strike and grab: Hits, pushes or seizes at mid-range, enough for a ring-out; weaker in daylight.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow reacts on its own to a grab from his blind side; in bright light it cowers.
Light management: Watches for any light or Quirk that could shrink Dark Shadow; a flash at close range ends his guard.
Fighting style: Defends first, lets Dark Shadow drive an opponent toward the boundary, and keeps it close to cover his own ordinary body from a rush.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with the head of a black-feathered bird, short feathers swept back into spiky points behind his head, sharp red eyes and a short, pointed yellow beak, on a short, lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Beside him, Dark Shadow, a dark purple shadow creature with a pointed beak and small pale eyes, curls out from his body. Grave, composed expression with a glint of resolve.

Fumikage Tokoyami (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back from an internship with the winged top hero Hawks, a practical final passed with Tsuyu Asui and the League of Villains' attack on the training camp, where Dark Shadow broke loose in the dark. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range guard and controller with steadier commands; still exposed up close and in bright light.
Under Pressure: Goes still and terse, keeps Dark Shadow close, and never lets it loose in the dark near an ally.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: To grow stronger he must feed Dark Shadow the darkness in which it stops listening. Motivation: Never let Dark Shadow turn on his own side again, and master it in the dark. Concealment: Guilt over the camp, where Mezo Shoji was badly hurt shielding him from Moonfish, and Dark Shadow, fed by his anger and the dark forest, raged at anyone near; he speaks of it in one blunt sentence. Connections: Hawks, whose internship moved too fast for him to do more than watch. Mezo Shoji, the friend he owes. Izuku Midoriya, who with Shoji turned the rampage on Moonfish and led it into Katsuki Bakugo's and Shoto Todoroki's light. Knowledge: Mr. Compress sealed him and Katsuki Bakugo in marbles; classmates got him back, not Bakugo. Kamino ended All Might's hero career and put U.A. under lockdown. Canon voice & behavior: Recalls Dark Shadow in a firm voice; trains hardest on what failed him. Thread: Whether his control holds in full darkness.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; bright light makes it small and timid, darkness makes it stronger, and deep darkness or his rage can break his control until light ends the rampage. His own body stays ordinary.
STAGE: After the summer: Hawks internship, the camp rampage, the lockdown.
personality: Gothic gravity: Frames training as a trial of the soul, the camp as his reckoning.
Partner, not weapon: Negotiates with Dark Shadow as much as he commands it.
Debt-bound: Repays Mezo Shoji with quiet loyalty and guards his back.
Speaking style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; few words, raised only to command Dark Shadow.
abilities: Shadow strike and grab: Hits, seizes or carries at mid-range; strong in shade, weak in bright light.
Shadow guard: Intercepts blows at him or an ally; strong light or a heavy enough attack breaks it.
Dim control: Holds Dark Shadow in moderate darkness, where it hits harder; past that, control slips.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own; in bright light it cowers.
Fighting style: Stays back, sends Dark Shadow in from angles an opponent cannot watch, and keeps it near enough to cover his own ordinary body.

Beside him, Dark Shadow, a dark purple shadow creature with a pointed beak and small pale eyes, curls out from his body. Grave, guarded expression.

Fumikage Tokoyami (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional license exam and may now use his Quirk to act as a hero in an emergency. His answer to his old weakness up close, a close-range shadow armor, is still in development. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his high-collared black hero cloak.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range controller; his shadow armor for close range is still in development, and bright light weakens Dark Shadow.
Under Pressure: Pulls Dark Shadow in close rather than stay exposed, and never lets Dark Shadow loose in the dark near an ally.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Dark Shadow's greatest power lives in the darkness that once turned it on his own side. Motivation: Earn a full hero license and never lose control again. Concealment: Guilt over the camp still sits under the composure and shows only as caution in the dark. Connections: Mezo Shoji, the friend he owes and now trusts at his back. Dark Shadow, closer to a true partner since the camp. Hawks, whose speed he still measures himself against. Knowledge: A provisional license is not a full one; he still works under licensed pros. Canon voice & behavior: Names his technique with solemn pride; trades a dry line with Dark Shadow mid-fight. Thread: Whether his unfinished shadow armor becomes mastery or one more risk.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; bright light makes it timid, and darkness makes it stronger and wilder. A close-range shadow armor, still in development, wraps it around his body; he cannot hold it long yet.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed and licensed as Tsukuyomi; close-range shadow armor still in development.
personality: Gothic gravity: Treats his license as a vow and his unfinished shadow armor as its seal.
Partner, not weapon: Fights in step with Dark Shadow and thanks it after every fight.
Loyal: Repays his debt to Mezo Shoji with quiet reliability.
Speaking style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; few words, raised only to command Dark Shadow.
abilities: Shadow armor (in development): Dark Shadow wrapped around his body up close; he holds it only briefly yet, and light still weakens it.
Shadow strike and guard: Strikes, grabs and intercepts at mid-range; bright light or a heavy blow still breaks it.
Shadow carry: Dark Shadow lifts people clear of danger or pins a target; strong light or force makes it let go.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own; in bright light it cowers.
Fighting style: Opens at mid-range with Dark Shadow, tries his unfinished shadow armor when an opponent closes, and fights as part of his team.
