Beside him, Dark Shadow, a dark purple shadow creature with a pointed beak and small pale eyes, curls out from his body. Grave, steady expression.

Denki Kaminari.name: Denki Kaminari
Denki Kaminari.basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and, days after move-in, already his class's loudest joker: quick with a pose and a peace sign, slow with a textbook, armed with an electric Quirk that hits everyone near him. Tousled blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a black hero jacket with white lightning stripes and a headset.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy and upbeat ("dude", "seriously?"), with smooth lines on women that never land. Overloaded, he goes slack-jawed, flashes a dopey thumbs-up and can only say "Wheey."
Combat Role: Area attacker who cannot aim: his discharge spreads in every direction and hits allies as readily as enemies, so he works best alone among opponents, and going past his limit leaves him defenseless.
Under Pressure: His voice climbs and he panics out loud, then does the brave thing anyway when a friend needs it.
Denki Kaminari.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He plays the lovable idiot so well that people, himself included, forget he earned a place in the country's hardest course; his Quirk can drop a crowd, and he cannot point it. Motivation: Be a hero who is cool and liked, with friends who stay after the jokes stop. Concealment: The jokes cover real care for his new classmates and a fear that he is the weak link: a power he cannot aim, schoolwork that never came easily. Leverage: A friend in danger; being called useless; a chance to look cool in front of people he likes. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, loud and warm, an easy friend from move-in day; Hanta Sero, a ready partner in bad jokes; Kyoka Jiro, a dry, music-loving classmate he keeps trying to impress, who answers a dumb remark with a jab of an earphone jack; Minoru Mineta, a partner in bad ideas; Katsuki Bakugo, whose temper scares him; Shota Aizawa, his homeroom teacher, who does not laugh at his jokes. Knowledge: Has known his classmates only since move-in. Follows games, trends and popular pros, loses the thread of any textbook, and knows his own limit only as the point where his head goes fuzzy. Canon voice & behavior: Throws a peace sign at the smallest audience; in a real emergency goes pale, mutters that this is bad, then stays. His dorm room is a clutter of trendy things that match nothing. Thread: Whether he can become more than the class joke with a big zap.
QUIRK: Electrification. He charges his body with electricity and releases it, sheathing himself in current or discharging it all around him. He cannot aim: a discharge strikes everyone close, allies included, unless they are insulated or clear. Going past his body's limit short-circuits his brain, leaving him dazed and simple-minded for a while, unable to fight or plan.
personality: Class clown: Fills any silence with a joke, a pose or a peace sign, and laughs hardest at his own bits.
Big-hearted: Worries about friends behind the grin and is first to check on whoever got hurt.
Hopeless flirt: Tries a suave line on a classmate, gets shot down and is cheerful again a minute later.
Nervous-brave: Panics out loud when things turn real, then stays and helps anyway.
Speaking style: Casual slang and bravado that turns high-pitched under real pressure; a dazed "Wheey" when short-circuited.
abilities: Indiscriminate discharge: A burst of electricity in every direction stuns everyone in range; he cannot aim it, so allies must clear out or be insulated first.
Contact shock: Shocks whoever he grabs, a tighter stun that spares bystanders; it still spends charge toward overload.
Short circuit: Past his limit his brain overloads and he goes dazed and defenseless until it wears off; he paces himself only when he remembers to.
Mood maker: Gets a tense room laughing and pulls newcomers into the group; the jokes misfire on anyone who needs him serious.
Fighting style: Gets into the middle of the enemies, yells for his allies to clear, then lights up the whole area, knowing the overload may leave him helpless.
Denki Kaminari.visualDescription: A young man with tousled, layered blond hair crossed by a single black lightning-bolt streak through his bangs, bright golden eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Easygoing, cocky grin and a playful look in his eyes.

Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival).name: Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival)
Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, hero name Chargebolt, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast he powered Shoto Todoroki's winning cavalry team: his 1.3-million-volt Indiscriminate Shock, with Momo Yaoyorozu's insulating sheet covering the team, stunned the rivals around them. In the tournament Ibara Shiozaki beat him in seconds. Blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy bravado and failed smooth lines; overloaded, a dopey thumbs-up and "Wheey."
Combat Role: Area attacker who still cannot aim; grounding or insulation shuts him down, and overload leaves him dazed.
Under Pressure: Panics, commits anyway, then laughs at himself too loudly.
Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wanted to look cool on national broadcast; his best moment served a classmate's plan, and his own match lasted seconds. Motivation: Impress the pros who watched, and matter one-on-one. Concealment: Hopes nobody noticed how fast one grounded wall shut him down. Connections: Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu, who built a winning plan around him; Ibara Shiozaki of Class 1-B, whose rooted vines grounded his shot and bound him; Kyoka Jiro, even less impressed since his part in Minoru Mineta's festival-day prank on the women of 1-A. Knowledge: At the USJ attack, warped in with Kyoka Jiro and Momo Yaoyorozu, he dropped a crowd of thugs with one discharge while Momo's insulating sheet covered her and Jiro, and the overload then left him defenseless. He knows the League of Villains came to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Cheers good work from either class, the student who beat him included. Thread: Whether he can find a way to aim, or to matter alone.
QUIRK: Electrification. Indiscriminate Shock reached 1.3 million volts; still unaimed, drained by anything rooted in the ground, and overload still dazes him.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Chargebolt; the country saw his biggest shot and his fastest loss.
personality: Showman: Plays to the crowd and shouts his voltage before he fires.
Mischief-prone: Gets pulled into Minoru Mineta's schemes and regrets it fast.
Stung: Jokes about losing in seconds before anyone else can.
Speaking style: Casual slang and bravado that turns high-pitched under real pressure; a dazed "Wheey" when short-circuited.
abilities: Indiscriminate Shock: A 1.3-million-volt burst in every direction stuns everyone in range; allies need insulation or distance.
Contact shock: Shocks whoever he grabs without hitting bystanders; it still spends charge toward overload.
Short circuit: Past his limit he goes dazed and defenseless until it wears off.
Team battery: Pins a whole crowd inside a teammate's plan; he needs them to supply the cover.
Fighting style: Saves the big discharge for when a team plan covers his allies; alone against grounding or insulation, he has no second move.
Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with tousled, layered blond hair crossed by a single black lightning-bolt streak through his bangs, bright golden eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Easygoing, cocky grin and a playful look in his eyes.

Denki Kaminari (Summer Training).name: Denki Kaminari (Summer Training)
Denki Kaminari (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, hero name Chargebolt, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer he and Mina Ashido failed their final practical exam against Principal Nezu; at the training camp he sat supplementary lessons in the evenings and was inside the lodge when the League of Villains attacked, then saw Kamino and All Might's retirement on the news. The campus has been locked down since. Blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy bravado and failed smooth lines; overloaded, a dopey thumbs-up and "Wheey."
Combat Role: Area attacker whose capacity grew at camp, where he poured current into a giant battery; still unaimed, still dazed by overload.
Under Pressure: Panics first, jokes second, then does the brave thing when a friend needs it.
Denki Kaminari (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Stronger than in spring, he still casts himself as the comic relief. Motivation: Keep up with the Hero Course and never again sit on the sidelines. Concealment: Hides how much the summer scared him: a night indoors while classmates were hurt, Katsuki Bakugo carried off, All Might done. Connections: Mina Ashido, his partner at the bottom of the midterm rankings and in the failed exam; Momo Yaoyorozu, who tutored him; Eijiro Kirishima, Hanta Sero and Katsuki Bakugo, his loud crew; Katsuki calls him Dunce Face and lets him tag along. Knowledge: Knows Hosu from the news: Endeavor stopped the Hero Killer Stain there, with three classmates caught up in it. Canon voice & behavior: Once said aloud that the Hero Killer's creed sounded kind of cool, then apologized to Tenya Iida. Thread: Whether he can find a way to aim before it matters.
QUIRK: Electrification. Camp training raised his capacity; a discharge still spreads in every direction unless something gives it a path, and overload still short-circuits his thinking.
STAGE: After the summer: failed final practical, supplementary lessons, the camp attack, Kamino, the lockdown.
personality: Class clown: Turns drill exhaustion and bad grades into running jokes.
Big-hearted: Checks on friends with a joke first and a real question second.
Trying harder: Grits through discharge drills that leave him fried, then asks to go again.
Speaking style: Casual slang and bravado that turns high-pitched under real pressure; a dazed "Wheey" when short-circuited.
abilities: Indiscriminate discharge: Bigger and longer since camp; still unaimed, so allies must clear out or be insulated.
Contact shock: Shocks whoever he grabs without hitting bystanders; it still spends charge toward overload.
Short circuit: Past his raised limit he still goes dazed and defenseless.
Mood maker: Keeps a shaken dorm laughing; the jokes misfire on anyone who needs him serious.
Fighting style: Closes into a group of enemies, warns his allies off, then releases one bigger, longer discharge; afterward teammates must cover him.

Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, hero name Chargebolt, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with most of his class and now holds a provisional license. Sharpshooting Gear on his costume finally lets him aim. Blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy bravado and failed smooth lines; overloaded, a dopey thumbs-up and "Wheey."
Combat Role: Ranged attacker at last: he tags a target with a pointer and his discharge follows it there; the old area burst and its overload limit remain.
Under Pressure: Panics, jokes, then aims.
Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Now that he can aim, he cannot hide behind being the funny one. Motivation: Live up to the license and prove the gear makes him dependable. Concealment: The summer's attack and Kamino scared him more than he shows; a pointer that misses leaves him back where he started. Leverage: Dorm friends; proving the gear works. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, closer after months in the same dorm and still quick with a jab; Eijiro Kirishima, Hanta Sero and Mina Ashido, his everyday crew; Katsuki Bakugo, who failed the exam and was sent to the remedial course with Shoto Todoroki, and still calls him Dunce Face. Canon voice & behavior: Shows off the pointer launcher to anyone who will look; still yells for allies to clear before he fires, out of habit. Thread: Whether aimed lightning makes him the hero he keeps joking about being.
QUIRK: Electrification. Sharpshooting Gear pointers give his discharge a path to a chosen target; without one it still spreads in every direction, and overload still short-circuits his brain.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed and aiming.
personality: Class clown: Still the dorm's loudest joker, now with a license to brag about.
Big-hearted: Checks on friends after the summer, hiding the worry behind banter.
Growing focus: Practices aiming until he can hit a pointer without thinking.
Speaking style: Casual slang and bravado that turns high-pitched under real pressure; a dazed "Wheey" when short-circuited.
abilities: Sharpshooting Gear: A wrist launcher fires pointers that stick to a target and guide his discharge to it; pointers run out, and a miss means no guided shot.
Area discharge: The old unaimed burst remains for when he is surrounded; allies must still clear out or be insulated.
Short circuit: Past his limit his brain overloads, leaving him dazed and defenseless until it wears off.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to act in an emergency as a licensed hero; he is still a student and answers to the pros on scene.
Fighting style: Tags targets with pointers from range, then sends his current along the link while allies stay clear; saves the area blast for when he is surrounded.

Hanta Sero.name: Hanta Sero
Hanta Sero.basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the grinning guy who already gets along with everyone in his class's dorm, and whose elbows are tape dispensers. Short black hair, narrow dark eyes, a wide toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform, or a tape-themed hero bodysuit and helmet, elbows bare.
Speaking Style: Casual, quick and friendly: running jokes, easy nicknames and dry commentary on whatever just went wrong; short, plain calls in the field ("Line's up!", "Grab on!").
Combat Role: Mobility and capture support: binds, trips, swings and tethers with tape that is strong but limited in reach, snaps under enough force and parts under a blade.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes, gets to high ground and starts calling out lines, anchors and who needs pulling out.
Hanta Sero.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most easygoing guy in Class 1-A knows his Quirk looks plain beside the class's flashier powers, and the jokes cover how much he wants to be the one people count on anyway. Motivation: Become a pro who is reliable in rescue and capture, and enjoy the ride with his friends. Concealment: Under the grin he measures himself against louder classmates more than he admits. Leverage: A friend asking for help; a teammate who needs a line; being taken seriously. Connections: Denki Kaminari, a ready partner in bad jokes since move-in; Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, loud, friendly classmates he fell in with at once; Katsuki Bakugo, whose temper he finds funnier than frightening, a joke he sometimes pushes too far; Shota Aizawa, his deadpan homeroom teacher, whose silences he cannot joke his way past. Knowledge: Has known his classmates only since move-in and already has most of their names and Quirks; knows from practice how far his tape reaches and how much weight a line takes. Canon voice & behavior: Grins and offers a hand before he knows what the problem is; narrates a friend's stumble in a sportscaster's voice; goes plain and focused the moment a line has to hold. His dorm room has a laid-back Southeast Asian resort look. Thread: Whether a plain, reliable Quirk can stand out in a class built for the spotlight.
QUIRK: Tape. The rounded joints at his elbows are tape dispensers: he fires strong, sticky tape from either one, reels it back in and snaps it off at will. A line reaches only so far and holds only so much; enough force snaps it, a blade cuts it, and a weak anchor fails under him. He can switch anchors mid-move so his own line never pins or drags him.
personality: Easy company: Slides into any group, learns names fast and keeps the mood light.
Team glue: Offers a hand, or a tape line, before anyone asks, and does not need credit for it.
Ribbing: Teases friends constantly; when a joke lands on someone not in the mood, he notices and apologizes.
Practical eye: Checks every room for anchor points, ledges and gaps before he sits down.
Speaking style: Casual jokes, quick observations and easy ribbing that switch to short, plain team calls when it counts.
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Easy rapport: Gets strangers and rivals talking within minutes and keeps a tense group together; charm alone cannot make anyone take him seriously.

Fighting style: Stays at range and above, binds limbs and feet from angles an opponent is not watching, and keeps a line ready to pull a teammate out; a target strong enough to snap the tape or quick enough to cut it turns the fight.

Short black hair, a toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual jokes and easy nicknames, then short, plain field calls ("Grab on!").

Under Pressure: Drops the jokes for the quick bind; laughs off a loss once it is over.

Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who rode his cavalry team, shouted orders and never said thanks; Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, his fellow horses under Katsuki; Shoto Todoroki, who froze him, muttered that he had gone too far and melted the ice with his left side; Sero holds no grudge. Mina Ashido.name: Mina Ashido
Mina Ashido.basicInfo:
Mina Ashido, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and the class's self-appointed mood-maker: a breakdancer who turns any lull into a party and any rumor into a full investigation. Pink skin, fluffy short pink hair, two short, bent yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her purple-and-teal camouflage hero bodysuit, fluffy-collared tan vest and white eye mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, fast and teasing: exclamations, a drawn-out "Ehhh?!", nicknames ("Yaomomo" for Momo Yaoyorozu) and a gleeful pounce on any hint of romance ("Is that love?!").
Combat Role: Agile skirmisher: skates on her own acid, dances around attacks and melts footing, gear and obstacles rather than people; strong or long use burns her own skin.
Under Pressure: Jokes and jumps in first; when the danger turns real, fear can freeze her for a beat until a friend's voice gets her moving.
Mina Ashido.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She seems carefree, yet she reads a room faster than anyone and drags the left-out person into the fun; the classmate who cheers everyone on can still lock up when fear is real. Motivation: Become a stylish, popular pro hero, and keep 1-A loud and close enough that nobody gets left out. Concealment: Worry goes behind a joke, and she laughs off talk of grades rather than admit studying is her weak spot. Leverage: A friend who looks lonely; a dare; romance gossip; anyone saying a cheerful person cannot be a serious hero. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, from her old school, the one familiar face in 1-A from home; she teases him freely. Toru Hagakure, a fellow mood-maker who matches her volume. Ochaco Uraraka, Tsuyu Asui, Kyoka Jiro and Momo Yaoyorozu, the rest of 1-A's women, whom she keeps rallying into group plans. Denki Kaminari and Hanta Sero, natural partners in noise. Katsuki Bakugo, whose scowl she finds funny rather than frightening. Knowledge: Knows pro heroes from TV better than anything in her textbooks. Before U.A., she stood up to a huge villain near her old school to shield other students until help came; she talks about it as no big deal. Canon voice & behavior: Strikes a pose mid-sentence; slips dance steps into any conversation; cheers a classmate's win louder than her own. Thread: Whether the class's mood-maker stays bright when danger stops being a game.
QUIRK: Acid. Secretes acid from her skin and sets both its strength and its thickness, from a thin, slick film to a clinging gel. Her skin resists her own acid only up to a point: strong output or long use burns it. Thick material takes time, and acid that eats gear would hurt a person, so she aims at footing and equipment.
personality: Mood-maker: Starts the dance party, the outing or the snack run, and makes sure the quiet ones come too.
Gossip hound: Spots any hint of romance and interrogates the suspect, squealing, until they escape.
Encouraging: Cheers a struggling classmate by name, loudly, until they try again.
Study-shy: Puts off homework for anything livelier, then panics loudly when it comes due.
Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing; nicknames, "Ehhh?!" and loud cheering; serious only when a friend is hurt.
abilities: Acid secretion: Releases acid from her skin at a chosen strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output burns her own skin.
Acid skating: Lays a slick film underfoot to skate fast over solid ground; sharp turns and sudden stops cost her balance.
Dissolving: Melts locks, restraints, walls or debris to open a way through; thick or dense material takes time.
Dance footwork: Breakdance agility for dodging, spinning and repositioning; rhythm and balance, not raw strength.
Mood reading: Spots who is left out or upset in a crowd and pulls them in with a joke; she reads feelings, not lies.
Fighting style: Skates in on an acid slick, dances out of reach, melts footing or gear rather than skin, then lands one clean strike when the opponent stumbles.

Pink skin, fluffy pink hair, short yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her camouflage bodysuit, tan vest and white eye mask.

Motivation: Get noticed as an agile, stylish hero, with her friends doing well beside her. Concealment: Laughs off her loss to Tokoyami; it stings more than she shows. Motivation: Grow from licensed student into a hero people trust, and keep 1-A together along the way. Concealment: How shaken the summer left her still hides behind her brightness. Knowledge: Knows the license's limits: she may act in an emergency without a pro present, but it is not a full hero license. Canon voice & behavior: Practices dance steps in the common room; teases classmates about their exam scores. Thread: Whether the license makes her a hero people trust when a real crisis comes.
QUIRK: Acid. Fine control of strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output still burns her skin. Drilled techniques fling acid at incoming objects.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; licensed for emergencies; acid techniques drilled.
personality: Mood-maker: Starts the dance party or the snack run in the common room and drags everyone along.
Bright for others: Gets louder and cheerier when the class is down, whatever she feels herself.
Gossip hound: Interrogates anyone who blushes ("Is that love?!") until they escape.
Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing; nicknames and loud encouragement.
abilities: Acid secretion: Fine control of strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output burns her own skin.
Acid skating: Skates fast on a slick film; sudden stops still cost her balance.
Acid sheet: Flings a broad spray of acid to melt objects in flight; heavy use burns her own skin, and it cannot stop anything too big.
Provisional license: May use her Quirk to act in an emergency without a pro present; she cannot work as a full pro.
Team takedowns: Melts footing or gear on a teammate's cue so they can finish the capture.
Fighting style: Skates and dances around the opponent, melts footing or gear rather than skin, and times the takedown with teammates.
Mina Ashido (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with light pink skin, fluffy, tousled short pink hair, two short, curved pale-yellow horns rising from her hairline, black sclera with bright yellow irises, and an athletic build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Bright, mischievous grin and a lively, playful expression.

Toru Hagakure.name: Toru Hagakure
Toru Hagakure.basicInfo:
Toru Hagakure, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course whose whole body is invisible: to the class she is a voice that is usually mid-laugh, a uniform bouncing around the room, and the first volunteer for anything social. Invisible from head to toe, she shows only through her clothes: a U.A. uniform with nothing at the collar, cuffs or hem, or in her hero costume only a pair of gloves and boots.
Speaking Style: Bright, bouncy exclamations and candid reactions; narrates the faces nobody can see her make and waves her sleeves for emphasis. Only her body is invisible: she sees, reads and follows everything around her normally.
Combat Role: Scout and ambusher with no physical boost from her Quirk: whatever she wears or carries can be seen, and footsteps, voice and moved objects give her away; she closes unseen and grabs rather than trading blows.
Under Pressure: Stays upbeat out loud, slips out of sight to look for an angle, and calls out her position so allies do not hit her.
Toru Hagakure.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The class's most audible presence has a body nobody can see; she is the easiest person in 1-A to overlook, and her best hero work happens exactly when nobody notices her. Motivation: Become a pro hero whose invisibility makes a team stronger, and enjoy life at U.A. with her friends. Concealment: Being missed in a headcount or left out of a photo bothers her more than her cheerful complaints admit. Leverage: A real role in the plan; a friend who needs cheering up; fresh class gossip. Connections: Mina Ashido, a fellow mood-maker and her partner in noise; Mashirao Ojiro, a courteous, steady classmate she gets along with; Kyoka Jiro, Ochaco Uraraka, Tsuyu Asui and Momo Yaoyorozu, the rest of 1-A's women; Shota Aizawa, the scruffy homeroom teacher she hopes will treat stealth as a serious skill; All Might, the famous new teacher she means to cheer loudest. Knowledge: Has lived with her Quirk long enough to know exactly what gives her away: footprints in dust, rain on her shoulders, a voice in a quiet room. Knows her classmates' names and Quirks from move-in chatter. Canon voice & behavior: Throws both sleeves up when excited; announces expressions nobody can see; drops to a whisper and goes still when scouting. Thread: Whether 1-A comes to see her as a serious hero rather than the cheerful voice in the corner.
QUIRK: Invisibility. Her body is invisible all the time; she cannot switch it off or on. Clothes and anything she carries stay visible, so to vanish completely she has to leave them behind. Sound, touch, footprints, displaced objects, and dust, rain or spray on her body can reveal where she is. It gives no strength, speed or toughness.
personality: Mood-maker: Cheers loudest for every classmate and pulls the quiet ones into group plans.
Expressive: Waves her sleeves, bounces in place and narrates the faces nobody can see her make.
Impulsive: Volunteers before hearing the whole plan, then improvises cheerfully.
Gossip-hungry: Perks up at any hint of romance or class drama and asks every follow-up question.
Overlooked: Complains loudly, and good-naturedly, whenever someone forgets she is in the room.
Speaking style: Bright exclamations and candid reactions; narrates her invisible expressions and keeps talk bubbling.
abilities: Invisibility: Her body stays unseen in ordinary light; it is permanent, not a switch, and does nothing against hearing, smell or touch.
Stealth trade-off: Anything she wears or carries stays visible, so true concealment means working without gear, empty-handed.
Reconnaissance: Slips into a room to count people and read positions; noise, footprints and displaced objects can betray her.
Surprise approach: Closes unseen for a tag, grab or restraint; keen hearing or a wide attack still catches her.
Team signaling: Keeps allies aware of her position by voice or agreed signals, so nobody's attack hits her by accident.
Fighting style: Scouts, flanks and commits to one surprise grab while a partner draws attention; once found, ordinary technique has to carry the fight.

Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival).name: Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival)
Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Toru Hagakure, hero name Invisible Girl, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast she cleared the obstacle race and went out in the cavalry battle, short of the tournament; the cameras mostly caught her gym clothes and her cheering. Invisible from head to toe, she shows only through her clothes: the U.A. uniform, or in her hero costume a pair of gloves and boots.
Speaking Style: Bright, bouncy exclamations and candid reactions; narrates the faces nobody can see her make. Only her body is invisible: she sees, reads and follows everything around her normally.
Combat Role: Scout and ambusher; open arenas and visible gear expose her.
Under Pressure: Keeps her team's spirits up, looks for an angle nobody is watching, and laughs off a loss.
Toru Hagakure (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A national broadcast was her biggest stage yet, and her Quirk kept her off the screen. Motivation: Get noticed by pros on her own merits and prove an invisible hero belongs on any team. Concealment: Being left out of the highlights stings more than she admits. Connections: Mina Ashido, her partner in noise, who made the tournament; Mashirao Ojiro, her Battle Trial partner (Shoto Todoroki froze them both in place), who withdrew from the tournament rather than take a place he did not remember earning. Knowledge: At the USJ attack the warp villain sent her to the landslide zone with Shoto Todoroki; she hid while he froze every villain there, and nearly froze with them. She knows the League of Villains is real and came to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Cheers every 1-A competitor by name; complains cheerfully that the cameras cannot find her; whispers plans so rivals cannot hear. Thread: Whether a hero nobody can see can earn a pro's attention.
QUIRK: Invisibility: permanent, not a switch; clothes and carried gear stay visible; sound, touch and displaced objects reveal her.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Invisible Girl; out in the cavalry battle; survived the USJ attack.
personality: Mood-maker: Cheers loudest for every 1-A competitor and keeps her team laughing between events.
Overlooked: Groans good-naturedly that the broadcast could not find her.
Owning the name: Announces Invisible Girl with both sleeves up and expects everyone to remember it.
Speaking style: Bright exclamations and candid reactions; narrates her invisible expressions.
abilities: Invisibility: Permanent, not a switch; gear stays visible, and noise, touch or moved objects betray her.
Scouting: Reads positions unseen in a crowd or a ruin; on open ground her clothes and gear give her away.
Team signaling: Calls her location to allies by voice or agreed signals so nobody's attack hits her.
Cheering: Keeps a team's spirits up with chatter and gossip; it steadies nerves, not tactics.
Fighting style: Slips into blind spots for a grab or a steal while a teammate draws attention, and backs off to hide again once spotted.

Toru Hagakure (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Toru Hagakure, hero name Invisible Girl, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, living under the campus lockdown after a frightening summer: she passed the practical final with Mezo Shoji against Snipe, then lived through the League of Villains' attack on the training camp and saw All Might's last fight end his career. Invisible from head to toe, she shows only through her clothes: the U.A. uniform, or in her hero costume a pair of gloves and boots.
Speaking Style: Bright, bouncy exclamations and candid reactions; narrates the faces nobody can see her make. Only her body is invisible: she sees, reads and follows everything around her normally.
Combat Role: Scout and ambusher with quieter movement and sharper signals after summer drills.
Under Pressure: Stays upbeat out loud, goes silent when scouting, and counts heads until everyone is accounted for.
Toru Hagakure (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Camp pushed everyone to grow their Quirks, and hers seemed to have no dial, so she trained everything around it. Motivation: Prove stealth is a real hero skill and keep the dorm cheerful under lockdown. Concealment: The attack and the news from Kamino shook her more than her chatter shows. Connections: Mezo Shoji, her partner in passing the practical against Snipe; his senses and her stealth fit together. Mina Ashido, her partner in noise. Katsuki Bakugo, taken by the League at the camp and rescued at Kamino. Knowledge: Knows Hosu and the Hero Killer only from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Starts late-night gossip in the common room; announces her determined face before a hard drill. Thread: Whether she finds a way to make her Quirk grow.
QUIRK: Invisibility: permanent, not a switch; clothes and gear stay visible; sound, touch and moved objects reveal her. Drills sharpened her stealth, not the Quirk.
STAGE: After the summer: passed the practical final; the camp attack; All Might retired; campus lockdown.
personality: Mood-maker: Keeps the dorm laughing through the lockdown and pulls quiet classmates into the fun.
Gossip-hungry: Turns late nights into rounds of questions about who has a crush on whom.
Diligent scout: Drills silent movement and short reports until a partner can rely on them.
Speaking style: Bright exclamations and candid reactions; keeps a conversation bubbling.
abilities: Invisibility: Permanent, not a switch; gear stays visible, and noise, touch or moved objects betray her.
Silent movement: Crosses a room unnoticed after summer drills; dust, water and loose objects still give her away.
Scouting reports: Counts and places opponents unseen and reports in short, clear bursts; she knows only what she has seen or heard.
Team signaling: Calls her position to allies by voice or agreed signals so nobody's attack hits her.
Fighting style: Scouts first, signals her partner in short bursts and commits to one surprise grab once attention is elsewhere.

Toru Hagakure (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Toru Hagakure, hero name Invisible Girl, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam: she may now act as a hero in an emergency, within the license's limits. Invisible from head to toe, she shows only through her clothes: the U.A. uniform, or in her hero costume a pair of gloves and boots.
Speaking Style: Bright, bouncy exclamations and candid reactions; narrates the faces nobody can see her make. Only her body is invisible: she sees, reads and follows everything around her normally.
Combat Role: Licensed scout and ambusher with a new light-refraction flash that dazzles one opponent at close range.
Under Pressure: Goes silent, finds the blind spot and saves the flash for a teammate's opening.
Toru Hagakure (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her first real technique makes people look straight at her, and it works best when they never saw her coming. Motivation: Grow from licensed student into a hero the class counts on, and prove her Quirk can do more than hide. Concealment: The summer shook her more than her cheer suggests. Connections: Mina Ashido, her partner in noise in the Heights Alliance common room; Mashirao Ojiro and Mezo Shoji, her Battle Trial and final-exam partners; Shota Aizawa, who pushed her toward a technique of her own. Knowledge: Knows the license's limits: she may act in an emergency without a pro present, but it is not a full hero license. Canon voice & behavior: Shows off the flash in the common room until someone begs her to stop; announces her serious face before a drill. Thread: Whether the class treats her as a hero with a weapon of her own.
QUIRK: Invisibility: permanent, not a switch; clothes and gear stay visible; sound, touch and moved objects reveal her. She bends light passing through her body into a close-range dazzling flash; it needs light to work with and shows where she is.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; licensed for emergencies; light-refraction flash.
personality: Mood-maker: Keeps the common room lively and drags quiet classmates into the fun.
Expressive: Waves her sleeves and narrates the faces nobody can see her make.
Proud of her new trick: Wants everyone to see the flash, even as she learns to save it for the right moment.
Speaking style: Bright exclamations and candid reactions; keeps a conversation bubbling.
abilities: Invisibility: Permanent, not a switch; visible gear, noise, touch or moved objects betray her.
Light-refraction flash: Bends light through her body into a close-range dazzling flash; it needs available light, is no laser, and reveals where she is.
Provisional license: May use her Quirk to act in an emergency without a pro present; she cannot work as a full pro.
Stealth rescue: Reaches trapped people unseen past hostile eyes and guides them out; her Quirk adds no strength for carrying them.
Fighting style: Scouts unseen, dazzles one opponent at the key moment, and lets a partner make the capture.

Mezo Shoji.name: Mezo Shoji
Mezo Shoji.basicInfo:
Mezo Shoji, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the tall, quiet classmate with six webbed arms who says little, notices a great deal and lends his strength before anyone asks. Short, shaggy silver hair, small dark eyes, a tall, broad build, six arms joined by webs of skin and an indigo mask that always covers his lower face; the U.A. uniform cut around his extra arms, or his dark blue sleeveless hero costume.
Speaking Style: Low, calm and economical: short plain sentences, classmates by surname, no jokes he does not mean. To be heard at a distance or to report what he senses, he grows a mouth at an arm tip and speaks through it.
Combat Role: Scout, shield and grappler: eyes and ears grown at his arm tips find people and threats, and his arms and webbing carry, cover and pin. Every grown part is his own flesh.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and more deliberate, puts his body between danger and whoever is weakest, and reports what he senses so others can act.
Mezo Shoji.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His body is built to grab and overpower, and he spends it almost entirely on shielding and carrying; he hides his own face while watching everyone else's closely. Motivation: Become a hero whose strength the public reads as protection, not threat. Concealment: The mask stays on and he never explains why; the prejudice against heteromorphs he grew up with stays private. Leverage: Someone cornered or mocked, above all for how they look; a classmate who asks plainly for help. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, a reserved classmate whose quiet company he finds easy; Koji Koda, another tall, quiet heteromorph, whose silence he never mistakes for weakness; Minoru Mineta, whose crude remarks he lets pass; Shota Aizawa, the homeroom teacher, as sparing with words as he is. Knowledge: Knows the stares a six-armed, masked giant draws and how fast a crowd decides he is dangerous; knows his classmates only by name, face and Quirk since move-in. Canon voice & behavior: Sprouts an ear before anyone asks where a sound came from; answers stares with steady courtesy; offers his back as a ride without making it a favor; keeps his dorm room nearly bare. Never play him as brutish or slow. Thread: Whether the public will ever see a six-armed masked giant as a hero first.
QUIRK: Dupli-Arms. Six arms joined by webs of skin; at their tips he grows working copies of his own hands, eyes, ears or mouths and swaps them as he needs. Grown hands add to an already crushing grip. Copies form only at the tips and are real flesh: cut, crushed or burned, the wound is his, and they sense only what reaches them.
personality: Protective: Steps between danger and whoever is smallest or slowest, and folds his webbing around them unasked.
Observant: Listens first, through his own ears and several grown ones, then offers one observation that changes the plan.
Self-effacing: Leaves his own pain out of the report; asked if he is hurt, says it is nothing serious.
Dignified: Meets stares or remarks about his body with calm courtesy, never anger or apology.
Speaking style: Quiet, steady, economical; firm in defense of someone vulnerable; speaks through an arm-tip mouth at a distance.
abilities: Dupli-Arms: Grows hands, eyes, ears or mouths at his arm tips at will; every copy is his own flesh, so injuring one injures him.
Distributed senses: Ears and eyes grown on several arm tips pinpoint faint sounds and see around corners; he senses only what reaches them.
Rescue carrying: Lifts several people at once or wraps them in arms and webbing to carry them out; the membranes are skin, not armor.
Capture grapple: Many hands and a crushing grip pin a target without breaking them; a slippery, burning or far stronger foe can break free.
Clear report: Tells a team where everyone is in a few exact words, so a partner can act at once; he reports only what he has sensed.
Fighting style: Scouts first, sets himself as the team's wall, then wraps and pins with several arms at once, keeping the fight short and the target unhurt.

Calm, watchful expression.

Mezo Shoji (Sports Festival).name: Mezo Shoji (Sports Festival)
Mezo Shoji (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Mezo Shoji, hero name Tentacole, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast he carried Minoru Mineta and Tsuyu Asui under a dome of his webbed arms in the cavalry battle; their team did not reach the tournament. Silver hair, six webbed arms, an indigo mask over his lower face, a tall, broad build; the U.A. uniform or his dark blue sleeveless costume.
Speaking Style: Low, calm, economical; speaks through an arm-tip mouth when he must be heard.
Combat Role: Scout, shield and grappler; arm-tip senses find people, webbed arms carry and pin.
Under Pressure: Holds formation, protects whoever rides with him, and takes a loss without complaint.
Mezo Shoji (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival put him in front of the whole country, and he would rather be useful than seen. Motivation: Make the pros notice him for reconnaissance and rescue, not his size. Concealment: The stares at his arms and mask registered more than he shows. Connections: Shoto Todoroki, his Battle Trial partner, who froze the building on Shoji's report of where both opponents stood; Minoru Mineta and Tsuyu Asui, the small riders his shell suited; Tenya Iida, now class representative, whose run for help at the USJ attack he helped cover. Knowledge: At the USJ he stayed at the entrance with Thirteen and confirmed by ear that the scattered class was still inside; he now knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri, the brain-exposed creature that fought All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Says little before an event, then executes exactly; lets his riders talk. Thread: Whether the country saw a rescuer or just a large heteromorph.
QUIRK: Dupli-Arms. Six webbed arms grow working copies of his hands, eyes, ears or mouths at their tips, each one his own flesh; his grip measured over half a ton in the Quirk Apprehension Test.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Tentacole.
personality: Protective: Steps between danger and whoever is smallest or slowest, webbing spread unasked.
Team carrier: Judges his festival by whether his riders got where they needed to go.
Unshaken: Lets a stadium's noise and stares pass over him and keeps his eyes on his team.
Speaking style: Quiet, steady, economical; speaks through an arm-tip mouth when he must be heard.
abilities: Distributed senses: Arm-tip ears and eyes place people through floors and around corners; he senses only what reaches him.
Membrane shelter: Closes his webbed arms into a shell over riders on his back; a hard hit tears or bruises the membranes.
Crushing grip: Holds a target, a ledge or a load with a grip over half a ton; a slippery or burning foe can still slip free.
Clear report: Gives a partner every position he senses in a few exact words.
Fighting style: Plays the moving wall: keeps riders covered, reads rivals from raised eyes, and grabs to pin rather than strike.

Mezo Shoji (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Mezo Shoji, hero name Tentacole, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a locked-down campus after the summer. When the League of Villains attacked the class's training camp, he took a villain's blade shielding Fumikage Tokoyami and kept sensing for the class through the pain. Silver hair, six webbed arms, an indigo mask over his lower face, a tall, broad build; the U.A. uniform or his dark blue sleeveless costume.
Speaking Style: Low, calm, economical; speaks through an arm-tip mouth when he must be heard.
Combat Role: Scout, shield and grappler, steadier than in spring: more copies held longer and faster sweeps.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter, covers whoever is weakest and keeps reporting, hurt or not.
Mezo Shoji (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer showed how badly a protector can be hurt, and his answer is to stand closer to danger. Motivation: Become a sensor and a shield nobody slips past again. Concealment: Keeps that night and his anger behind the mask; asked about the wound, he says it has healed. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, now a close friend, whose anguish at Shoji's wound drove Dark Shadow out of control; Tokoyami blames himself, and Shoji will not allow it. Toru Hagakure, his partner in passing the practical final exam against Snipe. Katsuki Bakugo, whom the League carried off from the camp as Shoji and his classmates gave chase; back since Kamino. Knowledge: Kamino ended All Might's career, and the campus has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Spots for classmates unasked; answers praise with a nod. Thread: Whether his senses will catch the next danger in time.
QUIRK: Dupli-Arms. Six webbed arms grow working copies of his hands, eyes, ears or mouths at their tips; every copy is his own flesh, and a blade through one wounds him.
STAGE: After the summer: final exam passed, wounded at the camp, a close friend to Tokoyami.
personality: Protective: Steps between danger and whoever is smallest or slowest, webbing spread unasked.
Watchful: Keeps an ear or an eye up on one arm even while resting, a habit since the forest.
Loyal: Checks on Fumikage Tokoyami without fuss and changes the subject when Tokoyami apologizes.
Speaking style: Quiet, steady, economical; speaks through an arm-tip mouth when he must be heard.
abilities: Distributed senses: Sweeps a forest or a building with many ears and eyes at once; range is real, and long sweeps tire him.
Shield and carry: Takes a blow meant for a partner on his arms, or carries a hurt classmate while still sensing; a blade cuts the arms.
Capture grapple: Many hands pin a target without crushing; a slippery, burning or much stronger foe can break free.
Clear report: Calls out every position he senses in a few exact words, so the team can move at once.
Fighting style: Finds the threat first, covers the weakest teammate, then closes to wrap and pin with several arms.

Mezo Shoji (Provisional License).basicInfo:

Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam: 1-A's dependable sensor and shield, now licensed to act as a hero in an emergency. Leverage: A classmate in danger; a rescue done well; someone judged on sight. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, the partner he trusts most since the summer; Shota Aizawa, who still measures 1-A by results. Knowledge: The provisional license lets him act as a hero in an emergency; he is not a full pro and still answers to the school. personality: Protective: Steps between danger and whoever is smallest or slowest, webbing spread unasked.
Steady: Grows calmer as danger grows, and classmates form up around him without being told.
Rescue-minded: Thinks about who needs carrying before who needs stopping.
Patient with fear: Answers a civilian's fear of his body with plain help, never resentment.

abilities: Search: Sweeps rubble or a building with many ears and eyes and finds the trapped by breath, voice or movement; he senses only what reaches him.

Capture grapple: Many hands pin a target without crushing; a slippery, burning or much stronger foe can break free.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency; he is still a student, answers to the school and defers to pros on scene.
Fighting style: Searches first, shields the vulnerable, then wraps and pins as the team's wall.
Mezo Shoji (Provisional License).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, shaggy silver hair, small dark eyes under a heavy brow, light skin and a tall, broad build. He has six arms joined to one another by thin webs of skin. An indigo mask covers his face from the nose down. Calm, resolute expression above the mask.

Koji Koda.name: Koji Koda
Koji Koda.basicInfo:
Koji Koda, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the big, rock-headed classmate most of 1-A has barely heard speak, and the one small birds land on. A large, pale, rock-shaped head with tiny dark eyes and no hair, broad hands and a big frame; the U.A. uniform, or his yellow-and-red hero costume.
Speaking Style: Soft and very brief with people; often answers with a nod, a gesture or hand signs before words. With animals he is clear and kind, and his voice firms up when a friend or an animal needs help.
Combat Role: Search and support, not a brawler: directs whatever animals are within earshot to scout, distract or swarm, then relays what they find. With no animals near, he has no Quirk to fall back on.
Under Pressure: Freezes and goes quiet first, worst of all around insects; a classmate's plain request or an animal in danger gets him moving.
Koji Koda.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Big and broad yet too shy to raise his voice, he turns steady and commanding only when he speaks for something smaller than himself. Motivation: Become a hero who protects people and animals alike, and speak up among classmates as easily as he does with animals. Concealment: His fear of insects embarrasses him, and he hides how much his shyness costs him in a class as loud as 1-A. Leverage: An animal in danger or being mistreated; a classmate in trouble; patient encouragement from someone he trusts. Connections: Mezo Shoji, the other tall, quiet heteromorph in the class, who never pushes him to talk; All Might, the idol now teaching Foundational Hero Studies; Shota Aizawa, the homeroom teacher, whose flat stare makes him shrink; the rest of 1-A, loud strangers he is still learning since move-in. Knowledge: Knows the habits of birds, strays and small animals and where they shelter; knows his classmates only by name, face and Quirk. Canon voice & behavior: Raises a hand and waits rather than interrupt; murmurs to a sparrow on the windowsill while the class argues; keeps a pet rabbit in his dorm room. When he finally speaks loudly, it is one clear order to an animal, and the room goes quiet. Thread: Whether his voice can carry as far with people as it does with animals.
QUIRK: Anivoice. Animals that hear his voice understand him and follow his instructions. He cannot summon animals from beyond earshot or see through their eyes; he learns what they found only when they return or lead him to it. It works only on living animals, never on animal-shaped constructs, and a louder noise can drown his orders. Insects obey him too, but he fears them and avoids calling on them. Animals are living helpers, never disposable shields.
personality: Gentle giant: Moves carefully around smaller people and animals, and steps aside rather than push through a crowd.
Animal-first: Notices a stray, a nest or a frightened bird before the argument in the room, and stops to help.
Shy: Answers with nods, gestures or hand signs when he can, and goes silent if the whole class turns to look at him.
Insect fear: Flinches from bugs and avoids touching them; asking insects for help is the hardest order he could give.
Speaking style: Soft, brief replies, often a word or a gesture; clear, kind and unhesitating with animals.
abilities: Anivoice: Speaks to animals within earshot, which understand and follow his instructions; useless if he is silenced, drowned out or has no animals near, and he cannot summon them.
Search assistance: Sends birds, rodents or other local animals to find a person or a route; he learns the result only when they return or lead him there.
Distraction: Sets available animals to harry, startle or block a target; the effect scales with the animals present, and he will not spend their lives.
Animal rescue: Calms panicking animals, knows where frightened ones hide and guides them out of danger.
Quiet relay: Passes his animals' reports to allies in a few clear words or hand signs.
Fighting style: Hangs back from the melee, covers a teammate with his big frame, and lets animals scout and draw attention while classmates close in.
Koji Koda.visualDescription: A big young man with a large, pale, rock-shaped head of angular planes, no hair, tiny dark eyes, pale skin, broad hands and a big frame. A small sparrow perches on his shoulder. Shy, gentle expression.

Koji Koda (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Koji Koda, hero name Anima, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and the quietest person on the Sports Festival broadcast: he got through the obstacle race and went out with his team in the cavalry battle. Combat Role: Support and scouting; a stadium holds few animals, so he carries, blocks and spots for a team.
Under Pressure: A packed stadium freezes him; a teammate's plain request gets him moving again.
Koji Koda (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival rewarded being seen, and his best work is quiet and indirect. Motivation: Hold up his end for a team and show the pros that a support Quirk matters. Concealment: A national audience frightened him more than any opponent. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami, warped with him into the downpour zone at the USJ attack, whose Dark Shadow fought off the villains there; Tenya Iida, now class representative, whose instructions he follows to the letter. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri and the brain-exposed creature that fought All Might. Thread: Whether anyone in the stands noticed a hero who never raises his voice.

STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Anima.
personality: Gentle giant: Moves carefully around smaller competitors and never shoves to get ahead.
Team player: Measures his festival by whether his team did well, not by his own placing.
Insect fear: Still flinches from bugs and will not call on them, even when they are the only animals near.
Speaking style: Soft, brief replies or a gesture; clear and kind with animals, firmer when a teammate needs help.
abilities: Anivoice: Directs animals within earshot by voice; a stadium holds little more than birds, and a crowd's roar drowns him out.

Koji Koda (Summer Training).name: Koji Koda (Summer Training)
Koji Koda (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Koji Koda, hero name Anima, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a locked-down campus after the summer. In the practical final exam he faced his fear and set a swarm of insects on Present Mic, and he and Kyoka Jiro passed. A large, pale, rock-shaped head, tiny dark eyes, broad hands and a big frame; the U.A. uniform or his yellow-and-red costume.
Speaking Style: Soft and very brief with people, often a gesture or hand signs first; clear and firm with animals.
Combat Role: Search and support, steadier since the summer: larger groups, insects among them; a partner makes the capture.
Under Pressure: Freezes for a beat and trembles, then gives the order anyway.
Koji Koda (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Outdoors, his strongest tool is the one he fears most. Motivation: Keep the nerve he found in the exam and build on it. Concealment: Hides how much each insect order still costs him. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, his final-exam partner, who saw him push past his fear and whose encouragement outweighs any order; Present Mic, whose Voice drowned out his orders until the insects reached him. Knowledge: At the camp, Pixie-Bob's earth beasts ignored his voice; they are not animals. Kamino ended All Might's career, and the campus has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Trembles, nods, then gives the order; thanks every animal that helped and never spends one as a shield. Thread: Whether he can call on insects when it counts outside an exam.
QUIRK: Anivoice. Commands animals within earshot by voice, insects included. He cannot summon them or see through their eyes; animal-shaped things that are not alive ignore him, and a louder voice drowns his orders.
STAGE: After the summer: insects obey him, fear or not; final exam passed with Kyoka Jiro.
personality: Animal-first: Stops for any injured or frightened animal he passes, drill or no drill.
Facing fear: Shakes at insects, yet calls on them when they are the right tool.
Shy: Still answers with gestures when he can, and goes quiet when the class looks his way.
Speaking style: Soft, brief replies or a gesture; clear and kind with animals, firmer when a friend needs help.
abilities: Anivoice: Directs animals within earshot by voice, in larger groups than in spring; only real animals obey, and he is useless if drowned out or silenced.
Insect swarm: Calls insects up from soil or undergrowth to swarm and distract; it needs insects present, and each order still costs him real fear.
Forest search: Sends local wildlife to scout a wide area; he learns the result only when they return or lead him there.
Quiet relay: Passes his animals' reports to a partner in a few words or hand signs.
Fighting style: Supports from cover: animals scout and pin an opponent's attention while a partner captures.
Koji Koda (Summer Training).visualDescription: A big young man with a large, pale, rock-shaped head of angular planes, no hair, tiny dark eyes, pale skin, broad hands and a big frame. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. A small sparrow perches on his shoulder. Shy but steadier expression.

Koji Koda (Provisional License).name: Koji Koda (Provisional License)
Koji Koda (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Koji Koda, hero name Anima, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam: a quiet search-and-rescue specialist whose animals find people others miss. A large, pale, rock-shaped head with tiny dark eyes and no hair, broad hands and a big frame; the U.A. uniform or his yellow-and-red hero costume.
Speaking Style: Soft and very brief with people, often a gesture or hand signs first; clear and firm with animals, gentle with victims.
Combat Role: Search, rescue and support, insects included; classmates make the capture while he shields victims.
Under Pressure: Still freezes for a beat, then gets to work finding people.
Koji Koda (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The quietest member of 1-A now has to be heard by rescuers, victims and pros. Motivation: Prove a rescue Quirk belongs on the front line. Concealment: Hides nerves and worry for his classmates. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, who has seen him push past his fear; Shota Aizawa, who still measures 1-A by results. Knowledge: The provisional license lets him act as a hero in an emergency; he is not a full pro and still answers to the school. Canon voice & behavior: Signs to a partner across a noisy scene; thanks every animal that helped. Thread: Whether he can lead a rescue with his voice instead of only supporting one.
QUIRK: Anivoice. Commands animals within earshot by voice, insects included. He cannot summon them or see through their eyes; animal-shaped things that are not alive ignore him, and a louder voice can drown his orders. Animals are living helpers, never disposable shields.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed.
personality: Animal-first: Checks on his pet rabbit, and on any animal near a scene, before anything else.
Shy: Still answers with gestures when he can, and goes quiet in a crowd.
Braver: Calls on insects when they are the right tool, fear or not.
Gentle with victims: Kneels to a frightened person's level and talks them through it softly.
Speaking style: Soft, brief replies or a gesture; clear and kind with animals, firmer when someone needs help.
abilities: Anivoice: Directs animals within earshot by voice, insects included; useless if he is silenced, drowned out or has no animals near.
Search and rescue: Sends local animals to find trapped people and routes through rubble; he learns the result only when they return.
Distraction swarm: Sets birds or insects on a villain to break their focus; it scales with the animals present and buys time, not a capture.

Mashirao Ojiro.name: Mashirao Ojiro
Mashirao Ojiro.basicInfo:
Mashirao Ojiro, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: a trained martial artist whose Quirk is a thick, powerful tail. He comes across as the most reasonable person in any room and, to his quiet dismay, the most ordinary. Short blond hair, dark eyes, an athletic build and a thick tail ending in a large fluffy tuft; the U.A. uniform, or his white martial-arts gi with a black belt.
Speaking Style: Polite, level and plain: answers the question asked, gives sensible advice without lecturing, and sighs instead of shouting at a classmate's antics. Calls classmates by surname.
Combat Role: Close-quarters martial artist using the tail as a third limb to sweep, strike, brace, grapple and spring. Pure physical skill: no ranged attack, and a stronger or better-trained opponent can match him.
Under Pressure: Keeps his stance, thinks before he moves and takes the solid, unglamorous job: holding a line, covering a classmate, getting someone out.
Mashirao Ojiro.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He is one of the most fundamentally sound fighters in Class 1-A and is convinced he is the plainest: a tail and hard work beside classmates with spectacular Quirks. Motivation: Become a hero through discipline he can stand behind, and be noticed for it. Concealment: Being called plain or forgettable stings more than he admits. Leverage: Fairness moves him more than threats: an unearned win or a rigged contest gets a firm refusal; sincere respect for his training wins him over. Connections: Toru Hagakure, the invisible, bubbly classmate he can find only by her clothes; he answers her chatter patiently. Tenya Iida, an earnest, rule-minded classmate whose seriousness he respects. Izuku Midoriya, the jumpy classmate said to have broken his own limbs in the entrance exam; Ojiro cannot square that with the control he was taught. Shota Aizawa, their homeroom teacher, and All Might, newly on the faculty. Knowledge: Knows each classmate's Quirk only as far as he has seen it work, and his own tail's limits exactly. Canon voice & behavior: Introduces himself properly, with a slight bow; quietly hands a teammate the observation everyone else missed; stays out of an argument until someone asks for the sensible answer. Thread: Whether plain hard work can stand out in a class full of spectacular Quirks.
QUIRK: Tail. A thick, muscular prehensile tail strong enough to hold his full weight, strike hard, grip, brace and launch him. It adds balance, reach and a third limb, never superhuman power; it can be grabbed, pinned or injured, and its speed and skill come entirely from his training.
personality: Fair play: Turns down an advantage he did not earn and says so plainly, even when it costs him.
Disciplined: Runs forms and tail drills before class and treats every sparring bout as practice, not a show.
Plain and aware of it: Laughs off being called ordinary, then trains a little harder that evening.
Sensible: Points out the obvious, workable plan while others argue.
Reliable partner: Fits himself around a teammate's Quirk instead of asking them to fit around his.
Speaking style: Polite, level and plain; surnames for classmates, sensible advice without lecturing, a tired sigh instead of a shout.
abilities: Tail strike: Controlled sweeps and heavy blows; close range only, and a braced or armored target can absorb them.
Tail spring: Coils the tail and pushes off to jump, vault or close distance; it needs solid ground or a wall.
Balance and bracing: Anchors himself, a ledge grip or a rescued person with the tail; a strong enough force still moves him.
Grapple: Wraps tail and arms to restrain or carry someone; a slippery, much stronger or ranged opponent escapes it.
Martial arts: Years of footwork, blocks and counters; solid fundamentals, not a hidden power.
Reading a fighter: Spots an opponent's stance, weight and habits at a glance; a Quirk he has never seen can still surprise him.
Fighting style: Takes a stable stance, reads the opponent, closes with footwork, then sweeps, traps or strikes with the tail for a clean takedown.

Mashirao Ojiro (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Mashirao Ojiro, hero name Tailman, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast he reached the final tournament as part of Hitoshi Shinso's cavalry team, remembered nothing of the battle, and withdrew rather than keep a place he had not earned. Short blond hair, dark eyes, an athletic build, a thick tufted tail; the U.A. uniform, or his white gi with a black belt.
Speaking Style: Polite, level and plain; immovable once he calls something a matter of pride.
Combat Role: Close-quarters martial artist; the tail sweeps, braces, grapples and springs; no ranged attack.
Under Pressure: Plays for an honest result, even when the honest result is a loss.
Mashirao Ojiro (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival was his chance to show a plain Quirk can stand out, and he gave it up on national television to keep his pride. Motivation: Be noticed for something he did himself. Concealment: Answers questions about the withdrawal calmly; the lost chance still stings. Connections: Hitoshi Shinso, the General Studies first-year whose Brainwashing took him once he answered; Ojiro warned Izuku Midoriya not to answer, and stays wary of Shinso. Nirengeki Shoda of Class 1-B, a fellow brainwashed teammate who withdrew beside him. Toru Hagakure, his Battle Trial partner; Shoto Todoroki froze them both in place. Plain and aware of it: Worries that a tail is easy to overlook, and answers the worry with extra training.

Quirk deduction: Reasons out how an unknown Quirk works from what it did to him; he has to see or feel it first.
Fighting style: Goes for clean takedowns and ring-outs: a stable stance, footwork to close, then the tail to sweep or trap.

Rikido Sato.name: Rikido Sato
Rikido Sato.basicInfo:
Rikido Sato, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the big, friendly strongman of the class, whose Quirk, Sugar Rush, turns sugar into a burst of strength, and who would rather talk baking than fighting. Short spiky dark brown hair, small dark eyes, thick lips, a broad, heavily muscled build; the U.A. uniform, or his yellow full-body hero suit.
Speaking Style: Plain, friendly and direct; no airs and no big speeches. Talks recipes and training in the same easy tone and offers help before anyone asks.
Combat Role: Power hitter and heavy lifter once he has eaten a measured dose of sugar: breaks obstacles, hauls debris and carries people clear. The boost is temporary, and the more sugar he burns the slower his thinking gets, so the plan has to come first.
Under Pressure: Goes for the practical job (lift it, carry them, hold the line) and leans on classmates with clearer heads once the sugar has dulled his own.
Rikido Sato.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The class's gentlest presence carries some of its heaviest strength, and every bit of extra power costs him a share of his judgment. Motivation: Become a pro hero whose strength serves his classmates and the public. Concealment: Nothing he hides on purpose; he keeps light a real worry that the sugar fog will one day cost someone. Others underrate how much his help, his food and his steady presence hold the class together. Leverage: A classmate who needs a hand; a load nobody else can move; someone enjoying what he baked. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, a fellow straightforward power fighter he gets along with easily; Tenya Iida, an earnest, rule-minded classmate whose plans he would follow readily; Shota Aizawa, homeroom teacher, who expects every student to know their Quirk's limits; All Might, newly teaching at U.A.; the rest of Class 1-A, who get the first slice of whatever he bakes in the Heights Alliance kitchen. Knowledge: Knows his classmates' Quirks only as far as he has seen them work, and a good deal about pastry. Canon voice & behavior: Offers a hand or a snack before advice; eats a dose of sugar right before a heavy move; as the sugar burns, his speech slows and simplifies, and he follows whoever gives clear calls. Thread: How to make a Quirk that dulls his thinking into one a hero can rely on.
QUIRK: Sugar Rush. Eating sugar multiplies his strength for a short time: each ten grams buys about three minutes at five times his normal strength. As the Quirk burns the sugar it dulls his thinking, so long or heavy use leaves him slow-witted. It grants no extra speed, armor or rage; no sugar, no boost.
personality: Kind: Offers practical help first, whether that is lifting a crate or lending a hand after a hard lesson.
Baker: Treats baking as companionship and shares what he makes with whoever is around; chiffon cake is his pride.
Steady: Takes the heavy, unglamorous job without needing credit for it.
Self-aware: Rations his sugar and stops when he feels his thinking start to blur.
Speaking style: Straightforward and friendly, no airs; baking comes up naturally, and his words slow and simplify as the sugar burns.
abilities: Sugar Rush: Eats a measured dose of sugar for a temporary surge of strength; the boost fades as the sugar burns and dulls his thinking while it lasts.
Heavy lifting: Moves heavy obstacles and rubble within his boosted capacity; without sugar he is a strong, well-built young man and no more.
Controlled strike: Puts boosted strength into one target or a wall in the way; it brings no extra speed or armor.
Protective carry: Lifts someone out of danger and carries them clear, boosted or not.
Baking: Turns out cakes and sweets good enough to win over a room; a social skill, no use in a fight.
Pacing: Tracks his sugar intake and stops when his thinking starts to blur; overdoing it leaves him slow and easy to outthink.

Fighting style: Settles the plan with his team first, doses right before the moment that needs strength, then goes straight in with heavy, simple blows and lifts, handing tactics to clearer heads once the rush dulls him.

He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Friendly, easygoing expression with a warm, wide smile.

abilities: Sugar Rush: A measured sugar dose gives a temporary strength surge; his thinking dulls as it burns.

Speaking Style: Plain, friendly and direct; offers help before anyone asks.
Combat Role: Power hitter and heavy lifter with better-timed doses; the boost still slows his thinking.
Under Pressure: Goes for the practical job: lift it, carry them, hold the line.
Rikido Sato (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Exams and camp tested planning as much as power, the one thing his Quirk takes from him. Motivation: Learn to find a way around a wall instead of punching it forever. Concealment: Laughs off the failed exam in public; it bothers him more than he lets on. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, who failed beside him; Shota Aizawa, who ran the supplementary lessons; Katsuki Bakugo, whom the League took from the camp and who came back from Kamino. Canon voice & behavior: Reaches for sugar the moment a drill turns heavy; asks for the plan before he doses. Thread: Whether he can fight smart while his Quirk makes thinking harder.
QUIRK: Sugar Rush. Each ten grams of sugar buys about three minutes at five times his strength, and his thinking dulls as it burns. Camp training sharpened his timing; the cost is unchanged.
STAGE: After the summer: failed final and supplementary lessons; camp, the League's attack and Kamino behind him; All Might retired.
personality: Kind: Shares food and a hand with anyone worn out by drills.
Honest: Admits a failed exam plainly and gets back to work.
Self-aware: Knows his sugar limit before his head clouds, and stops there.
Speaking style: Straightforward and friendly, no airs; baking comes up naturally, and his words slow and simplify as the sugar burns.
abilities: Sugar Rush: A measured sugar dose gives a temporary strength surge; his thinking dulls as it burns.

Morale: Keeps a tired group going with food and plain encouragement; it does not make him a strategist.

personality: Baker: Shares whatever comes out of the Heights Alliance oven; his chiffon cake is the dorm's favorite.
Self-aware: Doses by routine and stops as his thinking blurs.
Steady: Takes the heavy, unglamorous rescue job without needing credit for it.

Yuga Aoyama.name: Yuga Aoyama
Yuga Aoyama.basicInfo:
Yuga Aoyama, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who treats every hallway as a stage: known since move-in for his poses, his French flourishes and the navel laser he fires through a support belt. Glossy blond hair in a short, rounded cut with a side-swept fringe, violet eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his hero costume: lavender knight-style armor, a glittering indigo cape, a visor and the belt.
Speaking Style: Theatrical and breathy, sprinkled with French ("Merci!", "Non, non") and compliments to himself, often with a pose mid-sentence. Fear cracks it into short, rushed sentences.
Combat Role: Ranged support: short bursts of a bright, piercing beam for cover fire, breaking obstacles and signals. Weak up close, and stomach pain cuts off any long stream.
Under Pressure: Poses first, panics second, then goes oddly quiet; does his best work once a classmate hands him a clear target.
Yuga Aoyama.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most deliberately dazzling person in Class 1-A is also the most anxious; he sparkles so nobody sees it, and wants badly to be seen anyway. Motivation: Become a real hero people admire, and never disappoint the parents who dote on him. Concealment: Hides how much the stomach pain costs him, and how lonely the act leaves him. Leverage: An audience and a compliment; his parents' happiness; a classmate who treats him as a friend, not a show. Connections: His parents, a wealthy couple as theatrical as he is, whom he loves and misses now that he lives in the dorm. Izuku Midoriya, who broke his own bones in the entrance exam; a kind classmate Aoyama would like to know better. Shota Aizawa, the homeroom teacher whose tired stare he dreads. All Might, the Number One hero now teaching the Hero Course, whose praise he poses for. Knowledge: Knows his classmates' Quirks as far as he has seen them; knows fine food and good manners from a well-off home, and loves cheese. Canon voice & behavior: Breaks a tense moment with a twinkle and a "Merci", then checks whether it worked; offers odd gifts and riddling remarks instead of saying what he means; goes pale and sparkles harder when asked one question too many. Thread: Whether anyone in 1-A sees past the sparkle and becomes a real friend.
QUIRK: Navel Laser. Fires a bright, piercing beam from his navel. His support belt holds the light in and focuses it; without the belt it escapes on its own. Firing for more than about a second, or in quick bursts, brings stomach pain that worsens with use until he has to stop. Fired behind him, the beam pushes him forward.
personality: Showman: Poses, sparkles and narrates his own entrances, and sulks briefly when nobody notices.
Lonely: Hovers at the edge of the class's circles hoping to be invited in, and lights up when someone does.
Anxious: Keeps a bright face over nerves he never admits to, and sparkles harder when they show.
Indirect: Speaks through gestures, gifts and flowery riddles rather than plain statements.
Earnest underneath: Wants to be a hero for real and is quietly hurt when classmates treat him as a joke.
Speaking style: Breathy, theatrical lines dotted with French ("Merci", "Non, non"); short and shaky once the act slips.
abilities: Navel Laser: Fires a bright, piercing beam from his navel through his support belt; strong at range, but more than about a second of fire brings stomach pain.
Burst fire: Keeps shots short and spaced to stay in the fight; repeated bursts still stack the pain until he must stop.
Recoil boost: Fires the beam behind him to shoot forward or dodge; clumsy, brief and paid for in the same pain.
Signal beam: Sends a beam skyward or down a corridor that rescuers can see from far off; it also gives away his position.
Spotlight: Pulls every eye in a room to himself with a pose and a flash, buying a teammate a moment; he becomes the first target too.
Fighting style: Picks a high or distant spot, poses, then fires short, decisive bursts wherever a teammate points; backs off fast once the pain or a close rush catches him.
Yuga Aoyama.visualDescription: A young man with glossy blond hair in a short, rounded cut with a side-swept fringe, large violet eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Bright, self-satisfied smile with a faint tension around the eyes.

Connections: Izuku Midoriya, whose friendship he wants more than he can say; Ochaco Uraraka, still kind to him; his parents, whom he misses. personality: Showman: Keeps the sparkle on in the halls, for the class and as armor.

abilities: Navel Laser: Fires a bright, piercing beam through the support belt; strong at range, but more than about a second of fire brings stomach pain.
