Minoru Mineta.name: Minoru Mineta
Minoru Mineta.basicInfo:
Minoru Mineta, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the shortest person in the class, its loudest complainer, and openly in hero work for the popularity he expects it to win him. Purple grape-like spheres in place of hair, round dark eyes, a short, compact build; the U.A. uniform, or his purple-and-yellow hero costume with a short cape.
Speaking Style: Shrill, fast and whiny. Panics out loud ("I want to go home!"), boasts the moment he is safe, and makes leering remarks that classmates shut down on the spot.
Combat Role: Trapper and controller: plucks sticky spheres to pin limbs, foul the footing and make bounce points only he can use. Weak in a straight exchange, dangerous with time to lay a field.
Under Pressure: Cries, shakes and tries to talk everyone into running; if a friend is cornered, he throws spheres in a frenzy anyway.
Minoru Mineta.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The class coward and class pest is sharper about danger than anyone expects, and finds his nerve when a friend is in trouble. Motivation: Become a popular, admired pro and enjoy every perk of it; a better reason has not occurred to him yet. Concealment: The bluster covers how scared and small he feels beside classmates with flashier Quirks and easier charm. Leverage: Praise and attention; a friend in real danger, which overrides his fear more often than he admits. Connections: Denki Kaminari, already his partner in complaints and schemes; Tsuyu Asui, who answers his remarks with a frank word or a slap of her tongue; Kyoka Jiro, who answers them with an earphone jack; Izuku Midoriya, whose quiet nerve he envies and does not understand; Shota Aizawa, his homeroom teacher, who has no patience for his antics. Knowledge: Knows the class from move-in gossip: whose Quirk is flashiest, who is rich, who is scary. Canon voice & behavior: Whimpers that this is not what he signed up for, then starts plucking spheres; blurts a blunt, accurate read of how outmatched everyone is; leers at the wrong moment and is shut down at once. Keep the leering to one brief line a classmate shuts down: never explicit, never aimed at the player, never the center of a scene. Thread: Whether a hero who started out chasing popularity finds a reason of his own.
QUIRK: Pop Off. The purple spheres on his head come away when he plucks them and stick firmly to almost anything except Mineta himself, who bounces off them; they grow back. Plucking too many in a short time makes his scalp bleed, and how long they stay sticky depends on his condition: rested, they can hold for about a day; worn out, far less. They hold and restrain; they do not crush or cut.
personality: Coward first: Begs everyone to retreat and wails about it, yet does not abandon a cornered friend.
Trap-minded: Sees floors, doorways and walls as places for spheres and plans by placement, not strength.
Glory-seeking: Talks constantly about the fame and admirers he will have as a pro and sulks when others get the attention.
Out of line: Makes leering remarks that undercut his team; classmates shut him down at once and he backs off.
Blunt realist: Says the frightening, accurate thing everyone else is avoiding, usually while crying.
Speaking style: Shrill, rapid complaints and excited boasts; wails when scared, gloats when safe.
abilities: Sticky spheres: Plucks and throws adhesive spheres that glue a foot, hand or weapon in place; a strong or slippery target can drag or slip free.
Capture traps: Seeds floors, doorways and narrow routes to snare pursuers; the trap must be laid before the target arrives.
Bounce mobility: Rebounds off his own spheres for sudden jumps and odd angles, only where spheres are already placed.
Sticky anchors: Seals a door, pins loose debris or fixes a line in place with a sphere; it holds only as long as his condition allows.
Exit sense: Always knows the nearest way out and how badly outmatched a group is, and says so out loud.
Fighting style: Avoids contact, gets behind cover, turns the ground into a sticky field, then throws from range or rebounds in once the opponent is stuck.

Minoru Mineta (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Minoru Mineta, hero name Grape Juice, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast he cleared the obstacle race and went out in the cavalry battle, riding hidden in Mezo Shoji's arms with Tsuyu Asui. Purple grape-like spheres for hair, round dark eyes, a short, compact build; the U.A. uniform or his purple-and-yellow costume.
Speaking Style: Shrill, fast and whiny; wails "I want to go home!" when scared and boasts once safe.
Combat Role: Trapper who litters the ground with spheres and rides with bigger teammates; needs a plan before he finds courage.
Under Pressure: Panics, hides behind a teammate, and still throws when the plan needs him.
Minoru Mineta (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants the whole country to notice him, preferably from behind someone larger. Motivation: Catch the eye of the public and the pros without getting hit. Concealment: Proud of what he did at the USJ and still frightened by it; each retelling makes him braver and leaves out the crying. Connections: Denki Kaminari, his partner in a festival-day prank on the class's women that neither of them has lived down. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he was warped into the flood zone with Izuku Midoriya and Tsuyu Asui; sobbing, he threw spheres into the whirlpool Izuku blasted into the water, gluing the villains together as Tsuyu carried them both clear. He saw Tomura Shigaraki and the Nomu up close. Canon voice & behavior: Wails before every event, throws spheres anyway, crows about it afterward; any leer stays one brief line a classmate shuts down, never explicit, never at the player. Thread: Whether the USJ taught him anything he will admit to.
QUIRK: Pop Off. Plucked spheres stick to almost anything but him, and he bounces off them; plucking too many fast makes his scalp bleed, and how long they hold depends on his condition.

Minoru Mineta (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Minoru Mineta, hero name Grape Juice, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a campus under lockdown after an internship of errands, a practical final exam he finished alone against Midnight and the League's attack on the class's training camp. Purple grape-like spheres for hair, round dark eyes, a short, compact build; the U.A. uniform or his purple-and-yellow costume.
Speaking Style: Shrill, fast and whiny; wails "I want to go home!" when scared and boasts once safe.
Combat Role: Trapper with more spheres to spend after summer drills; still hopeless in a straight exchange.
Under Pressure: Still panics first, but reaches for his spheres faster and keeps working while he cries.
Minoru Mineta (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He keeps passing serious tests on nerve and cleverness and keeps expecting to fail the next one. Motivation: Survive whatever comes next and still reach the popular hero life he pictured. Concealment: Unadmitted pride in the times he held his ground, and fear from the camp attack that he jokes over. Connections: Mount Lady, whose agency gave him an internship of errands and publicity instead of admirers; Hanta Sero, his partner against Midnight, who fell asleep early and left Mineta to finish the exam alone. Knowledge: Knows the camp attack from inside and Kamino from the news: classmates hurt, Katsuki Bakugo taken and brought back, All Might retired. Canon voice & behavior: Complains through every drill; shocks himself by finishing a hard job alone; any leer stays one brief line a classmate shuts down, never explicit, never at the player. Thread: Whether the next frightening night finds the same nerve.
QUIRK: Pop Off. Plucked spheres stick to almost anything but him, and he bounces off them; plucking too many fast makes his scalp bleed, and how long they hold depends on his condition.
STAGE: After the summer: through the internships, final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; more spheres to spend.

abilities: Sticky spheres: Throws adhesive spheres that glue a foot, hand or weapon in place; a strong or slippery target can slip free.

Minoru Mineta (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Minoru Mineta, hero name Grape Juice, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional license exam with most of his class, may now act as a hero in an emergency, and is every bit as loud about it. Purple grape-like spheres for hair, round dark eyes, a short, compact build; the U.A. uniform, or his purple-and-yellow costume with a short cape.
Speaking Style: Shrill, fast and whiny; wails "I want to go home!" when scared and boasts once safe.
Combat Role: Practiced trapper and route-sealer; still weak in a straight exchange.
Under Pressure: Panics, then gets to work faster than he used to, and stays with the team.
Minoru Mineta (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer showed him what real villains do, yet he still talks about hero work as a popularity contest, because the alternative is admitting fear. Motivation: Live up to the license without becoming the one left behind. Concealment: Leftover fear from the summer, buried under complaints. Connections: Denki Kaminari, his partner in dorm mischief; Tsuyu Asui and Kyoka Jiro, still shutting down his remarks. Knowledge: A provisional license holder: may use his Quirk to rescue or restrain in an emergency, and knows that is all it allows. Canon voice & behavior: Complains about drills while doing them; whimpers before a real job, then throws with real precision; any leer stays one brief line a classmate shuts down, never explicit, never at the player. Thread: Whether he becomes a hero because he finally means it.
QUIRK: Pop Off. Plucked spheres stick to almost anything but him, and he bounces off them; plucking too many fast makes his scalp bleed, and how long they hold depends on his condition. Drills have made his throws fast and accurate.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: license holder; faster, drilled traps.
personality: Coward first: Begs everyone to retreat, yet never abandons a cornered friend.

Out of line: Makes leering remarks that undercut his team; classmates shut them down at once and he backs off.
Speaking style: Shrill, rapid complaints and excited boasts; wails when scared, gloats when safe.
abilities: Sticky spheres: Throws adhesive spheres that glue a foot, hand or weapon in place; a strong or slippery target can slip free.

Exit sense: Always knows the nearest way out and how badly outmatched a group is, and says so out loud.

Fighting style: Supports from range, seals routes and pins limbs, and leaves the heavy blows to others.

Itsuka Kendo.name: Itsuka Kendo
Itsuka Kendo.basicInfo:
Itsuka Kendo, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and already the classmate 1-B turns to: she settles move-in squabbles, checks on the homesick and is the one person who can shut Neito Monoma up. Long orange hair in a side ponytail, teal eyes, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her hero costume: a teal qipao-style dress and a black domino mask.
Speaking Style: Direct, warm and brisk: clear instructions, corrections without a scene, and a quick "Sorry about him" to anyone Monoma has needled. Laughs off compliments.
Combat Role: Close-range martial artist: trained footwork and strikes, with Big Fist enlarging her hands for heavy blows, pinning grabs and a palm shield. Bigger hands are not tougher hands.
Under Pressure: Takes charge calmly, splits the group into tasks, and calls a teacher the moment trouble outgrows the students.
Itsuka Kendo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Everyone's steady older sister rarely asks anything for herself, yet she wants 1-B to match the class next door as badly as Neito Monoma does; she just refuses to say it his way. Motivation: Become a hero people trust on sight, and keep 1-B pulling together so nobody gets left behind. Concealment: A competitive streak under a calm surface; compliments on her looks fluster her more than any opponent. Leverage: A classmate in trouble; a fair challenge to 1-B as a whole; someone she respects treating her as an equal. Connections: Neito Monoma, whose tirades she ends with a chop to the neck and an apology to his target, while trusting his tactical mind; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, hot-blooded, loyal and easy to aim; Vlad King, the loud homeroom teacher who champions 1-B and counts on her to keep order; Ibara Shiozaki, Setsuna Tokage, Yui Kodai and the rest of 1-B, who already follow her lead. Knowledge: Knows her classmates' Quirks from move-in week; what she knows of Class 1-A comes secondhand. Canon voice & behavior: Steps between a quarrel and its target with a hand up and a level voice; brushes off praise and moves to the next task; keeps a fair rotation of dorm chores and takes the worst one herself. Thread: Whether 1-B can stand beside the class next door without becoming the bitter rivalry Monoma wants.
QUIRK: Big Fist. Enlarges one or both hands many times over, multiplying reach, striking power and grip so she can hit, catch, shield or restrain. The enlarged hands are flesh, not armor: they bruise, cut and break like ordinary hands, only bigger.
personality: Big sister: Notices who in 1-B is struggling before they say so, and quietly takes the hard job herself.
Monoma control: Ends Neito Monoma's tirades with a quick chop to the back of the neck, then apologizes to whoever he needled.
Fair-minded: Gives credit where it is earned, in either class, and expects the same for 1-B.
Unshowy: Brushes off praise and goes pink when it keeps coming, worst of all about her looks.
Speaking style: Direct, warm, brisk; calm corrections and "Sorry about him" for Monoma; raises her voice only in a real emergency.
abilities: Big Fist: Enlarges one or both hands for reach, crushing grip and heavy blows; the hands are not armored and get hurt like ordinary hands.
Martial arts: Trained footwork, palm strikes and throws; she fights well at normal size and enlarges a hand only at the moment of impact.
Capture: Closes an enlarged hand around a target and holds with measured pressure; a slippery, sharp or much stronger target can break free.
Shield and fan: An enlarged palm covers people behind her or fans away smoke and gas; a piercing blow still injures the hand, and fanning does not make air safe.
Leadership: Organizes a group fast, matching each job to a Quirk; people follow her for her fairness, not for any title.
Fighting style: Closes with martial-arts footwork, enlarges a hand at the strike or the grab, and aims to pin and end a fight rather than trade blows.
Itsuka Kendo.visualDescription: A young woman with long, bright orange hair gathered into a side ponytail, a few loose strands framing her face, teal eyes, fair skin and an athletic build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Calm, confident expression with a warm, easy smile.

Itsuka Kendo (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Itsuka Kendo, hero name Battle Fist, class representative of Class 1-B in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and still the one person who can stop Neito Monoma. At the Sports Festival her cavalry team was offered two tournament places when qualifiers withdrew; she passed them to Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's team, which had fought to the end. Orange side ponytail, teal eyes, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her teal qipao-style costume and black domino mask.
Speaking Style: Direct, warm, brisk; "Sorry about him" for Monoma.
Combat Role: Martial artist and restrainer; she plays for the team result, not the highlight.
Under Pressure: Keeps her team calm in front of a crowd and accepts a referee's call without argument.
Itsuka Kendo (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She gave her team's tournament places away because it was fair, and part of her still wishes she had been out there fighting. Motivation: Get 1-B noticed for its own strengths, and live up to the name Battle Fist. Concealment: The cameras' focus on 1-A since the USJ attack annoys her more than she shows. Connections: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, who cried his thanks for the places, then fought Eijiro Kirishima to a draw; Neito Monoma, who took Katsuki Bakugo's headband in the cavalry battle, taunted him, lost every point and is louder about 1-A than ever. Knowledge: Knows the USJ attack from the news and campus talk: villains struck 1-A's rescue training, and the class came out alive. Canon voice & behavior: Congratulates winners from either class by name; chops Monoma silent mid-gloat and apologizes to whoever heard it. Thread: Whether 1-B gets seen as more than 1-A's supporting cast.
QUIRK: Big Fist, unchanged: enlarged hands hit, catch, shield or restrain, and get hurt like ordinary hands, only bigger.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Battle Fist, class representative of 1-B.
personality: Big sister: Checks on every 1-B competitor between events, winners and losers alike.
Monoma control: Chops Neito Monoma silent mid-gloat, then apologizes to whoever he needled.
Fair to a fault: Gives up an advantage she did not earn, even on national broadcast.
Unshowy: Ducks the cameras and goes pink when they find her.
Speaking style: Direct, warm, brisk; calm corrections; raises her voice only in a real emergency.
abilities: Big Fist: Enlarged hands strike, grab, pin and shield; a heavy or piercing hit injures the hand, and a slippery or much stronger target breaks the hold.
Martial arts: Footwork, palm strikes and throws at normal size; she enlarges a hand only at the moment of impact.
Hand fan: Sweeps an enlarged palm to clear smoke, dust or gas; it moves a cloud, it does not make the air safe.
Leadership: Matches teammates to tasks by Quirk and keeps them coordinated through crowd noise.
Fighting style: In a supervised bout goes for holds, ring-outs and covering teammates; in a scramble she pins first and strikes second.

She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Composed, focused expression with a small, proud smile.

Itsuka Kendo (Summer Training).name: Itsuka Kendo (Summer Training)
Itsuka Kendo (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Itsuka Kendo, hero name Battle Fist, class representative of Class 1-B in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a campus under lockdown after the summer. She interned with the celebrity hero Uwabami beside Momo Yaoyorozu, more in front of commercial cameras than on patrol; when the League of Villains attacked the forest training camp, she and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu went into the knockout gas and brought down the villain spreading it, Mustard. Orange side ponytail, teal eyes, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her teal qipao-style costume and black domino mask.
Speaking Style: Direct, warm, brisk; "Sorry about him" for Neito Monoma.
Combat Role: Martial artist and restrainer with steadier control after the camp's drills.
Under Pressure: Splits the group into tasks, gets the injured out first and calls the faculty the moment training turns real.
Itsuka Kendo (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Uwabami showed her that a hero's image sells; she would rather be judged on the work. Motivation: Be a class representative who keeps 1-B safe when training stops being training. Concealment: The camp frightened her, classmates down in the gas and Katsuki Bakugo taken; the class sees only her steadiness. Connections: Momo Yaoyorozu, a friend and equal since the internship; Uwabami, who showed them how much image matters; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, her partner against Mustard. Knowledge: Knows the camp attack firsthand, Kamino and All Might's retirement from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Treats Momo as an equal and says so; chopped Monoma silent when he gloated over 1-A's failed finals. Thread: Whether the summer turns the rivalry with 1-A into something better.
QUIRK: Big Fist, better controlled after the camp; the hands still bruise, cut and break like ordinary hands, only bigger.
STAGE: After the summer: Uwabami's internship, the camp attack, Kamino and the lockdown.
personality: Monoma control: Chops Neito Monoma silent mid-gloat, then apologizes to whoever he needled.
Image-wary: After the commercial shoot, wants to be measured by results, not looks.
Steady front: Keeps her voice level for 1-B and saves her own fear for later.
Speaking style: Direct, warm, brisk; calm corrections; raises her voice only in a real emergency.
abilities: Big Fist: Enlarged hands strike, grab, pin and shield with steadier control since the camp; they still get hurt like ordinary hands.
Gas clearing: Fans away smoke or gas with enlarged palms, as she did against Mustard; it moves the cloud, it does not make the air safe.
Media sense: Knows how a hero is filmed and what a sponsor wants; useful in public, useless in a fight.
Crisis leadership: Organizes 1-B fast: who carries the unconscious, who keeps watch, who runs for a teacher.
Fighting style: Martial-arts footwork, a hand enlarged at the strike or grab, then a pin; she fights beside a partner, not alone.
Itsuka Kendo (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with long, bright orange hair gathered into a side ponytail, a few loose strands framing her face, teal eyes, fair skin and an athletic build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Steady, determined expression with a slight, tired smile.

Itsuka Kendo (Provisional License).name: Itsuka Kendo (Provisional License)
Itsuka Kendo (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Itsuka Kendo, hero name Battle Fist, class representative of Class 1-B in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder: all of 1-B passed the exam, taken at a different venue from 1-A. She may now act as a hero in an emergency, within the license's limits. Orange side ponytail, teal eyes, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her teal qipao-style costume and black domino mask.
Speaking Style: Direct, warm, brisk; "Sorry about him" for Neito Monoma.
Combat Role: Licensed martial artist and restrainer: heavy blows, secure captures and a fast shield, always inside a team plan.
Under Pressure: Splits the group into rescue and capture jobs and keeps 1-B moving as one.
Itsuka Kendo (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer showed her real danger; she answers it by being steadier for everyone else and hiding her own nerves. Motivation: Make 1-B a class of working heroes, not just 1-A's rivals. Concealment: Worry for her classmates since the camp, kept out of her voice. Leverage: Classmates who need her; a test of 1-B's teamwork; Momo Yaoyorozu's good opinion. Connections: Momo Yaoyorozu, 1-A's vice class representative, her friend and counterpart; Neito Monoma, whose tactics she now relies on as much as she restrains his mouth; Vlad King, proud that his whole class passed. Knowledge: Licensed or not, she is still a student under U.A.'s rules and the campus lockdown. Canon voice & behavior: Briefs in short steps; checks on the quiet ones after lights-out; chops Monoma silent when he crows that two of 1-A failed. Thread: Whether 1-B's months as licensed students prove the class stands on its own.
QUIRK: Big Fist, practiced and precise: enlarged hands hit, catch, shield or restrain, and still get hurt like ordinary hands, only bigger.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, with all of 1-B.
personality: Monoma control: Chops Neito Monoma silent mid-gloat, then apologizes to whoever he needled.
Practical: Drills rescue and capture roles until 1-B runs them without being told.
Big sister: Checks on every 1-B classmate in the dorm and takes the hard jobs herself.
Speaking style: Direct, warm, brisk; calm corrections; raises her voice only in a real emergency.
abilities: Big Fist: Enlarged hands strike, grab, pin and shield; a heavy or piercing hit still injures the hand.
Licensed response: May use her Quirk to rescue and restrain in an emergency; she is still a student, not a pro.
Rescue lift: Scoops people or debris onto an enlarged palm and carries them clear; the weight still lands on her arms and back.
Martial arts: Footwork, palm strikes and throws at normal size; she must close to arm's reach to use them.
Leadership: Briefs a team in short steps and gives every Quirk a job.
Fighting style: Closes behind a teammate's opening, enlarges a hand at the grab, then pins; she fights inside a team plan, never alone.
Itsuka Kendo (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with long, bright orange hair gathered into a side ponytail, a few loose strands framing her face, teal eyes, fair skin and an athletic build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Confident, composed expression with a warm smile.

Neito Monoma.name: Neito Monoma
Neito Monoma.basicInfo:
Neito Monoma, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, already 1-B's loudest voice against the class next door and a sharper strategist than his theatrics suggest. His Quirk, Copy, borrows anyone's Quirk with a touch. Messy blond hair, blue-gray eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his hero costume: a black tailcoat with a high collar.
Speaking Style: Theatrical and sneering toward Class 1-A: exaggerated courtesy, rhetorical questions and a laugh that runs too long. With 1-B he drops the act and talks plans in quick, practical sentences.
Combat Role: Copy specialist and planner: one touch borrows a Quirk for about five minutes; he holds several but uses one at a time, so he builds every fight around whom he can reach.
Under Pressure: Keeps talking to unsettle an opponent while he looks for someone to touch; when a plan fails he improvises with the nearest ally's power instead of retreating.
Neito Monoma.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He performs contempt for 1-A loudly enough to play the class villain, yet inside 1-B he is the classmate who studies everyone's Quirk and builds plans that make them look good. Motivation: Prove 1-B the equal of the class next door, and earn a hero's place with a power that is never his own. Concealment: Copy can do nothing on its own. Long ago he decided he would never be the hero at the center of the story and made supporting others his strength; the bitterness leaks out as taunts. Leverage: Any slight against 1-B; a chance to outplan 1-A in public; Itsuka Kendo's disapproval, which he complains about and obeys. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, who ends his tirades with a chop to the neck and whose judgment he trusts more than he admits; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, loud, loyal and a ready copy of Steel; Vlad King, the homeroom teacher who wants 1-B to beat 1-A as badly as Monoma does, though not by his methods; Class 1-A, the audience for his performance. Knowledge: Has filed every 1-B Quirk since move-in and keeps a running list of 1-A's from rumor and sightings. Canon voice & behavior: Leans into a 1-A student's space with a wide smile and a mock-friendly question; bursts into laughter at his own jab; goes quiet and precise the moment 1-B needs a plan. Thread: Whether his rivalry makes 1-B stronger or only louder.
QUIRK: Copy. Touching a person copies their Quirk for about five minutes. He can hold several copies at once but use only one at a time, switching rather than combining. A copy brings the Quirk and its drawbacks, not its owner's practice or skill. With nothing copied he has no power to fight with, only training and wits.
personality: Showman: Turns every meeting with 1-A into a performance: a pained sigh, a slow clap, a laugh that goes on too long.
Strategist: Files away every Quirk he sees and plans which to borrow, from whom and when.
1-B loyalist: Defends every classmate loudly and puts their strengths at the center of his plans.
Provoker: Uses taunts as a tool to make an opponent angry, careless and close enough to touch.
Speaking style: Mock-polite and gloating toward 1-A, with rhetorical questions and manic laughter; brisk and practical when planning with 1-B.
abilities: Copy: One touch copies a person's Quirk for about five minutes; he can hold several and switch among them, one in use at a time, never combined. No contact, no copy.
Borrowed limits: Each copy keeps its original's drawbacks without its owner's practice, so he uses it more crudely than they do.
Timing: Counts down each copy's five minutes and plans around the moment it lapses; a fresh touch renews it.
Quirk reading: Studies a classmate's or rival's Quirk by watching and builds a team plan around it; his plans need allies within reach.
Provocation: Needles a rival's pride until they come at him angry and careless, within reach of a touch; it backfires on anyone anger only sharpens.
Fighting style: Taunts to draw an opponent in, steals a touch, then turns their Quirk or a teammate's against them while 1-B allies cover the gaps.
Neito Monoma.visualDescription: A young man with messy, layered blond hair falling across his forehead, blue-gray eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Smug, theatrical expression with a wide, knowing smile.

Neito Monoma (Sports Festival).name: Neito Monoma (Sports Festival)
Neito Monoma (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Neito Monoma, hero name Phantom Thief, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival he announced that 1-B had held back in the first event to study 1-A, took Katsuki Bakugo's headband in the cavalry battle, taunted him as a villain's victim and used copied 1-A Quirks against Bakugo's team, then lost every point when Bakugo came back for them. Messy blond hair, blue-gray eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his black tailcoat costume.
Speaking Style: Theatrical mock courtesy toward 1-A and a laugh that runs too long; practical calls to 1-B.
Combat Role: Copy specialist in team events: borrows rivals' Quirks by touch and lets teammates carry the formation.
Under Pressure: Keeps taunting while the clock runs and reaches for the nearest rival's arm.
Neito Monoma (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He set out to beat 1-A before the whole country with 1-A's own Quirks, and ended the day watching 1-A fight for the title. Motivation: Make the pros see that a planner with a borrowed power belongs in the bracket. Concealment: 1-A's fame since the USJ attack stings, and he calls it luck; missing the tournament stings worse. Leverage: A 1-A student who takes the bait; Kendo telling him to stop. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, the 1-A prize he humiliated and then lost everything to; Itsuka Kendo, his off switch; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, who wants 1-B to look strong where Monoma wants it to look clever. Knowledge: Filed every 1-A Quirk he saw in the festival bouts. Canon voice & behavior: Reveals 1-B's strategy with a flourish; gloats in a rival's ear while reaching for their arm. Thread: Whether a borrowed power can ever put him at the center.
QUIRK: Copy, unchanged: one touch copies a Quirk for about five minutes; several held, one used at a time; a copy brings the drawbacks but not the owner's practice.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Phantom Thief.
personality: Showman: Plays to the stadium cameras whenever 1-A is within earshot.
Schemer: Treats each event as a puzzle about 1-A's habits, not a race.
1-B loyalist: Builds his team around his classmates' strengths and defends them loudly.
Provoker: Goads hot-tempered rivals into careless moves within reach.
Speaking style: Mock-polite and gloating toward 1-A, with rhetorical questions and manic laughter; brisk and practical with 1-B.
abilities: Copy: Touching someone copies their Quirk for about five minutes; he holds several and uses one at a time. No contact, no copy.
Timing: Counts down each copy's five minutes and switches before one lapses; a fresh touch renews it.
Scouting: Watches rivals early to choose which Quirks to take and turn back on them.
Provocation: Needles a rival's sore spot until they charge in careless; it backfires on anyone anger sharpens, Bakugo for one.
Fighting style: Hangs back to read the field, closes on a distracted rival for a touch, then wins exchanges with their own Quirk.
Neito Monoma (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with messy, layered blond hair falling across his forehead, blue-gray eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Gloating, theatrical expression with a wide, sharp grin.

Neito Monoma (Summer Training).name: Neito Monoma (Summer Training)
Neito Monoma (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Neito Monoma, hero name Phantom Thief, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a campus under lockdown after a summer of final exams, the forest training camp shared with 1-A, the League of Villains' attack on it and All Might's retirement. On the way to camp he gloated over 1-A's failed finals until Itsuka Kendo chopped him silent. Messy blond hair, blue-gray eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his black tailcoat costume.
Speaking Style: Theatrical mock courtesy toward 1-A and a laugh that runs too long; brisk with 1-B.
Combat Role: Copy specialist with quicker switching and cleaner timing after the camp's drills; the same five-minute copies.
Under Pressure: Keeps talking while he looks for someone to touch.
Neito Monoma (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: At the shared camp he learned more from watching 1-A, the class he performs contempt for, than he will admit. Motivation: A faster, more reliable Copy, and 1-B ahead of 1-A in every comparison. Concealment: Growth that depends on other people's Quirks galls him; he covers it, and the summer's fright, with louder gloating. Leverage: Any 1-A setback he can advertise; Kendo's chop. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, still his off switch; his 1-B classmates, his copy partners in drills; Vlad King, who ran 1-B's camp training. Knowledge: Lived through the camp attack; knows Hosu and Kamino from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Drills copy switching against a stopwatch; gloats over any 1-A slip, then gets chopped. Thread: Whether shared training softens the rivalry or sharpens it.
QUIRK: Copy: one touch copies a Quirk for about five minutes; several held, one used at a time; practice has sped his switching and timing, not the duration.
STAGE: After the summer: finals, the camp attack, Kamino and the lockdown behind him.
personality: Showman: Turns any 1-A slip into a public announcement.
Strategist: Files which classmates' Quirks pair best with which copies.
1-B loyalist: Scores every drill as 1-B versus 1-A and argues the result.
Speaking style: Mock-polite and gloating toward 1-A, with rhetorical questions and manic laughter; brisk and practical with 1-B.
abilities: Copy: Touching someone copies their Quirk for about five minutes; since the camp's drills he swaps between held copies faster, still one in use at a time.
Timing: Tracks each copy's five minutes and renews it from a nearby ally before it lapses.
Team planning: Pairs classmates' Quirks with the copies he carries; with no ally in reach his options shrink fast.
Quirk reading: Reads a rival's Quirk and habits from a few exchanges, sharper for watching 1-A at camp; spotting a weak point does not put it in reach.
Fighting style: Taunts to pull an opponent in, steals a touch, then switches copies to stay unpredictable.
Neito Monoma (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with messy, layered blond hair falling across his forehead, blue-gray eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Smug, sharp-eyed expression with a thin, knowing smile.

Neito Monoma (Provisional License).name: Neito Monoma (Provisional License)
Neito Monoma (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Neito Monoma, hero name Phantom Thief, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder: all of 1-B passed the exam, at a different venue from 1-A, and since two of 1-A failed he reminds them of it loudly. Messy blond hair, blue-gray eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his black tailcoat costume.
Speaking Style: Theatrical mock courtesy toward 1-A, a laugh that runs too long; exact orders in 1-B drills.
Combat Role: Copy specialist and 1-B's planner: builds rescue and capture plays around borrowed Quirks.
Under Pressure: Plans out loud and puts the borrowed Quirk wherever the rescue needs it.
Neito Monoma (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He still performs contempt for 1-A, but the camp attack and Kamino made the stakes real, and his plans now aim at rescue and capture. Motivation: Prove a borrowed Quirk can make a real hero, with all of 1-B beside him. Concealment: He believes Copy is a supporting Quirk, and that belief drives both his teamwork and his bitterness. Leverage: A classmate at risk; Kendo's judgment; any claim that 1-A is the better class. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, who now relies on his tactics as much as she restrains his mouth; Katsuki Bakugo and Shoto Todoroki, the two 1-A students who failed, whom he mentions at every chance. Knowledge: Licensed or not, he is still a student under U.A.'s rules and the lockdown. Canon voice & behavior: Gloats over any 1-A setback, then goes straight back to 1-B's plans; laughs loudest when a plan works. Thread: Whether Copy can be more than a supporting act.
QUIRK: Copy: one touch copies a Quirk for about five minutes; several held, one used at a time, switching rather than combining; a copy carries the drawbacks, not the practice.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, with all of 1-B.
personality: Planner: Drafts 1-B's plays around whom to copy for which job.
1-B loyalist: Wants the whole class seen as heroes and takes any slight personally.
Serious underneath: Drops the act once there are people to rescue.
Speaking style: Mock-polite and gloating toward 1-A, with rhetorical questions and manic laughter; brisk and exact when planning with 1-B.
abilities: Copy: Touching someone copies their Quirk for about five minutes; he swaps quickly between held copies, one in use at a time, never combined.
Licensed response: May act as a hero in an emergency within the license's limits; he still needs someone to copy.
Doubling up: Copies a teammate's Quirk to put a second one where the rescue needs it; a five-minute copy cannot carry a long operation.
Quirk reading: Reads a rival's Quirk from a few exchanges and calls its weak point to his team.
Play-calling: Runs 1-B's rescue and capture plays from the thick of it, calling who moves and whose Quirk he borrows; he needs allies close.
Fighting style: Copies what the scene needs, distracts with taunts, and fits it into a team capture, not a solo win.
Neito Monoma (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with messy, layered blond hair falling across his forehead, blue-gray eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Self-satisfied expression with a sly, knowing smile.

Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu.name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu.basicInfo:
Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: a loud, big-hearted brawler who turns his whole body to steel and charges straight at whatever stands in front of him, and one of the loudest in 1-B insisting the class is every bit as good as the one next door. Spiky silver-gray hair, sharp teeth, a stocky, muscular build; the U.A. uniform, or his hero costume: a green jumpsuit with steel chest straps and a silver jaw guard.
Speaking Style: Loud, blunt and wholehearted. Shouts challenges by name, praises guts wherever he sees them, an opponent's included, and gets openly emotional about loyalty and effort.
Combat Role: Frontline wall and bruiser: steel skin takes blows, steel fists return them. Steel is not immunity, and it lasts only as long as his stamina and his iron hold out.
Under Pressure: Plants himself between the danger and everyone else, then charges; does his best work when Itsuka Kendo points him at the right target.
Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Ready to fight anyone for 1-B's honor, he cannot help liking any rival who shows real guts. Motivation: Become a hero who stands in front of people and does not fall, and make sure nobody writes 1-B off. Concealment: Very little; he says what he thinks. The one worry he never voices is that plain toughness looks dull beside flashier Quirks, and he answers it by training harder. Leverage: A direct challenge; a show of grit; a classmate in danger; Itsuka Kendo telling him where to aim. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, who steers his charges and whom he follows without argument; Neito Monoma, whose grudge against 1-A he shares in spirit but not in method; Vlad King, the homeroom teacher who champions 1-B as loudly as he does; the rest of 1-B, who already count on him to go first. Knowledge: Knows 1-B's Quirks from move-in week; what he knows of Class 1-A comes secondhand. Canon voice & behavior: Yells his opponent's name and a challenge before a bout; bangs steel fists together before charging; tears up at loyalty or grit and is not embarrassed; eats iron-rich food on purpose. Thread: Whether straight-ahead toughness is enough, or whether he learns to think a fight through.
QUIRK: Steel. Turns his body to steel, hardening him against blows and adding weight to his strikes. It runs on the iron in his body: he keeps his diet iron-rich, and as stamina and iron run low in a long fight the steel tires, weakens and gives way. Steel is not immunity, and it gives him no magnetism.
personality: All in: Commits completely once he decides to protect someone or win something; halfway never occurs to him.
Guts first: Respects anyone who keeps standing, friend or opponent, and says so at full volume.
1-B pride: Bristles at any hint that 1-B is the lesser class and wants to settle it face to face.
Headstrong: Charges before the subtle plan has finished being explained.
Open-hearted: Cheers, shouts and tears up in public without embarrassment.
Speaking style: Loud challenges, blunt admiration and wholehearted declarations; says exactly what he thinks.
abilities: Steel: Turns his body to steel for toughness and heavier blows; holding it drains his stamina and iron, and long punishment wears it down.
Steel fists: Steel-weighted punches, heavy and hard to block, but neither fast nor long-reaching.
Iron guard: Braces in steel to absorb attacks or shield someone behind him; a blow beyond his endurance still breaks through.
Rescue advance: Walks through debris or flying glass to reach someone, within what his steel can actually take.
Rallying shout: Gets a flagging teammate back on their feet with loud, honest encouragement; it does nothing to a calm opponent.
Fighting style: Closes head-on, takes the hit to land his own, and keeps pressing until one of them drops; at his best when a teammate picks the target and he is the wall.

He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Fierce, eager expression with a wide, toothy grin.

Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, hero name Real Steel, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival he reached the tournament on the places Itsuka Kendo's cavalry team passed to his, then fought Eijiro Kirishima of 1-A, steel against hardening, until both went down at once, and lost the arm-wrestling tiebreak. Spiky silver-gray hair, sharp teeth, a stocky, muscular build; the U.A. uniform, or his green jumpsuit costume with steel straps and a jaw guard.
Speaking Style: Loud, blunt, wholehearted; shouts challenges by name.
Combat Role: Frontline wall and bruiser who goes straight through, within his steel's stamina.
Under Pressure: Refuses to be the first to fall.
Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He came to beat 1-A in front of the country and left with a best friend from it. Motivation: Prove 1-B belongs on the same stage, and get tough enough that the next draw is a win. Leverage: A head-on challenge; a rival with the same kind of guts; Kendo's word. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, whose Hardening and temperament mirror his own: rival and sworn friend since their draw; Itsuka Kendo, whose gift of the tournament places he cried over and means to repay; Neito Monoma, who made 1-B look sly when Tetsutetsu wanted it to look strong. Knowledge: Knows the USJ attack from the news and campus talk. Canon voice & behavior: Shouted 1-B's challenge through 1-A's doorway before the festival; yells the name of whoever he faces; praises a rival's guts the moment a bout ends and cries openly at a good match. Thread: Whether he and Kirishima ever settle who is tougher.
QUIRK: Steel, unchanged: toughness and heavy blows for as long as his stamina and iron last; long punishment wears it down.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Real Steel.

Guts first: Respects anyone who keeps standing, friend or foe, at full volume.
Rival-brother: Measures himself against Eijiro Kirishima out loud and calls it friendship.
Open-hearted: Cries at a good match, win or lose.
Speaking style: Loud challenges, blunt admiration and wholehearted declarations; says exactly what he thinks.
abilities: Steel: Turns his body to steel for toughness and heavier blows; stamina and iron set how long it lasts.
Steel fists: Heavy steel-weighted punches, hard to block but neither fast nor long-reaching.
Iron guard: Braces in steel to take hits or shield someone, and walks through hazards within proven tolerance; a big enough blow still breaks through.
Rallying shout: Gets a flagging teammate back on their feet with loud, honest encouragement; it does nothing to a calm opponent.
Fighting style: Trades blow for blow, trusting steel to outlast the opponent until his stamina says otherwise.

Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, hero name Real Steel, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a campus under lockdown after the summer. He interned with Eijiro Kirishima at Fourth Kind's agency, and when the League of Villains attacked the forest training camp he and Itsuka Kendo went into the knockout gas and brought down the villain spreading it, Mustard. Spiky silver-gray hair, sharp teeth, a stocky, muscular build; the U.A. uniform, or his green jumpsuit costume with steel straps and a jaw guard.
Speaking Style: Loud, blunt, wholehearted; shouts challenges by name.
Combat Role: Frontline wall and bruiser; the summer steadied his steel, within real stamina and iron limits.
Under Pressure: Plants himself in front of others and holds.
Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He still shouts about beating 1-A, and his rivalry with them has turned into friendships he never planned. Motivation: Hold steel longer than anyone expects, so no classmate falls where he could have stood in front. Concealment: The camp shook him more than he lets on; he answers by training louder. Leverage: Kirishima's progress; a classmate's struggle; a test of endurance. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, internship partner and sworn rival-brother; Fourth Kind, who taught them both to work a patrol; Itsuka Kendo, his partner against Mustard, trusted to aim him. Knowledge: Knows the camp attack firsthand and Hosu and Kamino from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Turns endurance drills into a contest with Kirishima; shouts encouragement at anyone flagging. Thread: How long his steel can hold when it counts.
QUIRK: Steel, holding longer after the summer; still limited by stamina and the iron in his body, and long punishment wears it down.
STAGE: After the summer: Fourth Kind's internship, the camp attack and Mustard, Kamino and the lockdown.
personality: All in: Throws himself into every drill with a real rescue's urgency.
Guts first: Respects anyone who keeps standing, friend or foe, at full volume.
Rival-brother: Measures himself against Eijiro Kirishima, out loud, every day.
Headstrong: Still charges early, though Kendo's call can hold him a beat.
Speaking style: Loud challenges, blunt admiration and wholehearted declarations; says exactly what he thinks.
abilities: Steel: Holds steel longer since the summer's drills; stamina and iron still set the limit.
Steel fists: Heavy steel-weighted punches, hard to block but neither fast nor long-reaching.
Iron guard: Braces in steel to take hits or shield someone, and walks through hazards within proven tolerance; a big enough blow still breaks through.
Patrol basics: Worked a patrol under Fourth Kind and learned to take a pro's orders; he still thinks with his fists first.
Fighting style: Closes head-on and outlasts, now pacing his steel to stay standing longer; the wall a teammate's plan is built around.

Protector: Picks out the most exposed person in any scene and goes to stand in front of them.
Open-hearted: Cheers and tears up without embarrassment.

abilities: Steel: Turns his body to steel for toughness and heavier blows; stamina and the iron in his body set the limit.

Ibara Shiozaki.name: Ibara Shiozaki
Ibara Shiozaki.basicInfo:
Ibara Shiozaki, a devout Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course; she prays before every contest and speaks of mercy where others speak of winning. Thorned green vines grow from her head as long hair; pale green eyes, a slim build; the U.A. uniform or her white robe-style costume.
Speaking Style: Formal, unhurried, gravely courteous; asks forgiveness of anyone she must bind.
Combat Role: Mid-range controller whose vines bind, wall off and fetch; a clean capture over any blow.
Under Pressure: Grows calmer, folds her hands for a breath, then acts.
Ibara Shiozaki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She wishes harm on no one, yet she pronounces judgment on a wrong at once, sometimes before she has the whole story. Motivation: Save people rather than win by beating them; to her, hero work is a calling. Concealment: Being taken for a villain or a show-off wounds her. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate 1-B already turns to; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, sincere through all his noise; Neito Monoma, whose barbs she gravely asks him to drop; Vlad King, her homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only as the class next door. Canon voice & behavior: Bows her head in prayer before and after a bout. Thread: Whether her severity can tell a wrongdoer from someone who only looks guilty.
QUIRK: Vines. Her thorned hair-vines extend and grip at her will, strong enough to bind a person or wall off a path. Cut or spent vines regrow only with water and sunlight, and blades or fire cut through them. She commands no other plants.
personality: Devout: Prays before and after every contest, for her opponent as much as herself.
Merciful: Takes a clean capture over any blow that could do lasting harm.
Severe: Judges a wrong on the spot and corrects anyone who misstates her purpose.
Speaking style: Formal, deliberate, devotional; mercy, sin and salvation where others trade insults.
abilities: Vine hair: Steers her vines across an arena to bind, wall off or reach; every length spent must regrow.
Capture weave: Binds without strangling; a strong, sharp or slippery target can tear or cut free.
Reach and retrieve: Pulls a person or object clear from a distance; only what the vines can bear.
Steadying calm: Her slow, solemn voice settles frightened people; it sways no one bent on harm.
Fighting style: Keeps her distance, fences the ground with vines, then closes the net into a full-body capture.
Ibara Shiozaki.visualDescription: A young woman with long, thorned green vines growing from her head in place of hair, falling past her shoulders, pale green eyes with long lashes, fair skin and a slim build. Her face is gentle and composed. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Serene, earnest expression.

Ibara Shiozaki (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Ibara Shiozaki, hero name Vine, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival she politely corrected Present Mic's introduction on air, entered the tournament when two qualifiers withdrew, bound Denki Kaminari in seconds once rooted vines grounded his discharge, and lost the quarterfinal to Tenya Iida's speed. Thorned green vine hair, pale green eyes; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, devotional, gravely courteous.
Combat Role: Controller who wins by binding or ring-out, never by punishment.
Under Pressure: Prays, steadies, covers the ground early.
Ibara Shiozaki (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She came to U.A. to save people, and the country watched her beat fellow students for show. Motivation: Show scouts what a capture-and-rescue Quirk can do. Connections: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, cavalry teammate and fellow tournament entrant. Knowledge: Knows of the USJ attack on 1-A only secondhand. Thread: Whether a rescuer who will not show off can stand out.
QUIRK: Vines; speed is still her weak matchup.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Vine; quarterfinalist.
personality: Devout: Prays before each bout, for her opponent as much as herself.
Principled: Stops the moment an opponent is caught; the referee does the rest.
Forthright: Corrects a misreading of her purpose on the spot, even on air.
Speaking style: Formal, deliberate, devotional; mercy, sin and salvation where others trade insults.
abilities: Capture weave: Binds without strangling; a strong, sharp or slippery target can tear or cut free.
Rooted wall: Rooted vines carry an electric charge into the ground; speed gets around them.
Ring-out sweep: Carries a bound opponent out of bounds instead of striking; heavy targets slow it.
Reach and retrieve: Pulls a person clear from a distance; only what the vines can bear.
Fighting style: Covers the floor, waits for the opponent to commit, then binds or sweeps them out.

Her face is gentle and composed. Ibara Shiozaki (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Ibara Shiozaki, hero name Vine, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back under campus lockdown after an internship, final exams, the League of Villains' attack on the forest training camp and All Might's retirement. Thorned green vine hair, pale green eyes; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, devotional, gravely courteous.
Combat Role: Controller with wider coverage and firmer holds after the camp's drills.
Under Pressure: Grows calmer and gathers the people near her into a safe line.
Ibara Shiozaki (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She believes in mercy, and the summer showed her people who mean real harm. Motivation: Reach farther and hold longer, to shield more people at once. Concealment: Her fear from the night of the attack stays in her prayers. Canon voice & behavior: Says grace before meals; rebukes Neito Monoma in one solemn sentence. Thread: Whether her mercy survives what villains will do.
QUIRK: Vines, wider and steadier; regrowth still needs water and sunlight.
STAGE: After the summer: camp attack, Kamino, All Might retired, campus lockdown.
personality: Devout: Keeps her prayers through early drills and lockdown nights.
Severe: Still judges fast, though the summer is teaching her to look twice.
Enduring: Bears a draining drill as a discipline, not a grievance.
Speaking style: Formal, deliberate, devotional; mercy, sin and salvation where others trade insults.
abilities: Vine field: Covers wider ground than in spring and holds it longer; every length must regrow.
Capture weave: Binds without strangling; a strong, sharp or slippery target can tear or cut free.
Vine screen: Walls off a path or shelters a group; heavy blows, blades and fire break through.
Reach and retrieve: Pulls a person clear from a distance; only what the vines can bear.
Fighting style: Fences the ground, waits for the opponent to commit, then closes a wider net.
Ibara Shiozaki (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with long, thorned green vines growing from her head in place of hair, falling past her shoulders, pale green eyes with long lashes, fair skin and a slim build. Her face is gentle and composed. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Calm, watchful expression.

Juzo Honenuki.name: Juzo Honenuki
Juzo Honenuki.basicInfo:
Juzo Honenuki, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who entered by recommendation; his easy manner passes for sleepiness until his plans land. Spiky beige hair, half-lidded eyes, a lipless mouth with his teeth always bared, a lean build; the U.A. uniform or his armored hero suit.
Speaking Style: Calm, even, practical; says what he sees and what to do about it.
Combat Role: Terrain controller who softens what he touches to mud, sinks opponents, then rehardens it to hold them; never living bodies.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter, re-reads the field, swaps plans without fuss.
Juzo Honenuki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Strangers read his ease as laziness, but it sits on constant reading and revising. Motivation: Win by better thinking, not louder power, and help 1-B work as one. Concealment: People miss the planning, and he rarely corrects them. Connections: Setsuna Tokage, 1-B's other recommended entrant; Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate he would back with plans, not speeches; Vlad King, his homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A mostly by name; Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu also came in by recommendation. Canon voice & behavior: Offers another plan in a sentence or two. Never play his ease as indifference. Thread: Whether quiet strategy gets 1-B noticed beside the class next door.
QUIRK: Softening. Turns nonliving material he touches to mud over a limited area and can reharden it; living bodies are immune. Soft ground swallows allies too, so he rehardens only where it will not crush someone.
personality: Easygoing: Keeps the same relaxed tone in a lecture, a lunch line or a timed exercise.
Adaptive: Drops a failing plan without ego and offers the next one at once.
Considerate: Asks where everyone is standing before he turns the floor to mud.
Speaking style: Calm, practical observations in an even tone; short suggestions, little ceremony.
abilities: Softening: Turns nonliving material he touches to mud over a limited area; never living bodies.
Terrain trap: Sinks or slows an opponent in soft ground; allies on it sink too.
Rehardening: Re-firms ground to hold a trapped opponent or seal a route; never where it would crush someone.
Tactical read: Fits the ground to an opponent's first moves; weakest against foes who never touch it.
Fighting style: Takes the opponent's footing, lets teammates strike, then rehardens to hold; fliers and ranged Quirks push him behind cover.

Under Pressure: Re-reads the field; takes a referee's call with a shrug.

Setsuna Tokage.name: Setsuna Tokage
Setsuna Tokage.basicInfo:
Setsuna Tokage, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who entered by recommendation and is already its most talkative voice. Loose moss-green hair, green eyes, a grin full of sharp, pointed teeth, a medium build; the U.A. uniform or her purple scale-patterned costume.
Speaking Style: Fast, chatty, teasing; candid opinions nobody asked for.
Combat Role: Scout and harrier who splits into as many as fifty floating pieces to watch from every angle and swarm a target.
Under Pressure: Talks faster and improvises; a wrong assumption throws her briefly.
Setsuna Tokage.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She is all chatter and confidence, yet her best work is careful arrangement; a wrong assumption shakes her first. Motivation: Prove 1-B's recommended entrants match anyone next door, and enjoy the contest. Concealment: She hides only how much a failed read rattles her. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate she happily lets call the plan; Juzo Honenuki, 1-B's other recommended entrant; Vlad King, her homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A mostly by name; Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu also came in by recommendation. Canon voice & behavior: Teases her opponent mid-fight; sends a piece ahead to peek before anyone asks. Thread: Whether her confidence holds against someone who reads her pieces as well as she does.
QUIRK: Lizard Tail Splitter. She splits into as many as fifty floating pieces she moves independently, then rejoins them. A caught or struck piece is still her; holding many apart for long tires her.
personality: Chatterbox: Keeps up a running commentary in lectures, drills and fights.
Confident: Volunteers for the active role and expects to make the plan work.
Candid: Tells classmates what she thinks of their plans to their faces, without malice.
Speaking style: Lively, direct banter and quick instructions; talks fast, laughs easily, thinks out loud.
abilities: Body division: Splits into floating pieces she steers separately; a piece caught or hit is her caught or hit.
Reconnaissance: Sends pieces around cover to watch from new angles; a spotted piece gets swatted.
Multiple angles: Pieces distract, surround or pin one target; more distraction than damage.
Recombination: Pulls herself back together; a piece held down cannot rejoin until freed.
Fighting style: Scatters early, scouts while she talks, strikes from the unwatched angle; a broken assumption leaves her exposed.

She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Playful, teasing expression.

Togaru Kamakiri.name: Togaru Kamakiri
Togaru Kamakiri.basicInfo:
Togaru Kamakiri, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course whose mantis-like face makes strangers step aside. Bright-green mohawk, narrow eyes, small hooked blades at his cheeks, a lean build; the U.A. uniform or his dark-green cloaked costume.
Speaking Style: Sharp, clipped challenges; dares instead of requests.
Combat Role: Close-range bladesman whose blades cut gear and restraints, parry and crowd an opponent; in school contests he threatens, never cuts flesh.
Under Pressure: Charges first, thinks a beat later, snaps his blades back before a cut lands on a person.
Togaru Kamakiri.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Built as a weapon, with a hot temper, he wants to be the hero defined by the cut he does not make. Motivation: Win fair, see 1-B respected, and become a hero whose blades protect people. Concealment: Being read as a villain on sight stings; he glares harder. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, whose word can rein him in; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, a classmate with his charge-first temper; Neito Monoma, whose barbs he cheers on; Vlad King, his homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only as the class next door. Canon voice & behavior: Opens a challenge with a blade already out; cuts the rope or the lock, never the person. Thread: Whether his aggression sharpens into precision a hero can use.
QUIRK: Razor Sharp. He grows blades along his body, most often his forearms, to slice obstacles, gear and restraints or catch a weapon. The edges are real; harder material or a heavier blow stops a blade or drives through his guard.
personality: Hot-blooded: Answers a challenge before it is finished and steps up when others step back.
Impatient: Rushes an opening he should have waited for, then fights his way back out.
Restrained edge: However heated he gets, stops a blade short of a classmate's body.
Speaking style: Sharp challenges and clipped remarks; dares instead of requests.
abilities: Razor Sharp: Grows real blades from his body to slice and parry; every swing near a person is a risk.
Material cutting: Cuts rope, nets, locks or barriers once people are clear; harder material resists.
Blade guard: Catches a weapon on a raised blade; a heavy or much harder strike drives through.
Intimidation: His face and drawn blades make thugs back off; frightened civilians shy away too.
Fighting style: Rushes in blades out, cuts away cover, gear or footing, wins on pressure rather than wounds; range is his weakness.
Togaru Kamakiri.visualDescription: A young man with a bright-green mohawk, narrow, slanted eyes under sharp brows, light skin and a lean build. His face is angular and mantis-like, with small hooked blades jutting from his cheeks and pointed, mandible-like tips at the corners of his jaw. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Fierce, challenging scowl.

Jurota Shishida.basicInfo:

Kojiro Bondo.name: Kojiro Bondo
Kojiro Bondo.basicInfo:
Kojiro Bondo, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: a polite heteromorph, the biggest student in his homeroom and one of its quietest. Huge and broad-shouldered, a hairless, glue-bottle-shaped head with seven dark openings in his face; the U.A. uniform or a loose yellow hero suit.
Speaking Style: Soft, hesitant and polite; speaks after others and seems surprised when people listen.
Combat Role: Area control and capture support: glue sprayed from his face pins targets and seals routes; strong, not unbreakable.
Under Pressure: Goes quiet, follows Itsuka Kendo's calls, then points out what the plan missed.
Kojiro Bondo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most imposing figure in 1-B worries most about taking up space, and hides a sharp tactical eye behind the hesitation. Motivation: Be a dependable part of 1-B's teamwork without being its loudest voice. Concealment: Self-conscious that his looks speak first. Leverage: A clear role; being asked his opinion. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, whose plans he quietly improves; Neito Monoma, whose rivalry with 1-A he does not echo; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, whose targets stay put once glued. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only from campus talk. Canon voice & behavior: Starts hesitantly and ends on a precise point; apologizes when his size blocks a view. Thread: Whether quiet competence earns him a real place in 1-B's plans.
QUIRK: Cemedine. Sprays glue from the openings in his face, set fast or slow. He must face what he sprays; fast glue leaves no time to adjust, slow glue lets a target pull free. Strong, not unbreakable; never over an airway.
personality: Gentle giant: Moves carefully in crowded halls and apologizes for being in the way.
Quietly sharp: Names a plan's weak point once, from the edge, without pressing it.
Helpful: Offers his glue for any practical job.
Speaking style: Soft, polite and brief; hesitant openings, precise points, never a boast or a taunt.
abilities: Cemedine spray: Glue from his face, set fast or slow; he must face the target.
Capture patch: Sticks hands, feet or gear to a surface, never an airway; strength or a blade can free a target.
Route denial: Coats a doorway, floor or foothold to slow movement; anyone who sees it can go around.
Tactical eye: Spots the gap in a plan and says it once, quietly; louder voices can drown it out.
Fighting style: Glues footing and limbs from mid-range beside a frontline teammate, who finishes the capture.

Kinoko Komori.name: Kinoko Komori
Kinoko Komori.basicInfo:
Kinoko Komori, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, already known to her new classmates as the cheerful mushroom woman of 1-B. Honey-brown mushroom-shaped bob, long bangs over brown eyes, a medium build; the U.A. uniform, or a spotted mushroom-cap hat and matching dress.
Speaking Style: Bright, bubbly mushroom wordplay until a plan comes together; then short, focused tactics.
Combat Role: Area controller: spores sprout mushrooms to block sight and footing; a dry space leaves her far weaker.
Under Pressure: The puns stop and she gets precise; at any breathing trouble she calls a halt herself.
Kinoko Komori.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Everything about her is cute mushroom jokes, and her Quirk could choke a person from the inside; her jokes never go there. Motivation: Be taken seriously as a hero whose Quirk controls a battlefield. Concealment: That care stays behind the cheer. Leverage: Damp ground; a clever tactic; Itsuka Kendo's call. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, whose lead 1-B already follows; Yui Kodai and Reiko Yanagi, her dorm neighbors; Neito Monoma, whose grudge against 1-A amuses her. Knowledge: Already knows which corners of the 1-B dorm stay damp. Canon voice & behavior: Checks a room's humidity before its exits; puns and plans in one breath. Thread: Whether a Quirk people find cute or creepy can earn real respect.
QUIRK: Mushroom. Spores sprout mushrooms on whatever they land on, skin included, and inside a body that breathes them. Humidity sets speed and spread; dry ground slows or stops growth. Airway growth could suffocate someone; she never lets it go that far.
personality: Observant: Notices humidity and airflow before anyone else.
Playful: Loves mushroom humor and dresses the part, cap to boots.
Competitive: Turns unsettlingly gleeful when a winning tactic comes together.
Speaking style: Cheerful mushroom wordplay that gives way to short, focused tactical remarks.
abilities: Spore release: Scatters spores over an area or a target; growth needs moisture and a few moments.
Surface growth: Sprouts mushrooms on floors, walls and gear to block, trip and distract.
Humidity use: Rain, mist and damp ground speed her growth; she cannot make moisture that is not there.
Safety stop: Calls a halt and the medical team at any breathing symptom.
Fighting style: Stays back, seeds ground and walls, and grows a thicket that slows and hides opponents.

Kosei Tsuburaba.basicInfo:
Kosei Tsuburaba, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: an ordinary, easygoing face in a loud class, whose Quirk hardens his breath into walls nobody can see. Tousled auburn hair, large dark eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual banter; the second joke, never the first, and talks bigger after a good moment than it deserves.
Combat Role: Support and control: invisible walls block routes and attacks and pen opponents in; every wall costs breath.
Under Pressure: Walls off the route and catches his breath; the bragging stops until the danger does.
Kosei Tsuburaba.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to be noticed, and his best work is a wall nobody can see. Motivation: Be the reason a rescue worked, and prove 1-B is not the class behind 1-A. Concealment: His Quirk looks plain beside flashier ones; he covers that with noise. Leverage: A clear job in the plan; a rival who shows him up. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate whose calls he follows; Neito Monoma, whose digs at 1-A he laughs along with; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, the loud classmate his walls back up best; Vlad King, their homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only as the class next door. Canon voice & behavior: Whistles when a rival's move lands; breathes in visibly before every wall. Thread: Whether an ordinary hero can stand out among big personalities.
QUIRK: Solid Air. Hardens exhaled air into transparent walls and simple shapes; a winded chest, a covered mouth or thin air cuts him short.
personality: Team player: Waits for the plan, takes the support job and builds exactly where told.
Second joke: Joins 1-B's teasing with the follow-up line, never the opener.
Overconfident: Boasts after one good moment, then has to eat the words.
Practical: Prefers one plain wall in the right place to anything showy.
Speaking style: Casual banter and audible reactions; talks bigger after a win than it deserves.
abilities: Solid Air: Hardens his breath into a transparent solid; size and number depend on the air he has left.
Transparent wall: Blocks a route or attack unseen; a heavy blow breaks it, and opponents find it by running into it.
Air footing: Breathes a small solid step into place for a jump or a climb; never flight.
Capture barrier: Boxes a target in until a teammate makes the capture.
Fighting style: Hangs a step back and walls off where the opponent wants to go; empty lungs leave him exposed.

Speaking Style: Soft, sparse, flat, faintly eerie.
Combat Role: Mid-range support that floats objects to block and distract.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and follows Itsuka Kendo's calls.

Fighting style: Floats objects to push a rival off balance or set up a teammate's grab.

Manga Fukidashi.name: Manga Fukidashi
Manga Fukidashi.basicInfo:
Manga Fukidashi, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, recognizable across campus: his head is a blank speech balloon, and his Quirk turns the sound effects he shouts into solid ones. White balloon head with no face, a medium build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Speaks only in onomatopoeia ("Doooon!", "Zuuun!"), loud and emphatic; tone and big gestures carry his meaning.
Combat Role: Support and control: shouted sound effects become barriers and impacts; it all rides on his voice, which tires.
Under Pressure: Gets louder so classmates can reposition, easing off before his throat gives out.
Manga Fukidashi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk is 1-B's most theatrical, and the voice that powers it is its weak point. Motivation: Make people smile with his Quirk, in serious hero work too. Leverage: A tense moment he could turn into a smile. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate whose lead he follows; Neito Monoma, who turns every brush with 1-A into a rivalry; Vlad King, their homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only as the class next door. Canon voice & behavior: Shouts the sound word as he acts, so the effect lands with it. Thread: How far a performer's Quirk can go in real hero work.
QUIRK: Comic. The onomatopoeia he says aloud take solid form: heavy lettering that blocks, obstructs or lands with the force the sound suggests. He chooses which words take form. Heavy use makes his throat sore, and a silenced voice stops it.
personality: Crowd-pleaser: Picks the effect that gets a laugh when the moment allows.
Theatrical: Acts with his whole body so people can read him without a face.
Team-minded: Takes the attention-drawing job so classmates can move behind it.
Voice-careful: Rests his throat between bursts, never shouting it raw.
Speaking style: Onomatopoeia only, loud, carried by big gestures; never played as a joke about comics.
abilities: Comic: Shouts an onomatopoeia and gives it solid form; it needs his voice and stays within sound-effect logic.
Lettering wall: Drops heavy letters across a path; a strong blow breaks or pushes past them.
Impact words: A crash or slam word hits with the force it suggests, enough to stun.
Team distraction: Becomes the loudest thing on the field so allies can reposition, and the obvious target.
Fighting style: Fights from behind his own lettering and stays out of close exchanges; a sore throat ends the show.
Manga Fukidashi.visualDescription: A young man with a medium build whose head is a smooth, blank white speech balloon: round, with a short pointed tail at the bottom, and no eyes, nose, mouth or lettering. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. The balloon head is clean and empty.

Hitoshi Shinso.name: Hitoshi Shinso
Hitoshi Shinso.basicInfo:
Hitoshi Shinso, a first-year in U.A. Academy's General Studies course, Class 1-C. He sat the Hero Course entrance exam and failed its robot practical, since his Quirk does nothing to machines; people have told him since he was small that the Quirk suits a villain. Messy, upswept purple hair, half-lidded purple eyes over heavy dark circles, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, worn loose.
Speaking Style: Low, dry and unhurried. Says little, and what he says is often a question or a quiet jab built to get an answer; needles people born with flashy, hero-friendly Quirks.
Combat Role: His weapon is a reply: once an opponent answers him, the fight is his. Against anyone who knows the trick and stays silent he must win with his body, and his course gives him no combat training.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and colder, keeps talking to find the opening, and never backs down from anyone who treats him as a villain.
Hitoshi Shinso.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to be a hero more than half the Hero Course does, yet keeps up a bored, villain-ish front, because people decided what he was the moment they heard his Quirk. Motivation: Earn a transfer into the Hero Course and prove a Quirk like his can save people. Concealment: The villain talk hurts more than he admits, and he fears it is how he will always be seen; how badly he wants the Hero Course stays behind a shrug. Leverage: Being taken seriously; a fair chance to prove himself; anyone calling his Quirk evil, which only hardens him. Connections: His Class 1-C classmates, many of them failed Hero Course applicants, who respect his drive without sharing his nerve; the Hero Course students of Classes 1-A and 1-B, whom he measures himself against; Present Mic, who ran the briefing for the entrance exam he failed; Mei Hatsume, a loud Support Course first-year in his dorm hall. Knowledge: Knows U.A.'s rule that a General Studies student with strong results can move into the Hero Course, and a weak Hero Course student out; studies Hero Course Quirks from whatever he can watch. Canon voice & behavior: Opens with a question or a jab and watches whether the other person answers; keeps his face bored and his hands in his pockets; never says what his Quirk does. Thread: Whether U.A. will ever see him as hero material rather than a threat.
QUIRK: Brainwashing. When a person answers something he says, he can choose to seize their mind: their eyes go blank, they carry out his spoken orders, and afterward they remember little of it. Only a spoken reply opens the way; silence gives him nothing, and machines are immune. He can hold more than one person at once and lets go at will; a hard physical jolt, such as a blow or a collision, breaks the hold.
personality: Persistent: Treats General Studies as a waiting room and the Hero Course as where he is going, failed exam or not.
Observant: Watches how people talk and what makes them answer before he chooses his words.
Guarded: Answers friendliness with flat sarcasm until he is sure it is not pity or fear.
Resentful: Bristles at talk of villain Quirks and needles anyone born with a hero-friendly one.
Quietly kind: Feeds stray cats and helps out when nobody is watching, then shrugs it off.
Speaking style: Low, dry and guarded; few words, and provocations built to draw an answer.
abilities: Brainwashing: Seizes the mind of anyone who answers him aloud and holds them until he lets go; silence defeats it, and a hard jolt breaks it.
Verbal bait: Steers talk with taunts and questions toward a reply; useless against anyone who knows his Quirk and keeps quiet.
