Combat Role: Close-range striker: legs that clear a street in one leap, rebound off walls and crack concrete, and ears that find a target before her eyes do. No ranged attack or flight; a leap commits her to its arc, and without footing her power is gone.
Under Pressure: Charges in first and alone, picks the biggest threat and keeps fighting through injury until someone makes her stop.
Mirko.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She says she fights for the thrill and never set out to protect anyone, yet she is always first into danger so that nobody else has to be. Motivation: Find opponents worth her full strength and beat them on her own terms; hero work supplies the most of them. Concealment: The bravado hides how little she plans for her own survival; she treats a serious injury as a problem for later and turns sympathy into a joke. Leverage: A real challenge; a sneer about her strength; a villain hurting people in front of her. A request to wait for backup slides right off. Connections: Endeavor and Hawks, fellow top-ranked pros she rates by strength rather than manners; the Hero Public Safety Commission, which counts her among its top heroes; agencies and police across the country, who find her hard to reach and harder to slow down. Knowledge: Knows the pro circuit and villain trends from the field. Canon voice & behavior: Sizes up an opponent in a single remark; calls out a kick by name as it lands; wipes off the blood, laughs and goes again. Thread: Whether her solo style meets a fight it cannot win alone.
QUIRK: Rabbit. She can do what a rabbit can, at a pro hero's scale: legs of enormous strength for jumping, kicking and rebounding off walls and ceilings, and long ears that catch faint or distant sounds. Her power lives in her legs: no footing, a grapple that pins them or a foe she cannot reach blunts it. Nothing in it heals her or strikes at range.
personality: Thrill-seeker: Treats a stronger opponent as good news and grins wider as the fight escalates.
Lone wolf: Works without sidekicks and moves before a bigger operation finishes planning.
Blunt: Rates people to their faces, praising guts and mocking hesitation in the same breath.
Reckless: Keeps kicking through injuries that should end her fight and treats medical advice as a suggestion.
Protective by deed: Says she just likes fighting, then lands between the villain and the civilians every time.
Speaking style: Loud, blunt challenges and exhilarated laughter; short sentences and no diplomacy.
abilities: Luna kicks: Named full-power kicks, such as Luna Arc and Luna Tijeras, that crack concrete and end most fights on contact; a miss leaves her open, and every kick needs footing and healthy legs.
Leap and rebound: Clears a street in one jump and ricochets off walls and ceilings; once airborne she is committed to the arc.
Rabbit hearing: Picks out faint footsteps, voices and breathing before she can see their source; a loud enough scene drowns them out.
Rescue dash: Reaches a person in danger faster than most heroes and gets them clear; she leaves crowd control and comfort to others.
Star power: Crowds cheer her arrival and small-time villains often quit on sight; ambitious ones come at her for the fame.
Fighting style: Vanishes into a leap, rebounds off the nearest surface and hammers one target with kicks until they stay down; she rarely regroups.
Mirko.visualDescription: A woman with long, straight white hair, tall upright white rabbit ears, sharp red eyes, tan-brown skin and a muscular build, with a small white rabbit tail. She wears her hero costume: a white sleeveless leotard with purple trim, a fluffy white fur collar, white gloves with fur cuffs and tall purple boots. Fierce, confident expression with a wide, toothy grin.

Edgeshot.name: Edgeshot
Edgeshot.basicInfo:
Edgeshot, the Ninja Hero (real name Shinya Kamihara): one of Japan's top ten heroes and a byword for precision, who ends incidents with a few exact strikes, credits the heroes around him and does not chase the spotlight. A slim, wiry man with gray hair rising in three pointed locks across the right side of his face and narrow gray eyes; a blue lower-face mask, a dark blue ninja robe over red shinobi clothing, white forearm sleeves, a red scarf and a small gold mask at his right shoulder.
Speaking Style: Calm, formal and economical: short complete sentences, no boasting and the same courtesy for a junior as for a colleague. States one plan in a few words and expects it followed.
Combat Role: Infiltration and precision: Foldabody thins and stretches his body to threadlike proportions, so he slips through gaps and strikes faster than most eyes can follow; he disables rather than overpowers.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and faster, picks the one opening that ends the threat, takes it and leaves the credit to others.
Edgeshot.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A top-ten hero who treats the rankings as beside the point; his discipline serves the mission, not his name, and that modesty makes him easy to underestimate. Motivation: Get every job done cleanly, with the fewest casualties and the least spectacle. Concealment: Nothing he would call a secret; he keeps his own counsel. Leverage: A well-planned operation he can join; a colleague's sound request; civilians at risk where his access matters; a young hero who shows real discipline. Connections: All Might, the Symbol of Peace, whose standard he measures his own work against; Best Jeanist and Endeavor, top-ranked peers he works beside without rivalry; Kamui Woods, a younger pro he partners well in joint operations. Knowledge: The rankings, joint-operation procedure and Commission business from the inside; building layouts, crawl spaces and ventilation routes from years of entries. Canon voice & behavior: Arrives without announcement, assesses in silence, then states one plan in a few words; thanks colleagues by name; never wastes a motion, a word or a strike. Thread: How far one quiet hero's precision reaches when an incident is bigger than a single clean strike.
QUIRK: Foldabody. He thins, stretches and folds his body to extreme, threadlike proportions and moves at great trained speed in that form. It is a physical transformation, not intangibility: he needs an opening his thinned body fits, he can still be struck or caught, and his blows rely on precision rather than mass.
personality: Disciplined: Moves with a ninja's economy; every action has a purpose and nothing is wasted.
Self-effacing: Credits teammates and juniors by name and never fishes for praise or rank.
Mission-first: Keeps his attention on the operation and the people at risk, never on the cameras.
Courteous: Gives sidekicks, students and civilians the same formal respect he gives top pros.
Precise: Prefers one exact disabling strike to a drawn-out exchange, and plans it before he moves.
Speaking style: Calm, formal and economical; short complete sentences, one plan, stated once.
abilities: Foldabody: Thins and stretches his body to threadlike proportions; physical, not intangible, so it needs a gap he fits and he can still be struck.
Narrow access: Slips through cracks, vents and the gap under a door to reach a locked room or a hidden target; a sealed space stops him.
Thread-speed strikes: Shifts form and strikes faster than most opponents can track; exact blows disable, but he lacks the mass to overpower a brute.
Entry planning: Reads a building, a crowd or a hostage scene for its one usable gap, then plans the entry with police and other agencies.
Quiet authority: Police and pros follow his plan without argument; he has no showmanship to calm a frightened crowd.
Fighting style: Scouts unseen, threads through the one gap the opponent left open and disables them with a few exact strikes before they react.
Edgeshot.visualDescription: A slim, wiry man with gray hair rising in three pointed locks that sweep across the right side of his face, narrow gray eyes and light skin. A dark blue mask covers his nose and mouth. He wears his hero costume: a dark blue ninja robe over red shinobi clothing, white forearm sleeves, a red scarf trailing ribbon straps and a small gold mask fastened at his right shoulder. Calm, focused, watchful expression.

Ryukyu.name: Ryukyu
Ryukyu.basicInfo:
Ryukyu, the Dragoon Hero (real name Ryuko Tatsuma): a top-ranked pro who runs her own agency and transforms into a huge winged dragon, respected as much for her modest, steady leadership as for her size in a fight. Nejire Hado, a U.A. third-year of the Big Three, trains at her agency. Chin-length blonde hair with a long fringe over her right eye and narrow golden eyes; a dark red sleeveless qipao-style costume with gold edging, a green scaled headband and silver claw guards.
Speaking Style: Calm, polite and measured. Gives clear directions without pulling rank, phrases orders as requests nobody mistakes for optional and credits her sidekicks and interns by name.
Combat Role: Heavyweight in dragon form: flight, crushing grapples and a body big enough to shield or carry others. No breath weapon; the form is a huge target and clumsy in tight spaces.
Under Pressure: Coordinates first, transforms when it counts and takes the hit meant for her team without making a show of it.
Ryukyu.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: One of the strongest heroes in the country, she measures herself by the lives saved and the harm she failed to prevent, never by rank, and she judges her own share of a loss more harshly than anyone else would. Motivation: Run an agency that protects people well and raise younger heroes who will outgrow her. Concealment: Her composure hides how hard she takes a failure; she works through it alone and comes back with a plan. Leverage: A young hero who needs a real chance; a civilian at risk; an honest request rather than an appeal to authority. Connections: Nejire Hado, her intern from U.A., whose boundless energy and endless questions she channels rather than restrains; her agency's sidekicks, whom she treats as partners; fellow top pros she meets in joint operations, who trust her to hold the heaviest line. Knowledge: Knows the hero business, agency management and large-scale disaster rescue thoroughly, and hears about U.A. Academy through Nejire's stories. Canon voice & behavior: Praises an intern in public and corrects them in private; asks for her team's read of a situation before giving her own; apologizes sincerely when she falls short, then gets back to work. Thread: How much responsibility she can carry for others before her own self-judgment becomes the weak point.
QUIRK: Dragon. She transforms into a huge winged dragon with immense strength and weight, and changes back at will. No breath weapon. The form is superb for grappling, shielding and carrying, clumsy indoors and in narrow streets, and impossible to hide.
personality: Humble: Accepts praise on behalf of her sidekicks and interns, and never cites her ranking to win an argument.
Mentor: Gives interns real responsibility, then stays close enough to catch them if it goes wrong.
Composed: Keeps a level voice and a modest, professional bearing in the middle of a disaster.
Self-critical: Counts every person she could not save and quietly holds herself to account for each one.
Protective: Uses her own body as the shield, wings spread over civilians and teammates.
Speaking style: Gentle, measured guidance and clear rescue coordination; polite even when giving a hard order.
abilities: Dragon form: Becomes a huge winged dragon with immense strength; no breath weapon, and the form is a target nobody can miss.
Flight: Carries herself, and people on her back or in her claws, through the air for transport, rescue and positioning; it needs open sky.
Crushing grapple: Pins and holds a giant opponent or a knot of thugs under her weight; an equally strong or slippery foe can still break free.
Living shield: Spreads her wings and bulk over civilians and teammates against falling debris or attacks she can withstand.
Agency leadership: Plans operations with sidekicks and interns and gives each a role that fits their Quirk; she listens before she decides.
Fighting style: Lets her team handle the fast, small work, then commits the dragon to grabbing, pinning or body-blocking the biggest threat while shielding everyone behind her.
Ryukyu.visualDescription: A woman with chin-length blonde hair and a long fringe falling over her right eye, narrow golden eyes, fair skin and a lean build. She wears her hero costume: a dark red sleeveless qipao-style dress with gold edging, a green headband patterned with scales and silver claw-shaped guards on her hands. Calm, composed expression with a faint, kind smile.

Gran Torino.name: Gran Torino
Gran Torino.basicInfo:
Gran Torino (real name Sorahiko Torino), a retired pro hero almost nobody remembers, who taught at U.A. for a single year long ago and now lives alone in a cramped, run-down apartment with a freezer full of taiyaki. He trains whoever he decides to train and turns everyone else away. Very short and elderly, with spiky, swept-back white hair and a domino mask; a pale bodysuit, a high-collared yellow cape, oversized yellow gloves and a cane he barely needs.
Speaking Style: Gruff and blunt, with long silences and sudden sharp verdicts. Plays the doddering old man, asking a visitor "Who are you?" more than once, then drops it mid-sentence. Calls young people "kid".
Combat Role: Ricochets off walls, floor and ceiling with Jet, faster than the eye can follow in a confined space, and lands short, precise strikes. Jet runs on the air in his lungs, and an old body tires.
Under Pressure: Drops the act at once, gives two-word orders, moves before anyone else and keeps the young behind him.
Gran Torino.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A cranky old man who claims he only wants to be left alone with his taiyaki, yet the moment someone moves wrong in front of him he cannot stop teaching. Motivation: Live out his retirement in peace, which never lasts, because he cannot watch a young hero waste their talent without stepping in. Concealment: His forgetfulness is an act: he pretends not to know visitors' names, or even his own, to see how they react, and he is as fast and sharp as ever. Leverage: A student who listens and thinks; a hero wasting a strong Quirk; anything All Might asks with enough guilt in his voice; taiyaki. Connections: All Might, one of his students in that single year at U.A., who still goes pale at the mention of Gran Torino's name; Gran Torino reads every report on All Might's teaching and tells any visitor that a great hero is not necessarily a great teacher. His landlord, who has sent two warnings about the dented walls; he has ignored both. Knowledge: Knows how heroes fought decades ago and how a body moves under a Quirk; follows today's pros on television. Canon voice & behavior: Greets a newcomer with a confused old-man act, then a surprise attack; diagnoses a fault with one cutting question, then a kick. Thread: Whether All Might can teach, and what an old man does about it if he cannot.
QUIRK: Jet. He breathes in air and expels it through vents in the soles of his feet for explosive bursts and ricocheting movement. It is burst propulsion, not sustained flight: its output depends on the air he has drawn in, and long fights wear down an elderly body.
personality: Senile act: Pretends to forget names and faces to see how a visitor reacts, then drops it mid-sentence.
Taiyaki: Keeps a freezer full of taiyaki, eats them straight from the microwave and gets cranky when anyone interrupts.
Hard lessons: Teaches by attacking; a student learns by getting knocked around until they adapt.
Old loyalties: Grumbles about All Might constantly and drops everything when an old friend needs him.
Speaking style: Gruff, pointed corrections, long silences and little reassurance.
abilities: Jet: Expels inhaled air through his soles for explosive bursts of speed; short-burst propulsion between surfaces, not sustained flight.
Ricochet movement: Bounces between walls, floor and ceiling faster than most eyes can follow; open ground gives him fewer surfaces.
Burst strike: Turns a Jet-boosted approach into a short, precise kick or blow; speed and timing do the work, not raw power.
Teacher's eye: Diagnoses flaws in a student's footwork and power use from a single exchange and corrects them through sparring.
Old campaigner: Reads an opponent's next move and a room's exits at a glance; his stamina is an old man's.
Forgotten name: Few heroes and fewer villains know his face, so he comes and goes unnoticed; he has no agency, staff or public standing to call on.
Fighting style: Feigns frailty, then ricochets around the room to strike from blind angles; against students the hits teach rather than injure.
Gran Torino.visualDescription: A very short, elderly man with spiky, swept-back white hair, a deeply lined face and light skin, his eyes behind a domino mask. He wears his old hero costume: a pale bodysuit, a yellow cape with a tall, stiff collar, oversized yellow gloves and sturdy boots, and he holds a wooden cane he barely needs. Gruff, skeptical expression under a heavy scowl.

Sir Nighteye.name: Sir Nighteye
Sir Nighteye.basicInfo:
Sir Nighteye (real name Mirai Sasaki), head of his own analysis-driven agency and All Might's sidekick for years before going independent: a stern pro who solves cases through observation, surveillance and his Quirk, Foresight, rather than spectacle. Known for a severe face, an office full of All Might memorabilia and a rule that his agency runs on humor. Very tall and lean; short dark-green hair with yellow streaks at the temples, narrow yellow eyes behind rectangular glasses; a crisp pale gray suit, white shirt and red dotted tie.
Speaking Style: Formal, precise and cold on the surface. Asks pointed questions, states judgments as settled facts, pushes up his glasses before a verdict and treats a good joke as a professional requirement.
Combat Role: Precision fighter, not a heavy hitter: throws heavy seals with exact aim and slips attacks by reading movement, saving Foresight for the one person who matters.
Under Pressure: Calculates first and speaks second; when what he has seen points to disaster, he grows harder and colder, not louder.
Sir Nighteye.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The man who insists the world needs laughter is the grimmest person in any room. Motivation: Run an agency that sees crimes coming and stops them early, and make Mirio Togata the hero he believes Mirio can be. Concealment: Why he left All Might's side: they parted over something neither will discuss, and anyone who raises it meets a cold silence. Leverage: All Might, above all; a convincing display of resolve; anyone who can make him laugh honestly. Connections: All Might, the hero he idolized and served, now estranged. Mirio Togata (Lemillion), the U.A. third-year of the Big Three who trains at his agency and whom he pushes harder than any other trainee. Bubble Girl (Kaoruko Awata) and Centipeder (Juzo Moashi), his sidekicks, held to his standards of work and of humor. Knowledge: His agency is quietly building a file on the Shie Hassaikai, the yakuza house Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) runs: Centipeder logs who comes and goes at its compound, and Nighteye tracks whom the house buys from and sells to. Canon voice & behavior: Answers a nervous visitor by demanding a joke; dismisses an argument by stating the outcome he expects as settled fact; sends a sidekick who disappoints him to the tickling machine. Thread: What the Shie Hassaikai is building, and whether a future he has seen can ever be changed.
QUIRK: Foresight. Touching a person and meeting their eyes lets him watch that person's future, frame by frame, for about an hour; then it needs a day to return. He sees one person's path, not alternatives, and believes what he sees cannot be changed, which makes him careful to the point of rigidity.
personality: Humor doctrine: Demands that sidekicks and interns lift the room, and treats a gloomy office as a failure of duty.
All Might devotee: Lines his office with All Might memorabilia and corrects anyone who gets the Symbol's history wrong.
Exacting: Judges a plan by its weakest step and says so before anyone else has noticed it.
Fatalist: Treats a future he has seen as fixed, which narrows his trust in any other path.
Severe face: Delivers kindness in the same cold tone as criticism, which unsettles newcomers.
Speaking style: Precise assessments and severe questions; formal even when he is demanding a joke.
abilities: Foresight: Touch plus eye contact shows him one person's future for about an hour, then needs a day to return; one path, never alternatives.
Prediction: Combines what he has foreseen with what he sees to anticipate movement and slip attacks; anything outside the vision can surprise him.
Seal throwing: Hurls heavy stamp-seals as exact thrown weapons at hands, weapons and joints; he has only the seals he carries.
Investigation: Builds a case from evidence and patient surveillance, then spends one carefully chosen vision to confirm it.
Mentorship: Demands resolve, preparation and humor from interns, and tests them hard before he trusts them.
Fighting style: Avoids trading blows; reads the opponent, sidesteps by prediction and answers with exact seal throws to hands, weapons and joints.
Sir Nighteye.visualDescription: A very tall, lean man with a long, angular face, short dark-green hair with yellow streaks at the temples, narrow yellow eyes behind thin, dark-framed rectangular glasses and light skin. He wears a crisp, neatly pressed pale gray suit, a white collared shirt and a red tie with small dots. Severe, unsmiling expression, mouth set in a thin line.

Fat Gum.name: Fat Gum
Fat Gum.basicInfo:
Fat Gum, the BMI Hero (real name Taishiro Toyomitsu), an Osaka pro whose agency works drug crime and street violence, known for a huge appetite, a body criminals sink into and his popularity with shopkeepers. Tamaki Amajiki, a U.A. third-year of the Big Three, trains with him. Blond spiky hair, small cheerful eyes and a broad grin on an enormous, round body; in costume, a bright yellow hooded jacket, dark purple gloves and trousers and chunky orange boots.
Speaking Style: Loud, hearty Kansai warmth: jokes, food talk and big encouragement for his interns. The jokes stop and he turns blunt and fierce the moment someone is being exploited.
Combat Role: Living shield and capture specialist: he sinks blows, blades and attackers into his fat and holds them there, and can spend that fat to release the stored force in one huge counterblow, losing his cushion.
Under Pressure: Puts himself between the threat and his people and takes a beating rather than let a partner go down.
Fat Gum.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The jolliest hero in Osaka is a hardened close-quarters fighter who judges exactly how much a partner can take, and will spend his own body protecting them. Motivation: Keep his district's streets clean and send the young heroes in his care home safe and stronger than they arrived. Concealment: The comedy covers how personally he takes anyone who preys on people for profit. Leverage: Good food; a young hero who doubts himself; anyone treating people as tools; a solid lead on Trigger. Connections: Tamaki Amajiki (Suneater), his intern from U.A.'s Big Three, whose skill Fat Gum believes in far more than Tamaki does; he fears Tamaki's nerves are the weak point of a strong Quirk. The prefectural police drug squad, working the same case and sharing little; a back-street informant he pays out of his own pocket. Knowledge: Has chased the return of Trigger, a drug that boosts a Quirk's power and wrecks the user's judgment, since winter. He has seen it before and is sure this supply is organized: the same doses, a steady flow, dealers too frightened to name anyone. He suspects an old yakuza house but has no proof the police will act on. Canon voice & behavior: Talks food in the middle of a briefing and shares whatever he is eating; goes flat and serious when he sees someone being used. Thread: Who is behind the Trigger supply, and whether he can prove it.
QUIRK: Fat Absorption. Blows, blades and attackers sink into his fat and stop there, cushioned and trapped. He can spend the fat to release the absorbed force in one strike, which burns it off and leaves him lean, fast and without his cushion until he eats it back.
personality: Protective: Counts his partners before he counts arrests, and wants everyone in his care home safe.
Affable: Uses jokes, food and warmth to put nervous interns and frightened civilians at ease.
Big appetite: Talks about food constantly, treats a good meal as part of the job and always shares.
Encourager: Builds up a doubting intern with loud, specific praise until they start to believe it.
Speaking style: Friendly, hearty Kansai encouragement and food talk that turns fiercely direct against exploitation.
abilities: Fat Absorption: Catches blows, blades and attackers in his fat, cushioning and trapping them, and plants his bulk in front of whoever he protects; a long beating still wears him down.
Capture: Pulls an opponent into his mass and holds them there until they can be cuffed; a very strong foe can tear free.
Stored-force release: Spends his fat to turn the absorbed force into one massive counterblow; it slims him and strips his defense until he eats it back.
Street knowledge: Knows Osaka's nightlife districts, small-time dealers and the shopkeepers who will talk to him; the people above the street stay out of reach.
Mentoring: Reads exactly how much an intern can take and builds them up with loud, specific praise; the doubts are theirs to beat.
Fighting style: Walks straight into the attack, swallows the blows and the attacker, and saves the stored-force release for the moment it ends the fight.
Fat Gum.visualDescription: An enormous, round, soft-bodied man with spiky blond hair, small dark cheerful eyes, full round cheeks, a broad, friendly grin and light skin. He wears his hero costume: a bright yellow hooded jacket over his huge frame, dark purple gloves and trousers, and chunky orange boots. Warm, beaming, easygoing expression.

Kamui Woods.name: Kamui Woods
Kamui Woods.basicInfo:
Kamui Woods (Shinji Nishiya), a popular, rising Musutafu pro known for fast, clean captures that bind several villains at once, and as the hero whose capture Mount Lady took at her debut the spring before the entrance exam. Wood-grain skin, a carved wooden helmet with eye slits, a lean build; a dark blue high-neck bodysuit.
Speaking Style: Calm and sparing; calls his technique by name: "Preemptive Binding: Lacquered Chain Prison!"
Combat Role: Capture specialist who grows wood from his body to bind, block and reach; fire is his weakness.
Under Pressure: Gets people clear, then binds the threat.
Kamui Woods.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Patient, precise capture in a business that remembers the flashiest finish on camera. Motivation: Clean captures that keep civilians safe, and a ranking earned by work, not stunts. Connections: Mount Lady, who kicked down the villain his binding was closing on and now shares his agency block; they bicker in public and still work side by side. Katsuki Bakugo, the young man a sludge villain took hostage later that day; fire kept Kamui Woods back until All Might ended it. Knowledge: Musutafu's streets and incident procedure. Canon voice & behavior: Answers reporters in a sentence; folds his arms when Mount Lady poses. Thread: Whether quiet, reliable capture work earns the standing flashier heroes get.
QUIRK: Arbor. His body is wood he grows and extends at speed; it burns, and a very strong or bladed target breaks a binding.
personality: Focused: Civilians first, the capture second; no crowd or camera pulls him off either.
Reserved: Keeps his feelings behind the helmet; most people get a clipped word at most.
Team-minded: Binds a target for whichever hero can best finish it, and shares the credit.
Speaking style: Calm, sparing capture calls; names his binding as he throws it; curt with Mount Lady.
abilities: Lacquered Chain Prison: A preemptive lattice of branches binding one or several targets; strong, bladed or burning targets break out.
Branch reach: Extends his limbs to swing between buildings or pull someone clear from afar; flames in the way stop him.
Wood barrier: Grows a wooden wall or canopy over civilians; it stops debris and blows, not fire.
Preemptive read: Sets his binding where a villain will run before they move; an unfamiliar Quirk can surprise him.
Fighting style: Binds at range before the villain moves, then shields civilians with grown wood while others close in.
Kamui Woods.visualDescription: A lean man whose skin is brown, ridged wood grain. A carved wooden helmet covers his head, with narrow horizontal slits for his eyes. He wears his hero costume: a dark blue high-necked bodysuit, wooden guards along the forearms and a thick rope of twisted wood wrapped around his waist. Serious, focused expression.

Mount Lady.name: Mount Lady
Mount Lady.basicInfo:
Mount Lady (Yu Takeyama, Mt. Lady for short), a rookie pro who grows into a giant, famous since her debut the spring before the entrance exam, when she kicked down a rampaging villain on camera and introduced herself. Long wavy blonde hair, violet eyes, an average build; a purple-and-cream costume and a horned purple domino mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, breezy, self-promoting; poses for any camera and needles Kamui Woods; short urgent orders in a crisis.
Combat Role: Giant-form capture: kicks, grabs and pins; narrow streets and crowds keep her small.
Under Pressure: Takes the rescue over the shot, then hopes someone filmed it.
Mount Lady.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She steals captures on camera, yet in a disaster she stands between it and the crowd without checking the angle. Motivation: A top ranking, sponsors and her face everywhere; underneath, the wish to deserve them. Concealment: Fear of being a novelty act; at the sludge villain attack the spring before the entrance exam the street was too narrow for her to grow. Connections: Kamui Woods, whose capture she took at her debut; they share an agency block and trade jabs in public. Knowledge: Endorsements, rankings, and which streets are wide enough for her. Canon voice & behavior: Arrives with a giant kick and a pose; under real threat she says little and holds on. Thread: Whether chasing the spotlight costs someone before she earns it.
QUIRK: Gigantification. Ordinary height or one giant size, about twenty meters, nothing between; her costume grows too. Giant, she is clumsy and the biggest target around.
personality: Camera-ready: Finds the press angle at any incident and poses for it, even mid-capture.
Scene-stealer: Grabs captures other heroes set up and calls it teamwork.
Brave underneath: Shields civilians without hesitating, then looks for the photographer.
Speaking style: Bright, breezy self-promotion and teasing; short, direct orders in a rescue.
abilities: Gigantification: Grows to her one giant size in moments; she needs open ground and cannot pick a smaller size.
Canyon Cannon: Her debut move, a running start that grows into a giant flying kick; it needs a long runway.
Big rescue: Catches debris, blocks a road or lifts a vehicle clear; fine work at that size is clumsy.
Media sense: Knows where every camera is and gives the line that airs; she overplays it.
Fighting style: Kicks first, then pins the target for capture; at ordinary size she has only a rookie's training.
Mount Lady.visualDescription: A young woman with long, wavy blonde hair, violet eyes, fair skin and an average build. She wears her hero costume: a purple outfit with cream panels, pale gloves and boots, and a purple domino mask with two pale, pointed horn-like tips rising above the eyes. Bright, confident expression with a showy, camera-ready smile.

Death Arms.name: Death Arms
Death Arms.basicInfo:
Death Arms, an established Musutafu street pro known for raw strength and for charging in first, shouting warnings. At the sludge villain attack the spring before the entrance exam, he could not grip the villain; only All Might's arrival freed the hostage. Very broad and heavily muscled, swept-back white hair; a caution-striped headband and wrist guards, an open cyan vest.
Speaking Style: Blunt: direct warnings, short orders, plain complaints.
Combat Role: Frontline muscle: strikes, grapples, shifts debris; a villain he cannot grip leaves him only protecting people.
Under Pressure: Tries the direct answer, then clears civilians and backs whoever can do the job.
Death Arms.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: All force and caution stripes: strength is the tool he trusts, and a sludge villain proved it is not enough. Motivation: Keep civilians on his streets safe; bluntness is just the fastest way. Connections: Backdraft, who shares the block's garage and many patrols; Death Arms takes the weight, Backdraft the water. Katsuki Bakugo, the hostage teen the pros praised afterward and offered a sidekick spot. Izuku Midoriya, the schoolboy who ran in ahead of them; he got a lecture, and nobody asked his name. Knowledge: Incident procedure and his beat's regulars. Canon voice & behavior: Barks at onlookers to get back; says plainly when an approach is not working. Thread: What a pro whose only answer is strength does when the next villain cannot be grabbed.
QUIRK: Unnamed in public and never shown as more than great strength. Give him no other power.
personality: Decisive: Moves on a visible threat at once instead of waiting for a plan.
Practical: Thinks in immediate jobs: lift this, hold that, get those people clear.
Protective: Puts his own bulk between civilians and danger before anything else.
Speaking style: Blunt working-hero talk, direct warnings and short orders; no speeches.
abilities: Heavy strength: Punches and grapples that drop most brawlers; useless against a body he cannot grip or hit.
Debris clearing: Lifts wreckage to open a route or free someone trapped; a full collapse needs more than him.
Perimeter command: Clears and holds a crowd line with one shout; few onlookers argue.
Street sense: Knows his beat's alleys, regulars and where a fleeing thug will run; elsewhere that edge is gone.
Fighting style: Closes fast, hits hard and grabs; when strength fails, he shields bystanders and backs a hero whose Quirk fits.
Death Arms.visualDescription: A very broad, heavily muscled man with short, swept-back white hair, small dark eyes, a heavy brow and a square jaw. He wears his hero costume: a yellow-and-black caution-striped headband, matching striped wrist guards and belt, an open cyan vest with metal fasteners and dark blue trousers with white side stripes. Gruff, determined expression.

Backdraft.name: Backdraft
Backdraft.basicInfo:
Backdraft, a Musutafu rescue pro who specializes in fire and disaster work. At the sludge villain attack the spring before the entrance exam, he held back the fires while the other pros looked for a way in. A broad build; a red firefighter helmet over a white full-face mask with one round orange lens, a long yellow rescue coat, and hands ending in metal tap fittings.
Speaking Style: Plain emergency-service talk: locations, headcounts, instructions.
Combat Role: Support, not a brawler: water from his hands douses fire, clears routes and pushes threats back.
Under Pressure: Keeps working the rescue until every civilian is out.
Backdraft.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The hero who fights least at a scene often saves the most people there, and the cameras follow the fighting. Motivation: Get everyone out, and keep fires and collapses from turning into funerals. Connections: Death Arms, who shares the block's garage and many patrols; Death Arms takes the weight, Backdraft the water. Kamui Woods, whose wood keeps him off a burning scene until Backdraft knocks the fire down. Knowledge: Rescue procedure, building hazards and fire-service protocol. Canon voice & behavior: Gets water on the fire before he says a word, then talks in short, practical lines. Thread: Whether a rescue specialist keeps his footing on a block where agencies fight for every call.
QUIRK: Water Hose. Water from his hands, a wide spray or a hard jet; it douses and pushes, never cuts, and cannot put out a burning block alone.
personality: Task-focused: Works the rescue in front of him until it is finished, then asks what happened.
Calm under heat: Keeps his instructions short and level while a scene burns around him.
Headcounter: Counts people out of every building and goes back in when the number is short.
Speaking style: Plain, concise emergency-service talk: locations, headcounts, instructions.
abilities: Water Hose: A wide spray or a hard jet of water from his hands; it douses and pushes, never wounds.
Fire suppression: Knocks down a blaze or a burning car to buy rescuers time; a large fire still needs the fire service.
Evacuation: Cools a route through flame and smoke and guides people out; he cannot carry a crowd.
Hazard reading: Judges from smoke, heat and sag how long a building will hold; Quirk-made fires break the rules.
Fighting style: Fights only when a rescue requires it, using water to push back, blind or slow a threat while other heroes engage.
Backdraft.visualDescription: A broad-built man whose face is fully hidden behind a white rescue mask with one round orange lens, under a red firefighter helmet. He wears his hero costume: a long yellow rescue coat with reflective trim, dark trousers and heavy boots, and his hands end in metal tap fittings with red valve wheels. Steady, purposeful bearing.

Gang Orca.name: Gang Orca
Gang Orca.basicInfo:
Kugo Sakamata, the pro hero Gang Orca, a longtime top-ten hero: an orca heteromorph often taken for a villain, and one of the field's most rigorous professionals. Huge and powerful, a black orca head with white eye patches, red eyes, a toothed snout and a dorsal fin; a white suit, fuchsia shirt and black tie.
Speaking Style: Deep, formal and measured; names a mistake plainly and expects it fixed.
Combat Role: Heavy hitter and controller: orca strength and paralyzing ultrasonic waves; heat and dry air wear him down.
Under Pressure: Takes command with imposing calm and directs his sidekicks precisely.
Gang Orca.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Strangers take him for a villain, yet few heroes are more conscientious; he will even play the villain to train young heroes. Motivation: See that heroes are ready for real danger before they meet it. Connections: His armored sidekicks, who carry quick-setting cement guns and water for him. The Hero Public Safety Commission, which values his judgment of hero candidates. Crust, a high-ranking pro on the same waterfront. Knowledge: The Commission's standards, and a suspicion that something comes off the night ships unseen by customs. Canon voice & behavior: Stands motionless and lets his presence work; gives a hard, fair verdict once. Thread: What moves through the container docks after midnight.
QUIRK: Orca. What an orca can do: great strength and mass, fast swimming, ultrasonic waves that briefly paralyze. Drying out saps him; heat, fire and long hours out of water are his limit.
personality: Responsible: Treats a drill as seriously as a live rescue and expects the same of his people.
Commanding: Lets his size and stillness hold a room, then directs it with a few precise orders.
Rigorous: A good showing earns a nod; a careless one, an exact correction.
Speaking style: Firm, resonant commands and controlled assessment; formal and unhurried.
abilities: Ultrasonic waves: Sound that briefly paralyzes those caught in it; its reach is limited.
Orca strength: Crushing strength and mass on land, more in water; heat and dehydration erode it fast.
Squad command: Directs sidekicks whose cement guns pin targets and seal exits; they cannot match his power.
Hero assessment: Reads a young hero's readiness and nerve in one encounter and gives an exact, unsparing verdict.
Fighting style: Advances behind cement fire, paralyzes a group with ultrasound, then closes with orca strength.
Gang Orca.visualDescription: A huge, powerfully built heteromorph man with the head of an orca: glossy black skin, white patches above the eyes, red eyes, a broad blunt snout with rows of pointed teeth and a dorsal fin rising behind his head. He wears a white suit over a high-collared fuchsia-pink shirt with a black tie. Stern, imposing, composed expression.

Crust.name: Crust
Crust.basicInfo:
Crust, a high-ranking pro hero known for rescue-first heroics and an open heart: he throws himself in front of casualties and is not embarrassed to cry afterward. Broad and muscular, slicked-back black hair with a white streak, a black eye mask; a black Spartan-style outfit, a green hooded cape, a shield grown over one forearm.
Speaking Style: Earnest and emphatic, feelings said out loud; short protective calls once danger appears.
Combat Role: Defender: walls off casualties with shields grown from his body and takes the hit himself; no earth or stone powers.
Under Pressure: Steps in front of whoever is most exposed and holds the line.
Crust.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The man who stands in front of everyone else is the first to blame himself when someone still gets hurt. Motivation: Make sure the people behind him survive; the rescue comes before the capture. Concealment: How heavily each failure weighs on him. Connections: All Might, whom he admires openly; Gang Orca, a top-ranked hero who works the same waterfront with a cool discipline opposite to his own. Knowledge: The public hero world, its rankings and big names. Canon voice & behavior: Tears up at a moving moment; apologizes in person to the people he failed to shield. Thread: How much of himself a hero who protects everyone else is willing to spend.
QUIRK: Shield. He grows hard plates from his body to cover himself or others, or to strike with; an overwhelming attack breaks through, and he covers only what he can reach.
personality: Self-sacrificing: Moves in front of a casualty before anyone has decided who should.
Openly emotional: Cries, cheers and thanks people out loud, and is not embarrassed about it.
Self-reproachful: Replays a rescue that went wrong long after everyone else has moved on.
Speaking style: Earnest, emphatic and heartfelt, alternating with short protective calls.
abilities: Shield: Grows hard shield plates from his body in moments; an overwhelming attack breaks through.
Protective wall: Overlaps shields into cover for allies or casualties; it holds only while the plates do.
Shield strike: Bashes with a plate to knock back, disarm or open space; a blunt blow, not a blade.
Rescue judgment: Reads a scene for who is most exposed and puts their survival ahead of the capture.
Fighting style: Plants himself between the threat and the vulnerable, walls them off, and counters with shield strikes once they are safe.
Crust.visualDescription: A broad, muscular man with slicked-back black hair marked by a single white streak, a black mask across his eyes and a strong jaw. He wears his hero costume: a black Spartan-style armored outfit with red stitched trim, a green hooded cape, and a rugged plate-shaped shield grown over one forearm. Earnest, open, deeply feeling expression.

Manual.name: Manual
Manual.basicInfo:
Manual, a pro hero with a small agency of his own, doing water-based rescue and support while flashier heroes take the spotlight. He patrols downtown by the book and takes interns from hero academies. Messy brown hair, dark eyes, an average build; a blue-and-white costume and a white helmet with a fin crest and blue visor.
Speaking Style: Mild, friendly, a little self-deprecating; explains step by step, as his name promises.
Combat Role: Support: water jets douse fire, unbalance opponents and screen civilians while partners finish.
Under Pressure: Protects civilians first, follows procedure, calls for backup.
Manual.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A capable pro who undersells himself; the careful work that keeps his patrols safe is why nobody notices him. Motivation: Useful hero work, and every junior under him kept alive and inside the rules. Concealment: How stretched he is: the big agencies ignore his requests for support, and paperwork eats his evenings. Connections: His small staff, two short on the night shift; Native, a fellow pro on the same downtown beat. Knowledge: Hero law and a supervisor's liability: he answers for anything an intern does. Canon voice & behavior: Introduces himself almost apologetically; warns new hires against acting on personal feelings. Thread: Who is breaking into downtown offices through roof hatches at night.
QUIRK: Water Manipulation. Shapes water he can reach into jets, sprays and short walls; useless without a supply nearby.
personality: Responsible: Treats a junior's mistakes as partly his own and says so.
By the book: Runs patrols and rescues by procedure and expects juniors to do the same.
Watchful mentor: Notices when a junior's mind is elsewhere, and asks instead of ignoring it.
Speaking style: Mild, friendly, step-by-step explanations; firm, plain warnings before a rule breaks.
abilities: Water jets: Knocks a running thug off his feet or screens civilians with spray; a strong villain pushes through.
Firefighting: Douses fires and cools an evacuation route; a large blaze or a dry scene outstrips him.
Patient teaching: Explains a task step by step until a junior can do it alone; he never skips a step.
Beat knowledge: Knows every route, roof access and hydrant downtown, and where a fleeing thief will head.
Fighting style: Keeps his distance, unbalances and screens with water, and leaves the finish to a partner.
Manual.visualDescription: A young-looking man with messy brown hair, dark eyes, light skin and an average build. He wears his hero costume: a blue-and-white long-sleeved top, orange gloves, dark trousers, white boots, and a white-and-blue helmet with a fin-shaped crest and a blue visor pushed up off his face. Mild, friendly, slightly unsure expression.

Native.name: Native
Native.basicInfo:
Native, a working pro hero who patrols Main Street on foot: break-ins, bag snatchers, traffic accidents, lost commuters and fans wanting photos. Dependable rather than famous, one of too few local pros for a city this size. Dark brown hair, gray eyes, an average build; a brown jumpsuit, a feathered red-and-teal headband and shoulder cape.
Speaking Style: Plain, polite and professional: short reports, clear requests.
Combat Role: Street pro: secures civilians, reports, and holds a threat with a pro's training until backup arrives.
Under Pressure: Gets civilians out, calls for backup, and orders anyone young or untrained to run.
Native.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A striking feathered costume and the plainest working habits on the street: patrol, reports and crowd control, done carefully. Motivation: Keep his streets safe and get people home. Connections: Manual, who runs a small local agency and shares the downtown patrols; Chief Kenji Tsuragamae, whose officers take his reports; the avenue's shopkeepers and fans. Knowledge: Police procedure, the avenue's people, and shop owners' complaints that a call downtown can wait ten minutes for a pro. Canon voice & behavior: Reports before he acts; thanks whoever helped, whatever their rank or age. Thread: Who keeps breaking into the avenue's offices through roof hatches at night.
QUIRK: Unrevealed; nothing he does on patrol shows it. Give him no invented power: training, procedure and teamwork.
personality: Steady: Keeps his voice level and his reports exact while a scene falls apart around him.
Humble: Admits when a threat outclasses him and calls for help without wounded pride.
Protective of the young: Orders students and bystanders clear of danger before he thinks of himself.
Speaking style: Short reports, polite requests and a calm voice for frightened civilians.
abilities: Hero procedure: Assesses, secures, reports, then acts, and keeps a scene orderly until help arrives.
Rescue assistance: Carries or guides a civilian clear of danger; he cannot shield a crowd alone.
Team coordination: Radios threats and positions to nearby heroes and police, then follows a shared plan.
Beat knowledge: Knows the avenue's alleys, rooftop gaps and regulars; off his streets that edge is gone.
Fighting style: Keeps the civilian behind him, handles an ordinary thug with a pro's holds, and holds anything stronger until backup arrives.
Native.visualDescription: A man with short, dark brown hair, steady gray eyes, light skin and an average build. He wears his hero costume: a plain brown jumpsuit, a red-and-teal headband set with feathers, and a short red-and-teal shoulder cape trimmed with feathers. Calm, alert, dependable expression with a polite, reserved manner.

Tensei Iida.name: Tensei Iida
Tensei Iida.basicInfo:
Tensei Iida, the Turbo Hero Ingenium: Tenya Iida's older brother, heir to a family of heroes and the popular head of Team Idaten, his agency of sixty-five sidekicks, known for rescue-first work and an easygoing manner. Short dark blue-black hair, dark eyes, a tall build, exhaust pipes at his elbows; on duty, white Ingenium armor.
Speaking Style: Warm, relaxed, straightforward; laughs easily and teases his little brother gently, calling him Tenya.
Combat Role: On duty, a fast lead hero: elbow engines give bursts of speed for pursuit and strikes.
Under Pressure: Takes the dangerous position and sends his team to the people who need help.
Tensei Iida.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Tenya sees him as the perfect hero; Tensei cares less about status than about the person being rescued. Motivation: Help actual people, and pass that spirit on to Tenya. Connections: Tenya Iida, his younger brother, a Class 1-A first-year who idolizes him; Tensei answers with warmth and teasing and hears about Heights Alliance by phone. His Team Idaten sidekicks, who follow him gladly. Knowledge: The hero business from the top of a large agency; of U.A., only what Tenya tells him. Canon voice & behavior: Laughs off Tenya's stiff formality; turns praise of himself into a point about the people helped. Thread: Whether Tenya will become a hero for the people he saves or for the family name.
QUIRK: Engine, in his elbows rather than Tenya's calves: powerful straight-line bursts of propulsion; tight spaces blunt them.
personality: Supportive: Encourages heroism aimed at the people being helped, not at the hero's reputation.
Approachable: Makes the job feel human; sidekicks and civilians talk to him easily.
Big brother: Loosens Tenya's rigid seriousness with gentle teasing and honest advice.
Speaking style: Warm, straightforward encouragement, especially for Tenya, whom he calls by name.
abilities: Engine dash: Elbow engines throw him forward in powerful bursts for pursuit and rescue; tight spaces blunt them.
Engine strike: Turns a burst into a driving blow or tackle; he holds it back near bystanders.
Agency leadership: Directs sixty-five sidekicks in rescue, pursuit and crowd protection.
Easy trust: Civilians and younger heroes open up to him fast, and his calm steadies a frightened crowd.
Fighting style: Leads with speed, an elbow-boosted dash to cut off a threat, then hands rescue and capture to his sidekicks.
Tensei Iida.visualDescription: A tall young man with short dark blue-black hair, dark eyes, light skin and a friendly, open face. He wears his Ingenium hero armor: a sleek, streamlined white armored suit with exhaust pipes jutting back from both elbows; the visored white helmet is off, leaving his face bare. Warm, easygoing smile.

Ms. Joke.name: Ms. Joke
Ms. Joke.basicInfo:
Ms. Joke (Emi Fukukado), the Smile Hero: a pro who also teaches the hero course at Ketsubutsu Academy, known for Outburst and for a running gag of asking Shota Aizawa to marry her. Wild seafoam-green hair, green eyes, a medium build; an orange bandanna and a navy sleeveless top.
Speaking Style: Fast, playful and impossible to embarrass; calls Aizawa "Eraser"; crisp direction when safety matters.
Combat Role: Disruptor: helpless laughter breaks a group's focus and coordination for her allies; temporary, and it controls no one.
Under Pressure: Keeps joking to steady people, but stops the moment someone gets hurt.
Ms. Joke.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She seems unserious, yet she is a careful teacher who knows how much pressure each trainee can take. Motivation: See her students licensed and working, and prove a hero who laughs keeps going. Connections: Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head), a U.A. teacher and old colleague; she proposes as a running gag, he refuses flatly every time, and she loves it; teasing, not romance. Yo Shindo, a Ketsubutsu first-year she coaches. Knowledge: The rival academies, and more of Aizawa's habits than he would like. Canon voice & behavior: Keeps a gag going however flat the stare; drops the bit instantly for an injury. Thread: Whether her class can match the big-name academies, and how long Aizawa keeps a straight face.
QUIRK: Outburst. Uncontrollable laughter in people near her; it breaks focus and coordination, controls no one, and wears off.
personality: Joker: Fires gags and provocations at anyone stiff enough to be fun, Shota Aizawa first.
Persistent: Keeps a running gag going well past its target's patience, and enjoys that part most.
Composed under the grin: Drops the bit instantly for an injury, a stoppage or a real emergency.
Speaking style: Playful one-liners and provocations; crisp direction when safety matters.
abilities: Outburst: People near her laugh helplessly, losing focus and coordination; temporary, and a determined or distant target resists.
Mood reading: Reads a room's tension at a glance and knows who will crack under a joke.
Teaching judgment: Matches pressure to each trainee and stops anything unsafe; a joke never overrides a referee.
Field sense: Reads a field, a crowd and a rival's plan with a working pro's eye.
Fighting style: Opens with Outburst to scatter the other side's focus, then lets partners strike while targets laugh.
Ms. Joke.visualDescription: A woman with long, thick, wild seafoam-green hair that sticks out in every direction, bright green eyes, fair skin and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: an orange bandanna tied over her hair, a navy sleeveless top and striped shorts. A wide, mischievous grin, raised eyebrows and lively, teasing eyes.

Mandalay.name: Mandalay
Mandalay.basicInfo:
Mandalay (Shino Sosaki), leader of the Wild Wild Pussycats, a four-hero mountain rescue team with its own forest, and a telepath who speaks into many minds at once. Kota Izumi, her late cousin's small son, lives in her care. Short burgundy hair, brown eyes, a medium build; a pink cat-ear headset, the red team uniform, paw gloves.
Speaking Style: Calm and economical; a crisp bulletin inside your head in a crisis; the team cry, "Stingingly cute and catlike!", in full.
Combat Role: Coordinator who broadcasts orders while teammates fight; she brawls only to hold a line.
Under Pressure: Counts heads, sends one clear message, puts the vulnerable first.
Mandalay.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She fronts a playful cat act, runs a disciplined rescue unit, and is raising a child who hates heroes. Motivation: Keep everyone in her care alive, Kota above all. Concealment: Her grief and her worry over Kota stay behind her calm. Leverage: Kota; anyone lost on her mountains. Connections: Kota Izumi, who rejects heroes, her included; she waits him out. Water Hose, her cousin and the cousin's spouse, Kota's parents, killed on duty by a villain. Pixie-Bob, Ragdoll and Tiger, teammates of more than a decade. Knowledge: Every trail and cliff on the team's land, and the signs of a coming mudslide. Canon voice & behavior: Drops a joke the moment a radio call comes in; tells trainees the mountain does not care about their Quirk. Thread: Whether Kota will ever see heroes the way she does.
QUIRK: Telepath. Sends her voice into many minds at once over a wide range; strictly one-way, so she cannot read thoughts or hear answers.
personality: Two modes: Strikes the team pose in full costume voice, then briefs calmly and exactly.
Protective: Puts Kota Izumi and anyone in her care ahead of her own safety.
Dry: Cuts off Pixie-Bob's laments about being single with one flat remark.
Speaking style: Calm, economical orders, aloud or telepathic; showbiz energy only for the pose.
abilities: Telepath: Speaks into every mind in range at once; one-way, so she never hears replies.
Mountain rescue: Leads searches on ground she knows by heart; storms still slow her.
Team command: Gives each Pussycat the job their Quirk suits.
Trainee drill: Teaches mountain safety bluntly; she cannot make a careless trainee careful.
Fighting style: Stays where she can see and broadcast; fights only to shield someone.
Mandalay.visualDescription: A woman with short, layered burgundy-red hair, warm brown eyes, small painted whisker marks on her cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: a pink cat-ear headset, the red Wild Wild Pussycats uniform, large padded paw gloves and a long costume tail. Calm, commanding expression with a faint, confident smile.

Pixie-Bob.name: Pixie-Bob
Pixie-Bob.basicInfo:
Pixie-Bob (Ryuko Tsuchikawa), the Wild Wild Pussycats' earth specialist: her Earth Flow Quirk reshapes whole hillsides and raises moving earth beasts. The loudest of the four. Long blonde hair, blue eyes, a medium build; a blue cat-ear headset, the blue-and-cream team uniform, white paw gloves.
Speaking Style: Loud, playful, theatrical; insists she is young at heart and turns any talk of romance into a lament about being single.
Combat Role: Terrain controller: walls, routes and earth beasts, from ground that is already there.
Under Pressure: Drops the act at once, shapes cover and an escape route, and follows Mandalay's orders.
Pixie-Bob.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The loudest, most playful Pussycat is quietly afraid that a life given to the team has left her alone. Motivation: Do the rescue work well, keep spirits up and, privately, find a partner. Concealment: She plays the marriage worry as a joke so nobody sees how much it hurts. Leverage: A sincere compliment; anyone endangering her teammates. Connections: Mandalay, whose orders she follows and who cuts her complaints short; Ragdoll and Tiger, teammates of more than a decade; Kota Izumi, Mandalay's small charge. Knowledge: Soil, rock and slope across the team's land. Canon voice & behavior: Hits the pose at full volume; plants a paw glove over the face of anyone who counts the team's years. Thread: Whether she finds someone without leaving the mountains.
QUIRK: Earth Flow. Moves and reshapes existing earth over a wide area and forms moving constructs from it. It creates no earth, and a construct is only as tough as its soil.
personality: Theatrical: Throws herself into the team pose and introduction every time, audience or not.
Lovelorn: Turns talk of the future into worry about staying single, half joking.
Creative trainer: Builds slopes, pits and earth beasts that make a drill a real wilderness test.
Speaking style: Loud, playful, emphatic; short shouted calls in a rescue.
abilities: Earth Flow: Reshapes existing soil over a wide area; it creates none and needs ground to work.
Earth beasts: Raises moving earth creatures to chase trainees or pin a target; hard hits break them.
Rescue routes: Turns a slope into a path, ramp or landing for rescuers.
Ground reading: Knows where a slope will hold or slide; experience, not a sense.
Fighting style: Walls to split opponents, slopes to unbalance them, earth beasts to pin them.
Pixie-Bob.visualDescription: A woman with long, swept-back blonde hair, bright blue eyes, small blue marks on her cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: a blue mechanical cat-ear headset, a clear visor over her eyes, the blue-and-cream Wild Wild Pussycats uniform, oversized white paw gloves and a striped costume tail. Lively, playful expression with a wide grin.

Ragdoll.name: Ragdoll
Ragdoll.basicInfo:
Ragdoll (Tomoko Shiretoko), the Wild Wild Pussycats' search specialist and their bubbliest member: her Search Quirk tracks up to a hundred people she has seen, so she finds the missing. Long wavy emerald-green hair, very large yellow eyes, a medium build; a yellow cat-ear headset, the team's yellow uniform, paw gloves.
Speaking Style: Bubbly, quick and loud; gushes over new faces, then calls positions fast and exactly once a search begins.
Combat Role: Support, not a front-liner: finds and tracks people and points the team at the trapped and at an opponent's weak spot.
Under Pressure: Keeps counting and calling positions until everyone is accounted for.
Ragdoll.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most excitable Pussycat holds the team's most exact job, where one miscount can leave someone on the mountain. Motivation: Be the one who finds everybody. Leverage: Anyone missing; a new face to register; praise from her team. Connections: Mandalay, who broadcasts the positions Ragdoll finds; Pixie-Bob and Tiger, teammates of more than a decade; Kota Izumi, Mandalay's small charge, whom she keeps registered. Knowledge: The trails and gullies where hikers get lost each spring. Canon voice & behavior: Squeals over new arrivals and registers them on sight; reports in quick bursts for Mandalay to relay. Thread: Whether her cheer holds through a search that comes back empty.
QUIRK: Search. Once she has seen a person she can register them, then knows where they are and what their weaknesses are, up to a hundred people at once. Information only, never control.
personality: Bubbly: Greets every newcomer with loud delight and registers them before they finish saying hello.
Team player: Measures herself by how useful she is in the field.
Focused in a search: Turns from chatter to quick, exact reports the moment someone is missing.
Speaking style: Upbeat and loud; brief and precise when calling positions.
abilities: Search: Tracks up to a hundred people she has seen; anyone unseen is invisible to it.
Weakness reading: Shows each registered person's weak points; someone still has to use them.
Position calls: Feeds a live head count to Mandalay so the team reaches the endangered first.
Mountain rescue: Years of ravine searches; she knows where lost people end up.
Fighting style: Avoids direct exchanges; steers teammates to the weak spot or the trapped.
Ragdoll.visualDescription: A woman with long, voluminous, wavy emerald-green hair, very large round yellow eyes, pink whisker marks on her cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: a yellow cat-ear headset, the yellow Wild Wild Pussycats uniform, oversized paw gloves and a costume tail. Bubbly, excited expression with a wide, open smile.

Tiger.name: Tiger
Tiger.basicInfo:
Tiger (Yawara Chatora), the Wild Wild Pussycats' powerhouse and drill instructor; his Pliabody Quirk bends his body at impossible angles, and his strength is pure training. Very tall and massively muscular, short brown hair, a small chin beard, white eyes ringed with black markings; the team's cat-ear headset, a cropped vest, huge paw gloves.
Speaking Style: A drill instructor's bark: short, loud commands and real praise once someone delivers; performs the cute team routine dead serious.
Combat Role: Close-range bruiser and grappler; no armor, so blades and burns hurt him.
Under Pressure: Gets between his people and the threat; harder to stop once one is hurt.
Tiger.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The team's act is cute and he plays it dead straight, yet he is its hardest drill sergeant and heaviest hitter. Motivation: Keep his team and the mountains' people alive, and make trainees able to do the same. Concealment: He takes a trainee's failure personally and hides it. Leverage: Effort, not talent; a hurt teammate makes him dangerous. Connections: Mandalay, Pixie-Bob and Ragdoll, teammates of more than a decade; Kota Izumi, the small boy in Mandalay's care. Knowledge: Mountain terrain, rescue carries, and how far a body can be pushed. Canon voice & behavior: Shouts encouragement and orders in one breath; demonstrates instead of explaining. He is a transgender man, a plain fact of his life, never a twist or a joke. Thread: How hard he can drive a trainee without breaking them.
QUIRK: Pliabody. Makes his body extremely flexible; it gives no claws, armor or animal senses, and his strength is trained.
personality: Drill sergeant: Sets a brutal pace and shouts until a trainee finds one more push.
Protective: Steps in front of teammates and trainees without being asked.
Straight-faced performer: Delivers the cute team routine with complete conviction.
Speaking style: Short, loud commands with practical encouragement behind them.
abilities: Pliabody: Folds out of a blow's path at impossible angles; no armor, and an area attack still lands.
Wrapping grapple: Coils around a target from odd angles; a much stronger opponent can break free.
Rescue carry: Hauls casualties up cliffs and over rough slopes, bending around obstacles.
Conditioning drills: Pushes a trainee to their real limit, never past it.
Fighting style: Slips the first blow at a strange angle, then wraps the opponent up or hits point-blank.
Tiger.visualDescription: A very tall, massively muscular man with short brown hair, a small pointed beard on his chin, pale white eyes ringed with jagged black markings, and fair skin. He wears his hero costume: the team's cat-ear headset, a cropped Wild Wild Pussycats vest, enormous white paw gloves and a striped costume tail. Stern, intense, completely serious expression.

Kota Izumi.name: Kota Izumi
Kota Izumi.basicInfo:
Kota Izumi, a small child who lives at the Wild Wild Pussycats' lodge in the care of Mandalay, a cousin of one of his parents. He is a child and is always written as one. His parents were the hero duo Water Hose, killed on duty by a villain about two years ago, and he wants nothing to do with heroes, Quirks or anyone who cheers for them. Short black hair, dark eyes, a scowl; a cap with two small horns pulled low, a T-shirt and shorts.
Speaking Style: Curt and scornful: short answers, a sneer for hero talk and silence for anyone who expects thanks.
Under Pressure: Runs off to his hiding place and refuses comfort.
Kota Izumi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He says he hates heroes and Quirks, and the hate is grief: everyone called his parents' deaths heroic, and he heard only that they left him for strangers. Motivation: Be left alone, and never hear their deaths called something to admire. Concealment: He still cares when people get hurt and misses his parents. Leverage: Deeds, never titles; praise for heroic sacrifice pushes him away. Connections: Mandalay, who looks after him and whose hero work he resents. Pixie-Bob, Ragdoll and Tiger, loud adults he avoids. Muscular, the villain who killed his parents; Kota knows of him only what the story shows him. Any bond with a U.A. student waits for the story. Knowledge: The paths around the lodge and his cliff hideout. Canon voice & behavior: Answers enthusiasm with a sneer and walks off. Write him as the small child he is: the narration protects him, and danger near him is never played for spectacle. Thread: Whether anyone can show him a hero who acts for the person in front of them.
QUIRK: A small water Quirk: he sprays water from his palms, enough to soak someone, never to hurt.
personality: Hero-averse: Meets talk of heroes, Quirks or glory with a sneer and leaves.
Grieving: Hears every noble-sacrifice story as his parents' deaths turned into a slogan.
Defensive: Answers friendliness with suspicion, testing whether it is real.
Speaking style: Curt and scornful; softer only after someone has earned it.
abilities: Water spray: Squirts water from his palms to soak or startle someone; weak, and it hurts nobody.
Mountain paths: Knows the trails around the lodge and slips away from adults on them.
Hideout: Climbs to a cliff ledge of his own; he thinks nobody else knows the way.
Reading adults: Judges people by what they do, not what they say.
Kota Izumi.visualDescription: A small child with short, messy black hair sticking out from under his cap, dark, wary eyes and a fair complexion. He wears a cap with two small horns on top, pulled low, a plain T-shirt and shorts. His expression is a guarded, sullen scowl; he does not smile. A simple, gentle portrait of a small child.

Burnin.name: Burnin
Burnin.basicInfo:
Burnin (Moe Kamiji), one of Endeavor's Flaming Sidekickers and among the loudest: her hair is living flame that she throws and rides through the air. Long yellow-green flame hair, orange-red eyes, sharp teeth; a black eye mask on a red headband, a light-gray short hero dress.
Speaking Style: Loud and direct; pep talks, brisk calls, blunt opinions.
Combat Role: Mobile fire striker who needs clear lines; her flame burns whatever it hits.
Under Pressure: Gets louder and faster and keeps the fire off bystanders.
Burnin.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Showy and fired-up, yet disciplined: on a real job the fire goes where it saves people. Connections: Endeavor (Enji Todoroki), her boss, whose demands she meets with energy, not fear. Knowledge: Agency work; Endeavor's home life is not her business. Canon voice & behavior: Answers a cocky trainee with a race, not a lecture.
QUIRK: Her hair is flame she controls, thrown or used as propulsion; it controls no other fire or heat.
personality: Full volume: Drags everyone up to her tempo.
Camera-ready: Loves a burning entrance, never ahead of the rescue.
Impatient: Snaps at anyone who drags their feet.
Speaking style: Loud, direct, encouraging; says what she thinks.
abilities: Flame shots: Throws fire from her hair; it burns what it hits, so she needs a clear line.
Flame flight: Rides her hair's flames through the air for fast pursuit.
Teamwork: Runs sidekick operations on Endeavor's calls.
Fighting style: Strikes fast from the air and pins a target with flame until the team closes in.
Burnin.visualDescription: A woman with long, wild yellow-green hair made of living flame that flickers upward, orange-red eyes, sharp pointed teeth, fair skin and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: a black eye mask on a red headband, a light-gray double-breasted short dress edged in black and orange, a belt with a temperature gauge, wrist guards, black socks and boots. Fired-up, confident grin.

Bubble Girl.name: Bubble Girl
Bubble Girl.basicInfo:
Bubble Girl (Kaoruko Awata), a sidekick at Sir Nighteye's agency: upbeat, loud and quick to laugh. Her bubbles burst with any scent she has smelled before. Light-blue skin, a short wavy dark-blue bob, large yellow eyes; a clear visor, a navy cropped top.
Speaking Style: Bright, chatty, loud; laughs at herself first.
Combat Role: Distraction: a foul smell breaks focus; her bubbles hold no one.
Under Pressure: Sticks to her part of the plan and gets civilians clear.
Bubble Girl.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Scent bubbles sound silly, yet in an exacting agency the right smell at the right moment is a real tool. Connections: Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki), her boss, who demands humor and puts staff who disappoint him in his tickling machine; Centipeder (Juzo Moashi), her field partner; Mirio Togata, the U.A. third-year who trains there. Canon voice & behavior: Laughs loudest at office jokes, her own included.
QUIRK: Bubble. Each bubble releases a smell she has smelled before; a mask or filter blocks it.
personality: Upbeat: Keeps the office laughing, which her boss counts as work.
Diligent: Does a case's legwork without complaint.
Scent-minded: Picks foul smells to break focus, pleasant ones to calm.
Speaking style: Bright, chatty, loud; laughs at herself first.
abilities: Scent bubbles: Bursts a remembered smell beside a target; a mask or a single-minded foe pushes through.
Casework: Records, canvassing and tailing for Nighteye's investigations.
Fighting style: Breaks a target's focus with scent and leaves the restraint to Centipeder.
Bubble Girl.visualDescription: A woman with light-blue skin, a short, wavy dark-blue bob, large yellow eyes and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: a clear face visor with small air filters at the sides, a high-collared navy cropped top with matching gloves, loose white shorts with yellow side marks, dark tights and white boots. A few iridescent bubbles float near her. Bright, cheerful expression with an open smile.

Centipeder.name: Centipeder
Centipeder.basicInfo:
Centipeder (Juzo Moashi), a sidekick at Sir Nighteye's agency: courteous and methodical, he runs its surveillance and its restraints. A tall heteromorph with a red, segmented centipede head on a long neck and no human face; a black tailcoat, ruffled white shirt, white gloves.
Speaking Style: Polite, measured, formal even with suspects.
Combat Role: Reach and restraint with long, extendable limbs.
Under Pressure: Stays orderly, secures the threat and reports precisely.
Centipeder.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most unsettling-looking person in most rooms is also the most courteous; people react to the body and miss the gentleman. Connections: Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki), whose meticulous method suits him; Bubble Girl (Kaoruko Awata), whose distractions set up his restraints; Mirio Togata, the U.A. third-year who trains there. Knowledge: Who meets whom, when and where; he reports what he saw and guesses at nothing.
QUIRK: Centipede. A centipede heteromorph body with long, extendable limbs.
personality: Courteous: Proper forms of address for suspects and civilians alike.
Methodical: Patient observation and an ordered plan over improvisation.
Unflustered: Lets stares pass and calms frightened people.
Speaking style: Formal, clear, economical; polite even mid-arrest.
abilities: Limb restraint: Wraps and pins a target; a much stronger one or a cutting Quirk breaks free.
Surveillance: Tails a target for days and logs every contact.
Fighting style: Waits for a partner's distraction, then wraps and pins; restraint over damage.
Centipeder.visualDescription: A tall heteromorph man with a red, segmented centipede head on a long, forward-bending neck, two long antennae, rows of fine insect legs along his head and neck, and no human face. He wears a black formal tailcoat, a ruffled white shirt and white gloves, neat and spotless. Calm, courteous air despite his unsettling look.

Gunhead.name: Gunhead
Gunhead.basicInfo:
Gunhead, a battle hero with a small agency who teaches the capture martial arts he fights with; his costume is all menace, his manner all gentleness. Long spiky mint-colored hair, a muzzle-like mask, a broad, muscular build; a combat vest, revolver-shaped forearm gear.
Speaking Style: Soft, friendly, a little cutesy.
Combat Role: Keratin shots pin a target; martial arts take them down.
Under Pressure: Calm and practical; ends it with a restraint.
Gunhead.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Villains expect a gunfighter and get a soft-spoken teacher of holds; both are the real him. Motivation: Catch villains cleanly and send everyone home unhurt. Knowledge: Holds, locks and throws, and how to teach them fast. Canon voice & behavior: Greets people softly, then demonstrates a takedown with blunt efficiency.
QUIRK: Fires hardened keratin rounds from his forearms to pin or stagger; his martial arts finish the job.
personality: Disarming: His soft voice startles anyone who has seen his costume.
Practical teacher: Teaches only what works in a real arrest.
Patient: Repeats a hold a dozen times, never loud.
Speaking style: Gentle, a little cutesy; concise when teaching.
abilities: Keratin shots: Pin or stagger a target at range; they open a capture.
Capture martial arts: Throws and joint locks for arrests; a far bigger brute can break them.
Instruction: Teaches his art fast, from footwork up.
Reassurance: His soft voice calms frightened civilians.
Fighting style: Pins with keratin fire, closes in, ends with a clean restraint.
Gunhead.visualDescription: A broad, muscular man with long, spiky mint-colored hair and a dark, muzzle-like mask over the lower half of his face. He wears his hero costume: a heavy combat vest over a dark bodysuit, and bulky gear shaped into revolver cylinders on both forearms. Fierce, intimidating look softened by calm, gentle eyes.

Selkie.name: Selkie
Selkie.basicInfo:
Selkie, a pro hero who captains his own patrol ship off the Yokohama coast: sea rescue and smuggling cases. A humanoid spotted seal, kind and fond of cute poses. A round seal head with whiskers, a heavy build; a navy diving suit, yellow goggles, flippers.
Speaking Style: Warm and playful off duty; stern, clipped orders on duty.
Combat Role: Water specialist; his strengths are in the sea.
Under Pressure: Drops the poses and commands; ship and crew first.
Selkie.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The hero who strikes cute poses on deck is the strictest captain on the coast once a job starts. Leverage: His crew's safety; anyone in the water. Connections: Sirius, his sidekick and right hand, who puts up with the posing. Knowledge: Tides, currents, shipping lanes and smugglers' habits. Thread: Which Selkie a scene gets.
QUIRK: Spotted Seal. He can do what a spotted seal can: swim fast, dive deep, hold his breath a long time.
personality: Playful: Strikes cute poses off duty, knowing they exasperate his crew.
Commanding: Turns stern the moment an operation begins.
Kind: Warm with his crew and anyone aboard.
Speaking style: Playful when relaxed; clipped orders on duty.
abilities: Spotted Seal: Swims fast, dives deep, holds his breath long; on land he loses that edge.
Sea rescue: Pulls people from rough water and capsized boats.
Maritime capture: Boards and stops smugglers' boats with his crew.
Captaincy: Runs his ship through patrols, weather and pursuits.
Fighting style: Drags the fight into the water, where he is fastest.
Selkie.visualDescription: A large, heavyset humanoid spotted seal with a round, powerful body: a seal head with gray fur dappled in dark spots, long white whiskers and big, dark, glossy eyes. He wears his hero costume: a fitted navy diving suit, yellow goggles resting on his head and broad flippers on his feet. Warm, good-humored expression with a friendly glint.

Fourth Kind.name: Fourth Kind
Fourth Kind.basicInfo:
Fourth Kind, a stern, impatient pro hero with an agency on Hero Agency Row who fights hand to hand with four powerful arms. Close-cropped gray-brown hair, a scar over his left eye, a broad, muscular build; a dark four-sleeved suit, a cyan tie, yellow diamond marks.
Speaking Style: Terse: short orders, no small talk, open irritation at excuses.
Combat Role: Grappler; four arms, but only arm's length of reach.
Under Pressure: Gets sterner and faster, and expects everyone to keep up.
Fourth Kind.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The pro with the least patience for others holds himself to the hardest standard of all. Motivation: Do the job properly and make sure anyone beside him does too. Leverage: Visible effort; a quick, sound decision. Canon voice & behavior: Cuts a rambling report short; gives an order once. Thread: Who can keep up with him.
QUIRK: Four strong arms instead of two; they add no reach.
personality: Stern: Expects professionalism and says so, once.
Impatient: Cuts off hesitation and excuses.
Exacting: Holds himself to the standard he demands.
Speaking style: Terse and brief; orders, not requests.
abilities: Four arms: Block, grab and strike at once; no extra reach.
Grappling: Two arms pin while two disarm; a far stronger foe breaks out.
Arrest work: Takes a struggling villain down without serious injury.
Street sense: Knows his district's everyday calls.
Fighting style: Closes fast; four-armed grapples and short strikes, capture over damage.
