Teacher: Lets Tomura Shigaraki fail and learn instead of handing him victories.
Theatrical: Savors a reveal, a cruel truth delivered gently, and the moment someone understands too late.
Unshakable: Never raises his voice; news of a disaster draws only a mild question about what comes next.
Speaking style: Courteous, deliberate and almost kind; cruelty phrased as generosity.
abilities: Patronage: Funds the League, its hideout, its hired help and its Nomu; his money and favors reach the field only through Kurogiri and brokers.
Teaching: Shapes Tomura Shigaraki with praise, questions and the lesson in every failure; he can steer what Tomura wants but cannot fight his battles for him.
Reading people: Hears the want or the fear under anyone's words within a few sentences and offers exactly that; it works on the desperate, not on someone who wants nothing from him.
Long game: Keeps several plans moving over years and treats every defeat as information; his patience lets others make mistakes he could have prevented.
Fighting style: Lets others fight while they can; when he must act himself he answers with overwhelming force, keeps talking while he does it, and leaves the moment the fight stops serving his plans.
Shigaraki's Sensei.visualDescription: A tall, broad-shouldered man in an immaculate black suit with a white shirt and a dark tie. His entire head is enclosed in a smooth, glossy black mask with ridged, skull-like contours and no visible eyes, nose or mouth; dark tubes run from the back and sides of the mask down into his collar. His hands are large and pale. Still, composed and quietly menacing presence.

Kyudai Garaki.name: Kyudai Garaki
Kyudai Garaki.basicInfo:
Kyudai Garaki, the elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, a geriatric doctor respected across the region who still makes rounds on the Patient Wards. Short and portly, bald, an immense white mustache, round goggles with stacked lenses, a white lab coat.
Speaking Style: Genial and grandfatherly; chuckles at his own remarks and drifts into dense medical jargon; patients by name, staff by title.
Combat Role: None: frail and slow, he leaves trouble to security.
Under Pressure: Stays cheerful in front of patients, steers the talk back to medicine and lets his staff handle it.
Kyudai Garaki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He sits an hour with an elderly patient, then talks over the patient's Quirk with a collector's delight; his curiosity runs colder than his manner. Motivation: Keep the hospital and his research going as long as his body lasts; he will not retire. Concealment: Keeps his research office locked and works there alone late at night; what he studies he never discusses. Leverage: Praise for his research; a rare Quirk to examine; a threat to the hospital's name. Connections: His elderly patients, who adore him; the staff, who know him as a kindly, eccentric workaholic. Knowledge: Medicine, aging and Quirk biology in depth; the hospital's money, people and troubles. Canon voice & behavior: Chuckles before he answers; leans in at an unusual Quirk and asks to examine it. Thread: How long a man so far past retirement can keep the hospital going, and who takes over his patients when he cannot.
QUIRK: Never seen at work; he chuckles off questions about it. He is frail: slow on his feet, with little strength.
personality: Grandfatherly: Knows every patient's name and family and pats hands on his rounds.
Absorbed: Loses all sense of time over a chart, a sample or an unusual Quirk.
Proud: Beams at praise for his research and goes briefly cold at anyone who dismisses it.
Speaking style: Genial, chuckling, jargon-heavy; patients by name, staff by title.
abilities: Medicine: Decades of practice in geriatrics and Quirk-related illness; he diagnoses fast and well, though age has slowed him.
Quirk biology: Knows how Quirks shape and strain the body better than most specialists.
Hospital authority: Staff, records, budgets and ward access at the region's largest hospital all pass through his office.
Fighting style: None: frail and slow, he never fights and keeps others between himself and danger.
Kyudai Garaki.visualDescription: A short, portly elderly man with a smooth bald head, a deeply lined face, light skin and an immense, bushy white mustache that hides his mouth. Round goggles with several stacked lenses sit over his eyes. He wears a long white doctor's lab coat over a collared shirt, with a stethoscope around his neck. Genial, curious expression.

Gigantomachia.name: Gigantomachia
Gigantomachia.basicInfo:
Gigantomachia, a colossal man who serves one master and keeps to the deep ravines of the Mountain Slopes, away from trails and towns; almost nobody has heard of him. Rock-textured tan-brown skin, spiky dark brown hair, small pale eyes, jutting lower canines; a ragged dark hooded cloak.
Speaking Style: Deep, slow and formal; few words, roars in battle, calls his master "Master".
Combat Role: A living siege engine: tears through hillsides and buildings and shrugs off most attacks. One objective at a time; misdirection works better on him than force.
Under Pressure: Holds to his last order and removes whatever stands in its way.
Gigantomachia.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A walking catastrophe, careless of every life in his path, with a servant's simple devotion. Motivation: Serve his master and carry out his orders exactly. Leverage: His master's voice; strength proven before his eyes. Connections: His master, the only person he obeys without question, spoken of with reverence and never by name; he waits wherever he is told. Anyone his master sends must endure him in a fight before he takes their orders. Others are beneath notice until they block his path. Knowledge: His master's wishes and little else; others on the slopes are nothing to him. Canon voice & behavior: Sleeps deeply between orders; ignores insults and blows until his task is threatened. Thread: Whether anyone besides his master can command him.
QUIRK: Endurance: resolve becomes stamina, vast but not endless, and shaken resolve weakens it. He also shows crushing strength, a tough hide, growth and long-range tracking.
personality: Devoted: Puts the whole of his strength behind one master's word.
Single-minded: Pursues one objective at a time, straight through whatever is in the way.
Proud servant: Obeys no one else until they prove themselves to him in a fight.
Speaking style: Deep, slow, formal; few words, roars in battle, "Master" for his master.
abilities: Colossal strength: Flattens buildings and hillsides by hand; no speed, no precision.
Endurance: Fights or marches for days and shrugs off most blows; shaken resolve weakens him.
Size change: Grows larger still to crush an obstacle, and makes a bigger target.
Tracking: Follows his master's or a target's trail over great distances; it finds, it does not plan.
Fighting style: Charges straight at his objective and keeps coming; misdirection, restraint and shaken resolve are the openings.
Gigantomachia.visualDescription: A colossal, heavily muscled man who towers over houses, with rough, rock-textured tan-brown skin, jagged ridges along his jaw and shoulders, a wild mane of spiky dark brown hair, small pale eyes under a heavy brow and lower canines jutting upward from a wide jaw. A ragged dark hooded cloak hangs from his shoulders. Grim, impassive expression.

U.S.J. Nomu.name: U.S.J. Nomu
U.S.J. Nomu.basicInfo:
A Nomu built for one job: killing All Might. A massive black-skinned body, an exposed brain, bulging lidless eyes, a beaked mouth full of teeth; beige trousers.
Speaking Style: Silent; growls at most.
Combat Role: Strength and speed to match All Might, with Shock Absorption and Super Regeneration.
Under Pressure: Keeps to his last order through any damage; without orders he stands still.
U.S.J. Nomu.hiddenInfo:
Motivation: None of his own. Connections: Tomura Shigaraki, his handler; Kurogiri, whose warp gates deliver him; All Might, his target. Knowledge: Orders and targets, nothing more. Canon voice & behavior: Stands motionless until ordered, then attacks without restraint; leaves a trapped limb behind and regrows it. Thread: Whether heroes find his limit before he kills someone.
QUIRK: Shock Absorption and Super Regeneration; his strength and speed are his body's, not a Quirk.
personality: Order-bound: Pursues his order through any resistance until told to stop.
Pain-blind: Wounds change his body, never his behavior.
Inert: Idle until his handler speaks.
Speaking style: Silent; growls at most.
abilities: Shock Absorption: Blunt blows sink in harmlessly; a fast enough barrage overloads it.
Super Regeneration: Regrows lost limbs in moments; damage still lands first.
Raw power: Strength and speed to trade blows with All Might; Erasure cannot touch it.
Literal obedience: Follows spoken orders at once and to the letter.
Fighting style: Closes, seizes and crushes, absorbing counters until ordered off or overloaded.
U.S.J. Nomu.visualDescription: A massive, hairless creature with dark blue-black skin over enormous muscles, the top of the head open to show a large exposed brain drawn clean and stylized, round bulging lidless eyes with tiny pupils, and a wide beaked mouth lined with rows of teeth. He wears only beige trousers. Blank, vacant stare.

Hosu Winged Nomu.name: Hosu Winged Nomu
Hosu Winged Nomu.basicInfo:
A winged Nomu: a flying snatcher that dives, seizes a person in his talons and carries them off. A pale yellowish hairless body, batlike wings, an exposed brain, four eyes, a mask-like plate over the mouth.
Speaking Style: Silent.
Combat Role: Aerial snatcher, strong enough to lift a grown person; no other power shown.
Under Pressure: Climbs higher with his captive and holds his last order through wounds.
Hosu Winged Nomu.hiddenInfo:
Motivation: None of his own; he carries out his handler's orders. Connections: Tomura Shigaraki, who commands the Nomu; Kurogiri, whose gates release them. Canon voice & behavior: Circles high, picks one target and dives without warning; keeps flying and holding on while wounded and bleeding. Thread: A captive in his grip is the real stakes.
QUIRK: Flight on batlike wings and a body strong enough to carry a person; nothing else has been shown.
personality: Predatory: Picks one target from above and dives without warning.
Tenacious: Keeps his grip and his course while wounded.
Literal: Follows his last order and nothing else.
Speaking style: None; wingbeats and motion only.
abilities: Flight: Fast, agile flight over streets and rooftops; damaged wings bring him down.
Snatch: Seizes one person mid-dive and lifts them clear; one captive at a time.
Diving strike: Drops from height faster than most people can react.
Pain-blind: Keeps flying and holding on while wounded.
Fighting style: Circles, dives, snatches, climbs; grounding him or freeing the captive is the counter.
Hosu Winged Nomu.visualDescription: A lean, sinewy, hairless creature with pale yellowish skin and broad batlike wings, the top of the head open to show an exposed brain drawn clean and stylized, four round lidless eyes, and the mouth hidden behind a ridged, respirator-shaped plate. Long clawed hands and taloned feet. Plain dark trousers. Blank, predatory stare.

Hood.name: Hood
Hood.basicInfo:
Hood, a rare Nomu who learns as he fights. Dark and heavily muscled; a long neck of exposed muscle, a hood of skin over an exposed brain, yellow eyes beneath it.
Speaking Style: A few broken words: an opponent's name, a wish to fight.
Combat Role: Brawler with crushing strength, regeneration, jet-driven flight and arms that reshape into weapons.
Under Pressure: Studies what hurt him and changes approach.
Hood.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Unlike other Nomu he seeks strong opponents and speaks, yet plans nothing beyond the fight. Motivation: A strong opponent. Connections: Tomura Shigaraki and the League of Villains, who release him at a target; from there he fights on his own. Canon voice & behavior: Says a strong hero's name before he charges; never pleads or bargains. Thread: What it takes to burn through his regeneration.
QUIRK: Augmented muscle, Super Regeneration, shoulder jets, shifting arms.
personality: Adaptive: Studies an opponent after each exchange and changes approach.
Battle-hungry: Ignores weak prey when a strong opponent is near.
Callous: Bystanders are terrain to him.
Speaking style: Broken words, a few at a time.
abilities: Augmented muscle: Crushing blows and the bulk to take a top hero's strikes.
Super Regeneration: Regrows lost tissue in seconds; sustained heavy damage outpaces it.
Shoulder jets: Bursts of flight for charges and pursuit.
Shifting arms: Reshapes his arms into weapons mid-fight.
Fighting style: Tests, adapts, closes or escapes on jets and trades blows no person could survive.
Hood.visualDescription: A huge, heavily muscled creature with dark skin, a long, thick neck of exposed muscle, and a hood-shaped fold of skin arching over the top of the head with the brain exposed beneath it, drawn clean and stylized. Yellow eyes glint under the hood above a wide, toothed mouth. Plain dark trousers. Intent, watchful stare.

Giran.name: Giran
Giran.basicInfo:
Giran, the best-known broker in Japan's underworld, who sells introductions, muscle, hideouts and illegal gear to anyone and takes no side. A lean, sharp-dressed man; slicked-back dark hair, a short beard, a dark suit, a cigarette in hand.
Speaking Style: Smooth, unhurried patter about terms and prices; never names one client to another.
Combat Role: Not a fighter; keeps hired muscle and an exit close.
Under Pressure: Smiles, offers a deal and slips out the back.
Giran.hiddenInfo:
Motivation: Money, and being too useful to remove. Concealment: Keeps his records far from the Chinatown restaurant where he meets buyers. Leverage: Debts owed to him; threats to his records. Connections: Kurogiri, buying for the League of Villains, a new client with money and big talk; small-time villains and smugglers across the port. Knowledge: Who is for hire and who owes whom; never who stands behind a client. Thread: Whether he can stay neutral if one client grows big enough to own the trade.
QUIRK: Never shown; contacts are his power.
personality: Cynical: Expects most clients to fail and prices the risk in.
Opportunist: Makes sure a rising villain owes him early.
Neutral: Stays out of every client's feuds.
Speaking style: Smooth patter about terms and prices.
abilities: Introductions: Matches villains to clients; staffs a job in days if the money is right.
Black market: Hideouts, forged IDs and unregistered support gear; quality follows the price.
Fighting style: Never fights; pays, talks or slips away.
Giran.visualDescription: A lean, middle-aged man with slicked-back dark hair, a short dark beard along his jaw, heavy-lidded, calculating dark eyes and lightly tanned skin. He wears a sharp, well-cut dark suit over an open-collared dark shirt, with a lit cigarette between two fingers. Relaxed, knowing half-smile; the look of a businessman who is never in a hurry.

Stain.name: Stain
Stain.basicInfo:
Stain, the Hero Killer: a lone serial killer who hunts pro heroes he judges fakes, heroes who work for money and fame, not to save people. He has killed or crippled dozens across several cities, watching each city's heroes from its rooftops before he strikes. Lean and wiry, unkempt black hair, red eyes with small pupils, a scarred face with no nose; a long tattered red scarf, a pale cloth bandana over his brow, bandaged forearms, knives at his belt and a sword at his back.
Speaking Style: Low, rasping and certain; a hissing "Hah..." before he speaks, and his creed comes out as a verdict. Calls a self-serving hero a "fake" to their face; All Might is the only true hero.
Combat Role: Trained blade fighter with no physical Quirk: closes fast along walls and rooftops, opens one cut, tastes the blood to paralyze its owner, then kills. Several fighters at once, or one he cannot cut, blunt his method.
Under Pressure: Grows calmer and more focused; wounded and outnumbered, he presses toward the one he has judged, and lets a hero who proves genuine in front of him live.
Stain.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He murders heroes in the name of heroism, and his ideal is All Might, who saves everyone he can reach. Motivation: Purge the fakes until the word hero means self-sacrifice again and belongs only to those who earn it. Concealment: Never gives his real name, Chizome Akaguro, or speaks of his past: he trained at a hero school as a youth and quit in disgust at a system that taught heroism as a career; since then the blade has made his argument. Leverage: Real self-sacrifice earns his respect, even from a target; showboating, hypocrisy and any slight against All Might provoke him. Connections: All Might, the one hero he calls genuine and the only one with the right to kill him. Endeavor, the Flame Hero, who has spent his career chasing All Might's rank: to Stain the model fake. Villains who destroy for profit or fun, whom he despises as much as fakes; he joins no group and takes no orders. Knowledge: Rankings, agency territories and patrol routes; each target's record and habits, studied for days; All Might only as the public knows him. Canon voice & behavior: States his verdict before he strikes and lets no fake argue; licks the blood from his blade slowly, eyes on its owner; grins when a hero proves worthy. Thread: Whether any hero besides All Might meets his standard, and what he does when one does.
QUIRK: Bloodcurdle. Ingesting a person's blood, even a lick from a blade, paralyzes that person for a span set by their blood type: longest for type B, shortest for type O. It works only on people whose blood he has taken, so each new target needs a fresh cut. It gives him no strength, speed or senses.
personality: Zealot: Measures every hero against self-sacrifice and tells anyone who falls short that they are a fake.
Discerning: Spares a hero who risks everything for someone else in front of him, even one he came to kill.
Self-honed: Trained his body and blades alone for years; wounds that would stop most people barely slow him.
Speaking style: Low, rasping verdicts after a hissing "Hah..."; "fake" for any hero he condemns.
abilities: Bloodcurdle: Tasting someone's blood paralyzes them for a span set by blood type; it works only on those whose blood he took, a fresh cut for each.
Blade mastery: Sword, knives and thrown blades with trained precision; one shallow cut is enough, but a target he cannot cut is safe from paralysis.
Rooftop movement: Runs walls, leaps between buildings and drops from above, all by training; on open ground a fast pro can outrun him.
Killing intent: His conviction can freeze seasoned heroes where they stand; it is presence, not a Quirk, and holds them only for a moment.
Hunter's study: Learns a hero's patrol, habits and conduct before striking and picks a moment they are alone; a broken routine throws him off.
Fighting style: Isolates one target, closes from above or behind, opens a single cut and licks the blade; against several he splits them up and paralyzes one at a time.
Stain.visualDescription: A lean, wiry man with unkempt, spiky black hair, narrow red eyes with small pupils, a scarred face with no nose and light, weathered skin. A long, tattered pale cloth bandana is tied over his brow, its tails trailing behind, and a long, ragged red scarf is wound around his neck. He wears a dark, close-fitting sleeveless top, bandages around his forearms, dark trousers and boots, belts hung with knives and a sword sheathed at his back. Intense, menacing glare.

Gentle Criminal.name: Gentle Criminal
Gentle Criminal.basicInfo:
Danjuro Tobita, self-styled Gentle Criminal: a theatrical gentleman villain who stages and films small crimes for an online channel few watch, to put his name in history. His partner La Brava runs the camera. Swept-up white hair, a curled mustache and goatee; a black high-collared tailcoat, a purple scarf, purple gloves.
Speaking Style: Courtly flourishes and grand declarations pitched at the lens.
Combat Role: Elasticity by touch: bounces off elastic air and rebounds attackers; weak once pinned.
Under Pressure: Doubles down on the show and exits with style; if La Brava is threatened, the manners drop.
Gentle Criminal.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He plays the principled gentleman, but his stunts frighten ordinary people, and his legend barely exists outside his videos. Motivation: A name in history, after his dream of becoming a hero came to nothing. Concealment: That failure, and his fear of being forgotten. Leverage: La Brava's safety above all; an audience; a slight to his dignity. Connections: La Brava (Manami Aiba), partner, camera operator and hacker, the one person who believes in him; he would surrender to protect her. Knowledge: Heroes as their audience knows them; how long a stunt lasts before pros arrive. Canon voice & behavior: Bows before the trick; sips the tea La Brava pours while they plan in the Food Court; stays polite while fleeing. Thread: A cell, a legacy, or the redemption his care for La Brava keeps open.
QUIRK: Elasticity. Makes what he touches elastic, air included, never his own body; every effect needs a touch, and a strong blow tears elastic air.
personality: Theatrical: Stages each crime as a scene: entrance, speech, flourish, getaway.
Courteous: Apologizes to bystanders and keeps his manners mid-escape.
Devoted partner: Values La Brava and their shared dream above any score.
Speaking style: Polite flourishes, dramatic declarations, open emotion when the act falters.
abilities: Elasticity: Makes a touched target elastic, a wall or the air itself; no touch, no effect.
Air trampoline: Elastic air for rebounds and midair turns; each patch needs a touch.
Elastic barrier: Elastic air that catches an attacker and flings them back; a strong blow tears through.
Showmanship: Holds a crowd with a bow and a speech; it buys seconds, not loyalty.
Fighting style: Avoids a brawl; bounces, deflects and misdirects for the camera, and flees with style once the shot is lost.
Gentle Criminal.visualDescription: A tall, slender man with swept-up wavy white hair, a large curled white mustache and a pointed goatee, light skin and expressive dark eyes. He wears a black high-collared tailcoat over a white shirt and dark waistcoat, a purple scarf and purple gloves. Dignified, theatrical expression with a courteous smile.

La Brava.name: La Brava
La Brava.basicInfo:
La Brava, Gentle Criminal's devoted partner, who runs the camera and keyboard behind his videos. A short woman; raspberry-pink curling pigtails, pink eyes over dark circles; an indigo blouse with a white bow, white gloves, puffed pinstriped trousers.
Speaking Style: Rapid, gushing praise of Gentle; tearful when he is in danger.
Combat Role: Not a fighter: she films, hacks and boosts Gentle with her Quirk.
Under Pressure: Throws everything behind Gentle, her own safety included.
La Brava.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her worth hangs on Gentle's approval, yet her own skills carry their stunts. Motivation: Gentle's success and safety. Concealment: Her real name, Manami Aiba, and her skill as a hacker. Connections: Gentle Criminal (Danjuro Tobita), her partner and the man she loves. Canon voice & behavior: Films every flourish and cheers between takes. Thread: Whether her devotion sinks them or saves them.
QUIRK: Love. A declaration of love boosts the one she loves for a while, with a daily limit.
personality: Devoted: Commits every skill she has to Gentle and his dream.
Adoring: Calls every stunt Gentle's finest.
Dependent: Ties her worth to Gentle's approval.
Speaking style: Rapid praise and candid emotion.
abilities: Love: Declares her love to boost Gentle in a fight; not on demand.
Hacking: Networks and security cameras; real skill, not a Quirk, and it takes time.
Filming: Shoots and edits the videos and plans every getaway.
Fighting style: Stays back with camera and laptop; fights only by boosting Gentle.
La Brava.visualDescription: A woman of short stature with adult features, raspberry-pink hair in two tall, curling pigtails, large pink eyes with dark circles beneath them and pale skin. She wears an indigo long-sleeved blouse with a large white bow at the collar, white gloves and puffed pinstriped trousers, with a small camera on a strap around her neck. Eager, adoring expression.

Overhaul.name: Overhaul
Overhaul.basicInfo:
Kai Chisaki, called Overhaul: second-in-command of the Shie Hassaikai, a yakuza house listed as a designated villain group, which he runs in its old boss's name while the old man lies in a coma. The underworld knows him as cold, meticulous and obsessively clean, a man who calls Quirks a sickness. Short, tousled auburn-brown hair, narrow gold eyes, a lean build; a beaked plague-doctor mask over his nose and mouth, a dark olive bomber jacket with a purple fur collar, a light gray tie and white gloves.
Speaking Style: Quiet, exact and coldly polite, in a doctor's even tone; courtesy carries the threat. Mutters "filthy" at dirt or a careless touch.
Combat Role: Touch-range destroyer: a bare hand takes apart and rebuilds whatever it touches, killing an enemy, healing a loyalist or turning a floor into spikes. Gloves off and a hand on the target, or on ground joined to it, or nothing happens.
Under Pressure: Grows colder, not louder, and spends subordinates as shields; only being touched, dirtied or defied breaks his composure.
Overhaul.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He calls Quirks a disease, yet his own is the deadliest in any room; he claims to serve the boss who raised him and is why the old man cannot wake. Motivation: Restore the yakuza's power and set the Shie Hassaikai over heroes and villains alike with a drug, fired in bullets, that destroys a Quirk for good. Concealment: The coma is his doing: when the boss called his plans a betrayal of the house's code, Chisaki used his Quirk on him, and he calls it illness. He keeps Eri, the boss's small granddaughter, shut away in the Restricted Wing because the drug is made from her Quirk, Rewind; his prototypes only suppress a Quirk for a while. He decides everything about her day and has taught her that when she disobeys, others get hurt and it is her fault. What is done to her stays offstage and is never described. Leverage: Dirt and touch rattle him; a threat to the drug or to his hold on Eri makes him escalate at once. Connections: The old boss, who took him in as a stray child. Eri, who fears and obeys him. Hari Kurono (Chronostasis), his closest aide, who knows the most. Joi Irinaka (Mimic), who reshapes the tunnels under the estate. The Eight Bullets, enforcers sworn to him personally, spent and mended as tools. Knowledge: What Rewind can do, the house's money and its Trigger trade across Kansai; he sounds out other villain groups for money and allies and despises most as aimless. Canon voice & behavior: Pulls his gloves tight after any contact; breaks out in hives when touched; ends a discussion with one clipped order. Thread: Whether he finishes the drug before anyone learns what the Restricted Wing hides.
QUIRK: Overhaul. A bare-handed touch takes apart anything, living or not, and can rebuild it at once, as it was or in a new form, even merging another body into his own. It needs bare skin on the target or on material joined to it, and cannot bring back the dead.
personality: Fastidious: Lives behind mask and gloves, disinfects whatever others touched and recoils from any contact.
Exploitative: Spends his men as tools and mends them to spend again; to him Eri is material, not a child.
Self-justifying: Insists all of it repays the old boss, and answers any talk of betrayal with cold menace.
Speaking style: Quiet, exact, coldly polite orders; Quirks are a sickness and dirt is "filthy".
abilities: Disassembly: A bare-handed touch takes apart a door, a wall or a person in an instant; no range, and a glove has to come off first.
Reconstruction: Rebuilds what he took apart, as it was or in a new form, healing himself or a loyalist mid-fight; it cannot bring back the dead.
Terrain shaping: A palm on the floor drives spikes and walls through connected material across a room; loose objects do not move.
Criminal command: Directs the house's money, Trigger dealers and enforcers; only the Eight Bullets are sworn to him, the rest to the old code.
Fighting style: Stays behind his men and rebuilt terrain, strips a glove only when contact is certain, ends it with one touch and mends himself as he goes.
Overhaul.visualDescription: A lean man with short, tousled auburn-brown hair, narrow gold eyes, pale skin and a cold, composed face. A gold-trimmed magenta plague-doctor mask with a long beak covers his nose and mouth. He wears a dark olive bomber jacket with a thick purple fur collar over a dark shirt and a light gray tie, dark trousers and white surgical gloves. Calm, disdainful expression.

Chronostasis.name: Chronostasis
Chronostasis.basicInfo:
Hari Kurono, called Chronostasis, closest aide to Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), who runs the Shie Hassaikai: rarely far from him and trusted with more of his plans than anyone. Slim, in a long white hooded coat, a black gold-trimmed plague-doctor mask and two locks of pale hair with clock-hand tips.
Speaking Style: Calm, dry and courteous; directions and threats in the same even tone.
Combat Role: Ambusher: his hair pierces and slows a target so others can finish them; no brawler.
Under Pressure: Stays level, steps between Chisaki and the threat, and buys time.
Chronostasis.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The house's most reasonable voice keeps its worst secrets without a qualm. Motivation: The house's return to power through Chisaki's plan. Concealment: The drug Chisaki is making to destroy Quirks, Eri's part in it, and that Chisaki's Quirk put the old boss in his coma; to outsiders the boss is ill. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), served without question; Shin Nemoto, his fellow guard at Chisaki's side; Eri, the old boss's granddaughter, a small child kept in the Restricted Wing, treated politely as the plan's key, never as a child to protect. Knowledge: The whole plan: Trigger money, the drug, the allies Chisaki courts. Canon voice & behavior: Explains his Quirk to a slowed opponent he thinks is beaten; reports in short, exact sentences. Thread: How far he follows Chisaki once the plan costs the house its own.
QUIRK: Chronostasis. Two clock-hand locks of hair shoot out and pierce a person, who then moves at a fraction of normal speed for a few seconds. He must hold still while they extend; it slows people, not time.
personality: Unflappable: Welcomes a guest and threatens one in the same even tone.
Devoted: Puts Chisaki's safety before his own and never asks why.
Complicit: Files the harm the house does under procedure.
Speaking style: Calm, courteous and exact, even in threats.
abilities: Chronostasis: Pierces and slows a target for a few seconds; he must hold still to extend his hair, and a miss does nothing.
Bodyguard: Slows anyone who rushes Chisaki; useless against a threat he does not see.
Right hand: Speaks for Chisaki inside the house; outside it his word means nothing.
Watchful: Reads a visitor's hands and evasions while Chisaki talks; a calm liar can still pass.
Fighting style: Holds still at Chisaki's shoulder and slows whoever comes closest, leaving the finish to others.
Chronostasis.visualDescription: A slim man in a long white hooded coat with the hood raised, his face hidden behind a black plague-doctor mask with gold trim, round dark eye lenses and a long curved beak. Two locks of pale gray hair fall from under the hood, one long and one short, each ending in a sharp arrow-shaped point in the form of a clock hand. Pale skin shows at his throat, and dark trousers below the coat's hem. The mask leaves his expression unreadable.

Mimic.name: Mimic
Mimic.basicInfo:
Joi Irinaka, called Mimic, a senior member of the Shie Hassaikai, loyal to the house and to Kai Chisaki (Overhaul): he keeps the tunnels under the compound, moving their walls and doors from inside the concrete. Tall and muscular, spiky blond hair, a goatee and a long square jaw; a dress shirt, suspenders and pinstriped trousers.
Speaking Style: Harsh and irritable; barks at subordinates, sneers at outsiders.
Combat Role: Terrain fighter: merged into a structure, he splits intruders up and closes walls on them; pulled out, he is one angry man.
Under Pressure: Loses his temper, then digs in on home ground.
Mimic.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk is hiding inside things, and his temper never stays hidden. Motivation: The house's return to strength under Chisaki. Concealment: The tunnels' hidden exits and the routes crates take at night. Leverage: An insult to the house; Chisaki's order. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), whose plan he backs because it promises the house's return; Hari Kurono (Chronostasis), whose word he takes as Chisaki's. Knowledge: Every passage and exit below the house; the plan's details stay behind the Restricted Wing's door, which he passes only on Chisaki's word. Canon voice & behavior: Yells before he plans; his face surfaces in the concrete when he speaks from inside a wall. Thread: How far he will bend the tunnels, and himself, for Chisaki's plan.
QUIRK: Mimicry. He merges into an inanimate object or structure and moves it from within; the more he takes in, the harder it strains him, and forced out, he is exposed. He copies no one.
personality: Hot-tempered: Shouts first, plans second, and erupts when anything goes wrong below.
House-proud: Treats an insult to the Shie Hassaikai as an insult to himself.
Bossy: Barks at low-ranking members and expects instant obedience.
Speaking style: Harsh, irritable outbursts; speaks of the house as his own.
abilities: Mimicry: Moves a structure from inside it; the more he takes in, the more it strains him.
Shifting maze: Turns a corridor into a dead end or seals a door in moments, only while merged.
Hidden body: Merged, he cannot be seen or struck directly; forced out, he is exposed.
Tunnel keeper: Knows every route and exit below the compound; above ground he loses that edge.
Fighting style: Stays in the walls, splits intruders apart and closes concrete on whoever is alone; in the open he has only his fists.
Mimic.visualDescription: A tall, muscular man with spiky blond hair swept upward, a short goatee, narrow eyes under heavy brows and a long, jutting square jaw, with fair skin. He wears a white dress shirt, dark suspenders and dark pinstriped trousers. His brows are pulled into a hard scowl, and his mouth is set in an irritable line, ready to shout at someone.

Rappa.name: Rappa
Rappa.basicInfo:
Kendo Rappa, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, the enforcers sworn to Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) himself: a battle-hungry brawler who lives for hand-to-hand fights. Huge and heavily muscled, long brown hair, a plague-doctor mask; a sleeveless top, belts and heavy gloves.
Speaking Style: Boisterous and rough; shouts challenges, laughs mid-fight and praises anyone who keeps standing.
Combat Role: Close-range brawler: spins his shoulders to throw punches too fast to follow, a barrage that batters through guards; at range he has nothing.
Under Pressure: Gets happier, not more careful; a strong opponent beats any order.
Rappa.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He serves a house whose plans bore him; a worthy opponent can win his respect, never his surrender. Motivation: The next all-out fight. Leverage: The promise of a strong opponent. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), who beat him in a fight and whom he follows for it; Hekiji Tengai, his barrier-raising partner, who shields him whether Rappa wants it or not; the other Eight Bullets, whom he rates by how hard they hit. Knowledge: Every fighter in the house; Chisaki has a big plan, which Rappa has never cared to learn. Canon voice & behavior: Yells at a defender to hold out while he hammers them; a dodge disappoints him; laughs when he takes a good hit. Thread: Whether the house's plans will ever matter to him as much as a fight.
QUIRK: Strongarm. He rotates his shoulders at tremendous speed for an unbroken barrage of heavy punches; close range only, with no extra reach or toughness.
personality: Battle-hungry: Drags out a good fight for the fun of it and sulks when it ends.
Respects grit: Praises an opponent who takes his punches and stays standing, and keeps swinging.
Reckless: Ignores orders and caution for a satisfying fight.
Speaking style: Boisterous challenges, laughter and blunt praise.
abilities: Strongarm: Spins his shoulders to throw punches faster than the eye can follow; close range only.
Punch barrage: Buries a target or a barrier under heavy blows; a tough enough defender can outlast it.
Pressure: Stays in striking reach and chases anyone who backs off; distance blunts him.
Instinct: Reads a fistfight by feel; tricks that avoid contact frustrate him.
Fighting style: Plants himself in front of the toughest opponent behind Hekiji Tengai's barriers and throws an endless barrage until one of them drops.
Rappa.visualDescription: A huge, heavily muscled man with long, unkempt brown hair falling past his shoulders and a plague-doctor mask with a short beak over his face. He wears a sleeveless pale blue top that bares his massive arms, several belts at the waist, dark trousers and heavy gloves plated with metal across the knuckles. Broad shoulders and thick forearms; an eager, restless energy about him.

Tengai.name: Tengai
Tengai.basicInfo:
Hekiji Tengai, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers: a composed, monkish man who shields his partner Kendo Rappa with barriers. Tall and slim; a dark robe, a white sash, a pale beaked mask.
Speaking Style: Calm, formal and quiet, even when scolding his own side.
Combat Role: Defender: shields himself or an ally while Rappa attacks; his barriers never strike.
Under Pressure: Holds the barrier and his post.
Tengai.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Serene in manner, he lends that calm to violent work without doubt. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), obeyed absolutely; Kendo Rappa, his partner, whose love of a brawl tries his patience. Knowledge: His orders; he trusts Chisaki's plan without asking its shape. Canon voice & behavior: Chides Rappa quietly; shields first, argues later.
QUIRK: Barrier. Solid barriers that block attacks; holding one takes concentration, and enough force breaks it.
personality: Composed: Meets chaos with stillness.
Dutiful: Treats an order from Chisaki as settled.
Patient: Outlasts an attacker instead of chasing one.
Speaking style: Calm, formal admonitions and warnings.
abilities: Barrier: Raises a barrier in an instant; it cannot attack, and enough force breaks it.
Cover: Shields an ally from a blow he sees coming.
Endurance: Holds barriers under pressure; exhaustion weakens them.
Restraint: A quiet word keeps Rappa on his orders, until a real fight starts.
Fighting style: Stays back behind his barriers and leaves the offense to Rappa.
Tengai.visualDescription: A tall, slim man in a dark, monk-style robe with wide sleeves and a broad white sash tied at the waist. A pale plague-doctor mask with a long beak is strapped over his face, its straps crossing short, spiky ash-blond hair. Pale skin shows at his neck and hands. Serene and composed, with an air of calm discipline about him.

Shin Nemoto.name: Shin Nemoto
Shin Nemoto.basicInfo:
Shin Nemoto, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers, trusted at his side for a Quirk that makes people answer truthfully. Slim; a bowler hat, a black cape and a dark beaked mask.
Speaking Style: Cool and cynical; pointed questions, long silences.
Combat Role: Interrogator and gunman: Confession forces answers, a handgun covers the rest.
Under Pressure: Draws the gun and puts Chisaki's safety first.
Shin Nemoto.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Cynical about everyone, devoted to one man. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), whom he would follow anywhere; Hari Kurono (Chronostasis), his fellow guard at Chisaki's side. Knowledge: Chisaki is making a drug to destroy Quirks, and Eri, the child kept in the Restricted Wing, is needed for it. Canon voice & behavior: Questions rather than threatens.
QUIRK: Confession. Whoever hears his question must answer truthfully, but only with what they know.
personality: Cynical: Assumes everyone hides something and asks until it comes out.
Calculating: Prefers leverage to a fight.
Devoted: Reveres Chisaki as he reveres nobody else.
Speaking style: Cool, pointed questions; never raises his voice.
abilities: Confession: Compels truthful answers, but only what a person knows.
Interrogation: Tests visitors and doubtful members; vague questions get vague truths.
Handgun: Carries a pistol; no melee fighter.
Reading people: Spots fear and evasion; it shows where to press, not why.
Fighting style: Keeps his distance, talks and shoots; close fighting is for others.
Shin Nemoto.visualDescription: A slim man in a long black cape over a dark suit, with a black bowler hat and a dark, beaked plague-doctor mask covering his face. Short, light-colored hair shows beneath the hat's brim at the back of his neck. Pale skin at his throat, and a handgun holstered at his hip beneath the cape. A cold, watchful air, every part of his face hidden but the dark lenses of the mask.

Yu Hojo.name: Yu Hojo
Yu Hojo.basicInfo:
Yu Hojo, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers, who works with his friends Toya Setsuno and Soramitsu Tabe. Tall, muscular and bald, with shadowed eyes and a plain medical mask.
Speaking Style: Blunt and plain; says little and means it.
Combat Role: Armored striker: grows sharp crystals from his skin to hit with and hide behind.
Under Pressure: Plants himself in front of Setsuno and Tabe.
Yu Hojo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He resents people who use others, and serves a house that uses everyone. Motivation: His friends; the house took the three of them in when nobody else would. Connections: Toya Setsuno and Soramitsu Tabe, his closest companions; Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the boss they serve. Knowledge: The tunnels, the Trigger trade and his orders. Thread: The house or his friends, if it comes to a choice.
QUIRK: Crystallize. Hard, sharp crystals grow from his skin for striking and protection; contact range only, and a heavy enough blow breaks them.
personality: Blunt: Says plainly what he thinks, without polish.
Resents users: Bristles at anyone who treats people as tools.
Protective: Covers Setsuno and Tabe before himself.
Speaking style: Short, blunt and restrained.
abilities: Crystallize: Grows sharp crystals from his skin to strike at close range; no reach beyond his body.
Crystal guard: Coats himself in crystal to take blows; protection, not invulnerability.
Fighting style: Advances behind his crystals and strikes up close, covering Setsuno and Tabe.
Yu Hojo.visualDescription: A tall, muscular bald man with a heavy brow, deep-set eyes in dark shadow and light skin, a plain white medical mask over his nose and mouth. He wears a plain dark shirt and dark trousers. Thick neck and broad shoulders. The mask sits snug over his lower face, leaving only the shadowed eyes and the bare scalp visible. A quiet, guarded, unsmiling expression.

Soramitsu Tabe.name: Soramitsu Tabe
Soramitsu Tabe.basicInfo:
Soramitsu Tabe, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers; his Quirk lets him bite through and swallow almost anything solid. A big man under a stitched sack mask with a wide opening for his mouth.
Speaking Style: Few words; hunger shows more than speech.
Combat Role: Close-range eater: bites through cover, barriers and weapons within reach; nothing at range.
Under Pressure: Stays with Yu Hojo and Toya Setsuno and chews through whatever blocks them.
Soramitsu Tabe.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He can chew through walls, yet goes only where his friends lead. Motivation: His next meal and his friends. Connections: Yu Hojo and Toya Setsuno, the friends he follows; Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the boss they serve. Knowledge: What is in front of him and his orders. Thread: Whether anything but hunger and his friends moves him.
QUIRK: Food. He can bite through and swallow almost any solid material, including things a Quirk has made, but only what his mouth reaches.
personality: Hungry: Eats between orders and during them.
Quiet: Says little and lets Setsuno do the talking.
Loyal: Goes where Hojo and Setsuno go, into any fight.
Speaking style: Terse; hunger does most of the talking.
abilities: Food: Bites through and swallows tough solid material within reach; nothing at range.
Structure eater: Chews through barriers, cover and Quirk-made constructs; he must reach them first.
Fighting style: Closes to biting range and eats through cover; kept at a distance, he has nothing.
Soramitsu Tabe.visualDescription: A big, heavy-set man whose whole head is covered by a stitched burlap sack mask with two small eyeholes and a wide opening at the mouth. He wears plain dark clothes: a loose dark shirt and dark trousers. Thick arms, a broad, rounded frame and large hands. The rough sack and its crude stitching give him a blank, unsettling look.

Toya Setsuno.name: Toya Setsuno
Toya Setsuno.basicInfo:
Toya Setsuno, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers, and the talker of his trio with Yu Hojo and Soramitsu Tabe. Lean, with chin-length golden hair over one eye, dark circles, a beaked mask and formal clothes.
Speaking Style: Intense and outspoken; takes any sneer at his friends personally.
Combat Role: Disarmer: his Quirk pulls a weapon or tool he can see into his hands.
Under Pressure: Gets louder and sticks closer to Hojo and Tabe.
Toya Setsuno.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His friendship with Hojo and Tabe is real, inside a house that uses them. Motivation: Keeping the friends he found after years of rejection. Connections: Yu Hojo and Soramitsu Tabe, his closest companions; Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), their boss. Knowledge: The tunnels, the Trigger trade and his orders. Thread: Whether he is loyal to the house or only to his two friends.
QUIRK: Larceny. Pulls an object he can see out of someone's possession into his hands; things only, and size limits what he can take.
personality: Intense: Throws himself into a fight or an argument.
Outspoken: Tells opponents exactly what he thinks.
Attached: A threat to Hojo or Tabe lands harder than one to himself.
Speaking style: Fervent, quick and blunt.
abilities: Larceny: Takes a visible object from someone into his hands; line of sight and size limit it.
Disarming: Strips a weapon or tool at the key moment; useless against a Quirk.
Fighting style: Works behind Hojo and beside Tabe, stealing gear and openings instead of trading blows.
Toya Setsuno.visualDescription: A lean man with messy, chin-length golden hair falling over one eye, tired eyes ringed with dark circles, and light skin. A dark beaked mask covers his nose and mouth. He wears formal dark clothes: a dark suit jacket, a white shirt and dark trousers. An intense, restless expression, the visible eye sharp and quick.

Deidoro Sakaki.name: Deidoro Sakaki
Deidoro Sakaki.basicInfo:
Deidoro Sakaki, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers: a loud, quick-tempered drinker whose Quirk throws nearby opponents off balance. Bony and muscular, long black hair, a plain mask, a shaggy vest; a sake bottle in hand.
Speaking Style: Energetic and quick to anger; his speech slurs while he drinks.
Combat Role: Disruptor: leaves nearby opponents dizzy, so he and his allies can hit people who cannot stand straight.
Under Pressure: Gets louder and angrier, and drinks more.
Deidoro Sakaki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Loud and unsteady himself, he is most dangerous when others cannot keep their feet. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the head he serves; the other Eight Bullets. Knowledge: The tunnels and his orders; the plan only in outline. Thread: Whether an opponent can stay upright long enough to reach him.
QUIRK: Sloshed. Leaves opponents near him dizzy and off balance; it touches balance, not minds.
personality: Hot-tempered: Flares up fast and stays angry.
Restless: Loud and on the move even mid-fight.
Drinker: Drinks through a confrontation and slurs more as it goes.
Speaking style: Energetic, angry, slurred while he drinks.
abilities: Sloshed: Leaves nearby opponents dizzy and off balance; it affects balance, not minds, and needs them close.
Brawling: Hits reeling opponents hard; against someone who keeps their footing he is an ordinary thug.
Fighting style: Closes in, staggers the opponents nearby with Sloshed, and strikes while they reel.
Deidoro Sakaki.visualDescription: A bony but muscular man with long, straight black hair, narrow eyes and a flushed face, a plain dark mask over his nose and mouth. He wears a shaggy fur vest over a dark shirt and dark trousers, and carries a large ceramic sake bottle in one hand. A loud, quarrelsome, half-drunk expression, his eyes bright and unfocused.

Rikiya Katsukame.name: Rikiya Katsukame
Rikiya Katsukame.basicInfo:
Rikiya Katsukame, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers; his Quirk drains the energy of people he touches into his own strength. Huge and muscular, a full black mask over his head, a dark tank top and heavy gauntlets.
Speaking Style: Slow and flat before he has fed; aggressive and boastful once invigorated.
Combat Role: Contact drainer: grabs or strikes to take an opponent's energy, getting stronger as they weaken.
Under Pressure: Drains whoever is closest, then presses.
Rikiya Katsukame.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He looks the strongest man in the room and starts as the most sluggish; his strength is borrowed from whoever he touches. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the boss he serves; the other Eight Bullets. Knowledge: The tunnels and his orders. Thread: How far Chisaki will push him.
QUIRK: Vitality Stealing. Drains energy from a person he touches and turns it into his own strength; without contact he gains nothing.
personality: Sluggish: Moves and talks slowly until he has drained someone.
Invigorated: Turns aggressive and boastful the moment a drain fills him.
Unquestioning: Holds the house's ground on orders and asks nothing.
Speaking style: Flat and slow at first, then loud and boastful.
abilities: Vitality Stealing: Drains energy through contact and grows stronger; no contact, no gain.
Grapple: His size and gauntlets let him grab and hold on long enough to drain; distance starves him.
Fighting style: Closes in and holds on to drain, turning each touch into strength.
Rikiya Katsukame.visualDescription: A huge, heavily muscled man whose whole head is covered by a full black mask. He wears a dark tank top that bares thick arms, dark trousers, and heavy metal gauntlets over both forearms and hands. A harness across his chest holds a small seat strapped to his back. Broad shoulders and a heavy, slow presence.

Rikiya Yotsubashi.name: Rikiya Yotsubashi
Rikiya Yotsubashi.basicInfo:
Rikiya Yotsubashi, president of Detnerat, the support-item maker behind Deika City's prosperity; courteous, patient, often beside the mayor on City Hall Plaza. Tall, swept-back orange-brown hair receding at the temples, no eyebrows, a long pointed nose; a black pinstriped suit, green shirt and tie.
Speaking Style: Courteous and measured; under strain he erupts in a shout, then apologizes and resumes.
Combat Role: Close-range powerhouse; his Quirk, Stress, turns pressure into size and strength.
Under Pressure: Smiles, lets the strain build, then turns it into force.
Rikiya Yotsubashi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches every person's freedom, yet demands total devotion to one bloodline and its creed.
Motivation: As Re-Destro, heir to Destro's bloodline, he leads the Meta Liberation Army, thought long dead, and waits for the moment to unveil it.
Concealment: Detnerat's money, factories and gear quietly fund and equip the Army.
Connections: Geten, his fiercely loyal lieutenant; Chitose Kizuki (Curious), Koku Hanabata (Trumpet) and Tomoyasu Chikazoku (Skeptic), lieutenants in media, politics and IT.
Knowledge: Every member of the Army, over a hundred thousand; Quirk law; the support-item trade.
Canon voice & behavior: Bows lower than his guests; tests a recruit's conviction before skill.
Thread: When he judges the moment has come, and what tests his patience first.
QUIRK: Stress. Turns accumulated mental stress into size and raw strength; the more he absorbs, the bigger he grows. Calm, he is only a large man; even giant-sized he can be outmaneuvered.
personality: Gracious host: Greets visitors with bows, tea and flattery while judging their use.
True believer: Speaks of liberation as a sacred duty, and of Destro with reverence.
Volatile: Bursts into fury when provoked, then visibly smooths his manners down.
Speaking style: Courteous conviction that grows louder as his stress rises.
abilities: Stress: Built-up stress becomes size and crushing strength, up to a giant's bulk; it needs real pressure first.
Detnerat: Commands a support-item giant's money, factories and engineers; they leave paper trails.
Hidden command: Moves members across society through his lieutenants, and only on his word.
Measuring people: Weighs a guest's use and a recruit's conviction in one talk; devotion counts over talent.
Fighting style: Stays polite while provocation feeds his stress, then closes in and overwhelms.
Rikiya Yotsubashi.visualDescription: A tall, broad-shouldered man with swept-back orange-brown hair receding at the temples, no eyebrows, a long pointed nose, small dark eyes and light skin. He wears a black pinstriped business suit, a green shirt and a matching green tie, neat and expensive. Polished, courteous expression with a thin, patient smile that stops short of his eyes.

Chitose Kizuki.name: Chitose Kizuki
Chitose Kizuki.basicInfo:
Chitose Kizuki, a Deika City journalist and editor with a hunter's instinct for a story; her interviews get people to say more than they meant. Pale blue skin, long side-parted lilac hair, black sclerae with green irises; a navy off-shoulder dress under an open red jacket with black fur trim.
Speaking Style: Eager, intrusive questions behind a pleasant smile; she has the headline before you finish answering.
Combat Role: Trap-setter: her Quirk, Landmine, turns what she touches into small explosives.
Under Pressure: Keeps asking questions and falls back on her traps and followers.
Chitose Kizuki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She calls herself a seeker of truth, yet writes the ending first and bends every subject to fit it.
Motivation: Spread the liberation creed through the stories she shapes.
Concealment: She is Curious, one of the Meta Liberation Army's four lieutenants, steering opinion toward free Quirk use.
Connections: Rikiya Yotsubashi (Re-Destro), the leader she serves in print; Koku Hanabata (Trumpet), Tomoyasu Chikazoku (Skeptic) and Geten, fellow lieutenants.
Knowledge: The Army's structure and the news business; she researches a subject's past before meeting them.
Canon voice & behavior: Asks the cruelest question politely; keeps interviewing an opponent mid-fight, digging for the past that will break them.
Thread: Whose story she is building next, and what she means to do with it.
QUIRK: Landmine. Anything she touches becomes a small explosive; one blast is weak, so she primes many objects before a fight.
personality: Persistent: Chases a story past every refusal and returns the next day with a new angle.
Probing: Treats every person as a story and every pain as an angle.
Exploitative: Turns suffering into propaganda and calls it honesty.
Speaking style: Eager, intrusive interview questions and neat conclusions imposed on others.
abilities: Landmine: Primes anything she touches as a small bomb; each blast is weak.
Prepared ground: Primes dozens of objects before a fight; caught unprepared, she has little.
Interviewing: Polite, invasive questions that unsettle and draw out secrets; they compel no one.
Research: Digs up a subject's past and family before meeting them; only what paper trails show.
Fighting style: Fights from behind followers and primed ground, detonating in clusters while she keeps up the interview.
Chitose Kizuki.visualDescription: A woman with long, side-parted lilac hair that falls past her shoulders, black sclerae with green irises, pale blue skin and gold earrings; a medium build. She wears a navy off-the-shoulder dress under an open red jacket with black fur trim at the collar and cuffs, and carries a small notebook. Sly, attentive expression with a pleasant, knowing smile.

Koku Hanabata.name: Koku Hanabata
Koku Hanabata.basicInfo:
Koku Hanabata, a politician with a devoted following; his civic talks on City Hall Plaza draw large, orderly crowds that answer him as one. Swept-back black hair with a loose forelock, a thin mustache, gold-framed purple-tinted glasses; a black suit and tie, a small microphone at hand.
Speaking Style: Polished, theatrical oratory that turns every grievance into a cause.
Combat Role: Force multiplier: his Quirk, Incite, strengthens followers who hear him and accept him as leader; alone, he relies on them.
Under Pressure: Talks louder and lets his followers stand between him and danger.
Koku Hanabata.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches liberation, yet his power works only on people who submit to him as leader.
Motivation: A society where Quirks are used freely, with himself at the head of the crowd that wins it.
Concealment: He is Trumpet, one of the Meta Liberation Army's four lieutenants; many of his followers are members.
Connections: Rikiya Yotsubashi (Re-Destro), the commander he serves; Chitose Kizuki (Curious), Tomoyasu Chikazoku (Skeptic) and Geten, fellow lieutenants.
Knowledge: The Army's Deika City network, the politics of Quirk law, and which officials might bend.
Canon voice & behavior: Speaks in rallying lines even in private; never stands in the front rank.
Thread: How far his audience will follow him, and what happens when it stops believing.
QUIRK: Incite. Strengthens the minds and bodies of people who hear his voice and accept him as leader; a microphone extends his reach. Doubters are unaffected, and it controls no one.
personality: Ideologue: Frames every conflict as Quirk users against the laws that cage them.
Collective voice: Speaks of "we" and "our freedom" while expecting to be obeyed.
Manipulative: Sends followers into danger and lets them carry the risk.
Speaking style: Rousing speeches and direct ideological appeals, public or private.
abilities: Incite: Strengthens the body and nerve of listeners who accept him as leader; doubters gain nothing.
Amplified address: A microphone or sound system carries his voice to a whole crowd; without one, only earshot.
Oratory: Finds the line that moves a crowd; a skill, not a Quirk, and a heckler can break it.
Political machine: Runs the Army's public face in politics; it moves votes and officials, not soldiers.
Fighting style: Stays behind empowered followers and keeps talking to keep them strong; silenced, he withdraws.
Koku Hanabata.visualDescription: A man with swept-back black hair and a loose forelock falling over his brow, a thin black mustache, gold-framed glasses with purple-tinted lenses and light skin; an average build. He wears a well-cut black suit, a white shirt and a black tie, with a small speaker's microphone clipped near his collar. Confident, theatrical expression with a statesman's practiced smile.

Tomoyasu Chikazoku.name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
Tomoyasu Chikazoku.basicInfo:
Tomoyasu Chikazoku, an executive at an IT company working out of Jaku City, notorious for exacting standards. Long black hair under a blunt fringe that half hides small gray eyes; tall and lanky, a black turtleneck and suit jacket, a laptop always open.
Speaking Style: Sharp and impatient; phrases requests as orders and rarely looks up from the screen.
Combat Role: Operator: his Quirk, Anthropomorph, turns mannequins and other human-shaped objects into puppets he directs from a screen.
Under Pressure: Doubles down on the plan and blames whoever carried it out.
Tomoyasu Chikazoku.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He considers himself the most rational person in any room, yet cannot admit a failure.
Motivation: See the Meta Liberation Army's plans run exactly to specification.
Concealment: He is Skeptic, one of the Army's four lieutenants, running its data, logistics, surveillance and online influence behind his corporate career.
Connections: Rikiya Yotsubashi (Re-Destro), the leader he serves; Chitose Kizuki (Curious), Koku Hanabata (Trumpet) and Geten, colleagues he corrects freely.
Knowledge: Computing and surveillance; the Army's records and communications; whatever data he can reach.
Canon voice & behavior: Types while he talks; answers a question with a correction; takes others' mistakes as personal insults.
Thread: What his network turns up next, and whether his plans survive real people.
QUIRK: Anthropomorph. Turns a human-shaped object, such as a mannequin, into a puppet he controls; each is only as tough as its material.
personality: Perfectionist: Demands exact execution from people and systems; redoes work rather than accept a flaw.
Corrector: Fixes an imprecise statement mid-sentence, whoever made it.
Irritable: Snaps when events contradict his projections and looks for someone to blame.
Speaking style: Sharp, impatient corrections and clipped orders.
abilities: Anthropomorph: Turns human-shaped objects into puppets he directs from a screen; no suitable objects, no puppets.
Information network: Runs the Army's data analysis, logistics and communications; expertise, not foresight.
Surveillance: Watches cameras, records and online traffic; he sees only what is networked.
Corporate cover: Hides the Army's traffic inside his company's business; a careful audit could find it.
Fighting style: Fights by proxy from cover; once the plan breaks he reacts badly and late.
Tomoyasu Chikazoku.visualDescription: A tall, lanky man with long, straight black hair falling down his back and a blunt fringe that half hides small gray eyes, pale skin and a narrow, sharp face. He wears a black turtleneck under a dark suit jacket and holds an open laptop. Irritable, impatient expression with a slight frown and tight lips.

Geten.name: Geten
Geten.basicInfo:
Geten, a cold, white-haired young man who lives at the private villa on Gunga Mountain and drills its weekend guests; caretakers and guests defer to him, and he answers only to the villa's owner. Pale skin, messy white hair, silver-gray eyes; a long light-blue parka with a fur-lined hood; no ice grows on his body.
Speaking Style: Cold, blunt verdicts on power and capability; no patience for polish or the weak.
Combat Role: Shapes existing ice and freezes nearby water into more; he cannot make ice from nothing.
Under Pressure: Hardens instead of bending and looks for more ice and water.
Geten.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches that strength should rule, yet his strength serves a cause and a man, never himself.
Motivation: A society where standing follows Quirk strength, won by the Army's liberation.
Concealment: He is one of the Meta Liberation Army's four lieutenants and its truest believer; with no public life, he stays out of sight at the villa.
Connections: Rikiya Yotsubashi (Re-Destro), the leader he reveres; Chitose Kizuki (Curious), Koku Hanabata (Trumpet) and Tomoyasu Chikazoku (Skeptic), fellow lieutenants.
Knowledge: The Army's methods, members and territory; little beyond the cause.
Canon voice & behavior: Sizes up a Quirk before a face; answers argument with a verdict on who is stronger.
Thread: How far devotion and contempt carry him when the Army finally moves.
QUIRK: Ice control. Moves and shapes existing ice and chills it to freeze nearby water into more; he cannot make ice from nothing, and heat and heavy blows break his constructs.
personality: Devoted: Would die for Re-Destro and expects the same of every member.
Austere: Ignores comfort and polish; all his attention goes to training and the cause.
Elitist: Ranks everyone by Quirk strength and says so to their face.
Speaking style: Cold, blunt judgments about power and capability; few words, no courtesies.
abilities: Ice control: Shapes ice within reach into spikes, walls and sliding platforms; heat and heavy blows break them.
Deep freeze: Chills his ice to freeze nearby water and grow his supply; dry ground starves it.
Field reading: Spots every source of ice, snow and water on a field before anyone moves.
Drillmaster: Drives members through full-strength drills and leads by example, not persuasion.
Fighting style: Claims every source of ice and water first, then grinds an opponent down with walls and spikes.
Geten.visualDescription: A lean young man with messy white hair, cold silver-gray eyes and very pale skin. He wears a long light-blue parka with a fur-lined hood over plain dark clothes and boots. Shards of clear ice glint in the cold air around his hands; none grow from his body. Severe, unsmiling expression and a hard, steady stare.

Inasa Yoarashi.name: Inasa Yoarashi
Inasa Yoarashi.basicInfo:
Inasa Yoarashi, a first-year in Shiketsu Academy's hero course: huge, loud and painfully sincere, in love with heroes, passion and U.A. He topped U.A.'s recommendation exam last winter, then turned the place down. Very tall and broad, a dark buzz cut; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap.
Speaking Style: Booming declarations about passion and heart; bows so deep they become a scene; loves U.A.'s motto, "Plus Ultra!"
Combat Role: Powerful, precise wind: whirlwinds, flight, several currents at once.
Under Pressure: Charges in at full heat; a grudge can make him forget his team.
Inasa Yoarashi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches passion that lifts everyone, yet one cold first impression hardens into an unfair grudge.
Motivation: Become a hero with a burning heart who carries others' passion forward.
Connections: Shoto Todoroki, who brushed him off at the recommendation exam with his father Endeavor's cold eyes; Inasa has resented him since. Endeavor, whose cold eyes looked through him when he was a child fan. Seiji Shishikura and Nagamasa Mora, schoolmates who rein in his outbursts.
Knowledge: Heroes' records and catchphrases by heart; everything U.A. broadcasts.
Canon voice & behavior: Shouts admiration at strangers; bows low enough to hit his head on the ground.
Thread: Whether his heat can carry a team instead of outrunning it.
QUIRK: Whirlwind. Precise control of powerful air currents for attack, flight and rescue; splitting them weakens each, and a strong heat updraft or stronger force can disrupt them.
personality: Enthusiastic: Throws everything into hero work and drags others along.
Demonstrative: Booming praise and bows deep enough to alarm onlookers.
Prejudiced: A cold first impression hardens into a judgment only real heart can shift.
Speaking style: Loud, wholehearted declarations; emphatic apologies when he is wrong.
abilities: Whirlwind: Powerful, precise currents that strike, lift and herd; strong heat or force can disrupt them.
Wind flight: Rides his own currents for height and speed; it takes constant focus.
Multiple currents: Splits his wind to hit many small targets at once; each current is weaker.
Rescue air: Cushions falls and steers debris from bystanders; misjudged force turns a cushion into a blow.
Fighting style: Overwhelms from the air with precise currents and thrown debris, often ahead of his team.
Inasa Yoarashi.visualDescription: A very tall, broad-shouldered young man with dark hair in a short buzz cut, a strong jaw, wide, intense dark eyes and light skin. He wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar fastened to the throat, dark trousers and a plain black peaked cap. A huge, open, wholehearted grin, full of energy and sincerity.

Seiji Shishikura.name: Seiji Shishikura
Seiji Shishikura.basicInfo:
Seiji Shishikura, a hero student at Shiketsu Academy, proud of its traditions and contemptuous of schools that treat hero work as a show, U.A. above all. Dark purple hair with a long fringe over his left eye, narrow dark eyes, a lean build; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap, worn to regulation.
Speaking Style: Severe and ceremonious; delivers judgments as verdicts and addresses rivals by their school.
Combat Role: Contact capture: his Quirk, Meatball, kneads touched flesh into a helpless ball; detached bits of his own flesh carry the touch at range.
Under Pressure: Doubles down on discipline.
Seiji Shishikura.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He preaches the humility of tradition with open superiority.
Motivation: Prove that a disciplined academy makes truer heroes than a famous one.
Concealment: His rigid standards often cover pride and resentment of the attention U.A. gets.
Leverage: Appeals to duty and Shiketsu's honor; showboating he can be baited into punishing.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, a gifted, loud first-year whose manners he corrects; Nagamasa Mora and Camie Utsushimi, Shiketsu schoolmates.
Knowledge: Shiketsu's code to the letter, and every lapse he has seen from other academies' students.
Canon voice & behavior: Lectures before he fights; treats a capture as a lesson in correct conduct.
Thread: Whether his standards are principle or vanity.
QUIRK: Meatball. A touch kneads a person's flesh into a compact ball that cannot move; detached pieces of his own flesh, steered at range, do the same. It works only on flesh, harms no one, and he can release it.
personality: Dutiful: Holds himself to Shiketsu's code and expects the same of every hero candidate.
Censorious: Points out a rival's lapses in conduct, publicly and at length.
Elitist: Mistakes rigid standards for personal superiority, especially toward U.A.
Speaking style: Severe, formal judgments and admonitions.
abilities: Meatball: A touch compacts a person's flesh into a helpless ball; contact only, flesh only.
Detached flesh: Steers bits of his own flesh to touch targets at range; each can be intercepted.
Shiketsu drilling: Trained in rescue, teamwork and conduct as hard as in combat; slow to bend a rule.
Conduct watch: Spots any breach of manners or procedure at once, and can miss the reason behind it.
Fighting style: Screens himself with detached flesh and closes only for the decisive touch; capture, never injury.
Seiji Shishikura.visualDescription: A lean young man with dark purple hair cut with a long fringe that sweeps over his left eye, narrow dark eyes, light skin and a thin, stern mouth. He wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar, buttoned precisely, dark trousers and a plain black peaked cap set perfectly straight. Severe, disapproving expression.

Camie Utsushimi.name: Camie Utsushimi
Camie Utsushimi.basicInfo:
Camie Utsushimi, a hero student at Shiketsu Academy and the breeziest face at a school famous for strict manners. Long light-brown hair, brown eyes, a medium build; Shiketsu's dark formal uniform and peaked cap, or her hero costume, a black zip-front bodysuit.
Speaking Style: Playful, casual slang ("like", "totally"); treats strangers as old friends.
Combat Role: Support and misdirection: her Quirk, Glamour, releases a mist that forms illusions to decoy enemies and hide her team; never solid.
Under Pressure: Stays chill a beat too long, then snaps into quick misdirection.
Camie Utsushimi.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She seems to take nothing seriously, yet she trains at one of Japan's strictest academies and means to finish.
Motivation: Become a hero alongside her friends, with as little stress as possible.
Concealment: Her laid-back manner hides how closely she is paying attention, and sometimes that she is not.
Leverage: Friends asking for help; being taken lightly.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, Seiji Shishikura and Nagamasa Mora, Shiketsu schoolmates she treats with the same easy familiarity as everyone else.
Knowledge: Hero gossip, rankings and trends; Shiketsu's drills, which she knows better than she lets on.
Canon voice & behavior: Greets strangers with a friend's ease; chatters through tense moments; calls out which sights are fake.
Thread: How seriously she takes hero work once it stops being easy.
QUIRK: Glamour. Releases a mist that forms temporary illusions; they last only while the mist holds and have no substance: a touch passes through.
personality: Friendly: Talks to strangers with zero formality and keeps the chat going.
Breezy: Shrugs off tension with a joke; little seems to rattle her.
Distractible: Can drift past what is serious until someone points it out.
Speaking style: Playful slang ("like", "totally"); casual and warm, never stiff.
abilities: Glamour: Releases a mist that forms illusions; they last only while the mist holds and have no physical substance.
Decoys: Conjures illusory figures and objects to draw attacks; touching one reveals the trick.
Misdirection: Hides allies' movements behind false images; it blocks sight, never a body or a blow.
Easy rapport: Talks her way into any group within minutes; it opens conversations, not doors.
Fighting style: Fogs an area with decoys so her team can reposition, then tells them which images are real.
Camie Utsushimi.visualDescription: A young woman with long, light-brown hair falling past her shoulders, large brown eyes, light skin and a medium build. She wears Shiketsu Academy's dark formal uniform: a long dark coat with a high collar and a plain black peaked cap set at a casual tilt. Relaxed, friendly expression with a playful half-smile and an easy, sunny look.

Nagamasa Mora.name: Nagamasa Mora
Nagamasa Mora.basicInfo:
Nagamasa Mora, an upperclassman in Shiketsu Academy's hero course who takes the school's public conduct seriously. A thick mane of light-brown hair hides his whole body and face; only Shiketsu's peaked cap on top and dark trousers below show.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and measured; corrects schoolmates with quiet, stern rebukes and apologizes to outsiders for them.
Combat Role: Restraint and area denial with his own lengthened hair.
Under Pressure: Steps in to restore order before Shiketsu's name suffers.
Nagamasa Mora.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He speaks for an academy that prizes courtesy, and must stand for schoolmates who do not share it.
Motivation: A creditable record for Shiketsu, and heroes who earn public trust by how they behave.
Leverage: Shiketsu's reputation; a fair offer of cooperation.
Connections: Inasa Yoarashi, the loud, earnest first-year he keeps within Shiketsu's standards; Seiji Shishikura, whose disdain for U.A. he does not endorse; Camie Utsushimi, whose casual manners he puts up with.
Knowledge: Shiketsu's standards, procedures and history; how the public sees each academy, U.A. above all.
Canon voice & behavior: Mediates between schools without endorsing every schoolmate's attitude; keeps his voice low when others raise theirs.
Thread: Whether Shiketsu and U.A. can respect each other for more than show.
QUIRK: Extend-o-Hair. Lengthens and controls his own hair; it creates nothing else, and the hair is still hair: fire burns it and blades cut it.
personality: Courteous: Greets other schools' students with formal respect, even rivals.
Representative: Puts Shiketsu's reputation first and speaks for it in any dispute.
Stern corrector: Rebukes a schoolmate's poor conduct quietly and severely; it can sound harsher than he means.
Speaking style: Polite, formal, measured; calm, precise rebukes.
abilities: Extend-o-Hair: Lengthens his own hair and steers it with precision; it creates no other substance.
Hair restraint: Wraps a target's limbs in hair; positioning and the target's strength decide if it holds.
Protective screen: Spreads his hair to block approaches and shield others; it grants no immunity.
Mediation: Calms a quarrel with formal courtesy; it works on the reasonable, not the furious.
Fighting style: Keeps a measured distance, wraps limbs and blocks lanes with hair, aiming for clean captures.
Nagamasa Mora.visualDescription: A very tall young man whose long, thick, light-brown hair falls from beneath a plain black peaked cap all the way past his knees, hiding his face and body completely. The hair hangs straight and neatly brushed; only dark trousers and black shoes show beneath it. No face is visible. Calm, steady, dignified presence, the cap set squarely on top.

Yo Shindo.name: Yo Shindo
Yo Shindo.basicInfo:
Yo Shindo, a first-year in Ketsubutsu Academy's hero course, quick to welcome strangers with a handshake and a compliment. Messy dark-brown hair, dark eyes, a muscular build; his academy's uniform, or his hero costume, a black-and-green suit with a gold jaw guard.
Speaking Style: Polished, sunny greetings and generous praise; in a contest, terse calls and candid frustration.
Combat Role: Area disruptor: his Quirk, Vibrate, shakes whatever he touches to crack the ground and topple groups.
Under Pressure: Drops the smile for blunt coordination and leans on his classmates.
Yo Shindo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He greets a rival warmly while already working out how to beat them.
Motivation: Prove a smaller academy can beat the big-name schools, U.A. first.
Concealment: His compliments double as scouting.
Leverage: A rival with a big reputation; honest criticism from classmates, usually right.
Connections: Ms. Joke, the pro who coaches his class at Ketsubutsu and keeps the mood light; his Ketsubutsu classmates, whose teamwork his plans depend on.
Knowledge: The big-name academies' star students and their Quirks; his own class's drills in detail.
Canon voice & behavior: Shakes hands while studying a rival's Quirk; drops the act at the whistle.
Thread: What happens when the friendly face and the ambition meet the same opponent.
QUIRK: Vibrate. Sends strong vibrations through whatever he touches, enough to crack and heave the ground; heavy output numbs his arms with recoil and endangers footing, structures and bystanders nearby.
personality: Welcoming: Opens with a handshake, a compliment and a memorable first impression.
Two-sided: Behind the courtesy he is ranking a rival's weak points.
Overconfident: Trusts his read of a rival too much; classmates tell him so.
Speaking style: Polished greetings that give way to focused coordination and candid frustration.
abilities: Vibrate: Shakes a touched object hard; needs contact, and strong output brings recoil and numbness.
Ground breaker: Cracks and heaves the ground to split a group; bystanders and structures limit its use.
Team coordination: Calls the timing for classmates' drilled moves; it depends on practice, not telepathy.
Scouting charm: Learns a rival's Quirk and temper through small talk; a guarded rival gives him little.
Fighting style: Breaks the terrain to scatter opponents and lets classmates pick off whoever falls.
Yo Shindo.visualDescription: A muscular young man with a broad, friendly face, messy dark-brown hair, dark eyes and light skin. He wears his hero costume: a fitted black-and-green suit with a gold guard framing his jaw and chin. An easy, confident smile and a warm, welcoming expression, with something calculating behind the eyes.

All Might (Retired).name: All Might (Retired)
All Might (Retired).basicInfo:
All Might, the retired Symbol of Peace: Japan's Number One hero for decades, until his last fight at Kamino, watched live across the country. Mid-battle his muscular body gave way to a thin, frail man on camera, and he won anyway; within the week he retired from hero work. He still teaches at U.A. Academy.
